details.description: Armor set with countless eyes and ears. Worn by Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing. Knowledge begins with the recognition of one's ignorance. items.acquisition: Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. This armor was worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. These fierce warriors were each and all accomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

items.name: Black Dumpling
items.acquisition: Mask forced on a victim's head to lend torture an extra degree of cruelty. It magnifies one's fears and make them acutely aware of all forms of pain Raises attack power when the wearer suffers from madness. items.name: Drake Knight Armor
items.acquisition: Armor Set comprised of the Drake Knight Helm , Drake Knight Armor , Drake Knight Gauntlets and the Drake Knight Greaves . This set can be acquired once you reach the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. Use the red roof below the grace to reach the rooftop garden-like area in the northeast which has a rotunda structure with a lift inside. The lift can't be used initially so drop down onto the large red roof to the south, then down the walkway to the east. Check along the northeast edge of this walkway for a platform you can jump onto to reach the rotunda building's lower balcony. The armor set can be found in a chest at the northeast end of this balcony.

items.name: Gelmir Knight Armor

To find the corpse, head down the first Chariot hallway until you see a pit on either side of the central concrete walkway instead of lava. Drop down into the left pit onto some wooden beams and look for a small window along the walls. Head through this window and down the ladder to find a Bloodhound Knight guarding the corpse.

To find the corpse, head down the first Chariot hallway until you see a pit on either side of the central concrete walkway instead of lava. Drop down into the left pit onto some wooden beams and look for a small window along the walls. Head through this window and down the ladder to find a Bloodhound Knight guarding the corpse.

items.name: Goldmask's Rags
items.acquisition: After the completion of Brother Corhyn 's questline. Head south from the Capital of Ash site of grace and go down the small path in the direction of the colosseum. Go past the plant enemies and stick to the left and you will find Goldmask. Look the rune from him, and reset the area and return to find the rest of his set on his body.

details.description: Worn rags that just barely cover the body. Lord Goldmask felt no draw to the vain excess of clothing; what use is finery to one who seeks greater brilliance?

items.name: Gravebird Armor

This location is situated to the far west of the Abandoned Ailing Village, nearly reaching the outer walls of Belurat, Tower Settlement.

items.name: Gravebird's Blackquill Armor

The path will start to head upwards and you will find several Gravebirds. Continue upwards and you will eventually reach an area where there are gravebird statues at the side, in the middle, against the wall, you will find the armor.

items.name: Gravekeeper Cloak

The snake is viewed as a traitor to the Erdtree, and the audience delighted in seeing these bronze effigies beaten and battered.

items.name: Greatjar
items.acquisition: Belurat Gaol : After leaving the jar labyrinth, you will pass a small bridge and fight 3 Mutated Prisoners, on quite a large platform. In order to advance the dungeon, you have to step on the jar at the end of the area, but don't do that. Instead, turn right to find another jar on a slightly lower level. Step on it, and it will take you high. Once there, jump from platform to platform, and once the area, opens up, the item is on a pedestal, beware of the enemies.

Jump on the spiked ceiling as it drops and ride it up to a platform with this item.

details.description: Golden scarab worn directly on the head. These scarabs roll clumps of incantations during their labors. Slightly reduces the FP costs of incantations, but increases damage taken. As a scarab approaches death, it abandons its rolled treasure and stretches its wings wide for long journey to its home nest.

Rebirth is as sleep to them, and with each awakening, memory fades into oblivion.

items.name: Night Maiden Armor
items.acquisition: This is a set that can be obtained from the top level of Bonny Gaol . To reach it, you have to progress most of the dungeon, then when you jump in a pot to get down, stay on that pot and wait for it to bring you all the way up again. The armor set contains the following pieces: Helm of Night Armor of Night Gauntlets of Night Greaves of Night

details.description: Armor worn by the nightmaidens of the Eternal City. Indicates the highest clerical rank, and includes a silk cape. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

items.name: Nomadic Merchant's Chapeau
items.acquisition: Full Armor Set. In the hidden tunnels behind the altar in Mohg, the Omen's boss room at the Cathedral of the Forsaken Site of Grace in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds below Leyndell, Royal Capital. After opening the secret passage behind the altar and taking the stairs down, after crossing the narrow fallen rafter, directly to the left is a tent and in the far corner you can find the full Nomadic Merchant's set. To get access to the set, you need to destroy tent by either aggroing the enemy close by, leading it next to the tent and baiting its frenzy attack onto it or quit-outing while standing very close to tent itself.

details.description: Chapeau of the nomadic merchants.

items.name: Tree Sentinel Armor
items.acquisition: Armor Set comprised of the Tree Sentinel Helm , Tree Sentinel Armor , Tree Sentinel Gauntlets and Tree Sentinel Greaves . Obtained inside the Auriza Hero's Grave by destroying three specific Chariots. Doing this involves a few steps: From this first Chariot Hall, drop down the openings on either side just before the second ramp. In the room below, head west and up the steps and then turn right in the next corridor. Follow the path and you will end up in a large Chariot Hall where two Chariots are running almost side by side, with a short delay between them. These are the Chariots you need to destroy. Head down the hall all the way to the bottom where there is a large pit behind some pillars. Looking down, you will find several wooden beams you can drop down onto. Navigate your way down onto the lowest beam you can drop down to and then head south towards an archway with a ladder in the back. Climb up the ladder to reach another Chariot Hall with a single Chariot. Wait for the Chariot to head downwards and then run up the ramp and enter the chamber on the right where you will find a flamethrower pillar. Hit the pillar to raise it which will activate the circular golden seal in the middle of the large double Chariot Hall, teleporting the Chariot from the third hall and causing it to collide with the double Chariots. From here, you will need to return to the large hall to witness the collision event and collect your items. The easiest way to do this is by killing yourself or using the Memory of Grace tool (if you don't care about your runes) to return to the Site of Grace. Alternatively, from the flamethrower pillar room, return to the third Chariot Hall, go all the way down the ramp and turn left into a corridor. Take another left to find a lift which will take you up to a chamber where the flamethrower pillar was raised. Wait for breaks between flame spews and head through the corridor in the north. There is an alcove on the right halfway through the corridor which you can use to safely wait for another break before heading towards the end. At the end of this corridor, you can turn left to return to the large Chariot Hall. After the Chariots crash into each other, you will receive the Armor Set along with the Ash of War: Holy Ground .

details.description: Golden armor of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

Climb up the ladder to reach another Chariot Hall with a single Chariot. Wait for the Chariot to head downwards and then run up the ramp and enter the chamber on the right where you will find a flamethrower pillar. Hit the pillar to raise it which will activate the circular golden seal in the middle of the large double Chariot Hall, teleporting the Chariot from the third hall and causing it to collide with the double Chariots. From here, you will need to return to the large hall to witness the collision event and collect your items. The easiest way to do this is by killing yourself or using the Memory of Grace tool (if you don't care about your runes) to return to the Site of Grace. Alternatively, from the flamethrower pillar room, return to the third Chariot Hall, go all the way down the ramp and turn left into a corridor. Take another left to find a lift which will take you up to a chamber where the flamethrower pillar was raised. Wait for breaks between flame spews and head through the corridor in the north. There is an alcove on the right halfway through the corridor which you can use to safely wait for another break before heading towards the end. At the end of this corridor, you can turn left to return to the large Chariot Hall. After the Chariots crash into each other, you will receive the Armor Set along with the Ash of War: Holy Ground .

items.name: Ash of War: Holy Ground
items.acquisition: Ash of War obtained inside the Auriza Hero's Grave by destroying three specific Chariots. Doing this involves a few steps: From this first Chariot Hall, drop down the openings on either side just before the second ramp. In the room below, head west and up the steps and then turn right in the next corridor. Follow the path and you will end up in a large Chariot Hall where two Chariots are running almost side by side, with a short delay between them. These are the Chariots you need to destroy. Head down the hall all the way to the bottom where there is a large pit behind some pillars. Looking down, you will find several wooden beams you can drop down onto. Navigate your way down onto the lowest beam you can drop down to and then head south towards an archway with a ladder in the back. Climb up the ladder to reach another Chariot Hall with a single Chariot. Wait for the Chariot to head downwards and then run up the ramp and enter the chamber on the right where you will find a flamethrower pillar. Hit the pillar to raise it which will activate the circular golden seal in the middle of the large double Chariot Hall, teleporting the Chariot from the third hall and causing it to collide with the double Chariots. From here, you will need to return to the large hall to witness the collision event and collect your items. The easiest way to do this is by killing yourself or using the Memory of Grace tool (if you don't care about your runes) to return to the Site of Grace. Alternatively, from the flamethrower pillar room, return to the third Chariot Hall, go all the way down the ramp and turn left into a corridor. Take another left to find a lift which will take you up to a chamber where the flamethrower pillar was raised. Wait for breaks between flame spews and head through the corridor in the north. There is an alcove on the right halfway through the corridor which you can use to safely wait for another break before heading towards the end. At the end of this corridor, you can turn left to return to the large Chariot Hall. After the Chariots crash into each other, you will receive the Ash of War along with the Tree Sentinel Armor Set .

Follow up with a strong attack for an upward strike."Usable on swords, axes, and hammers, (small and medium swords excepted).

items.name: Ash of War: Storm Assault
items.acquisition: Starting from the Rampart Tower grace, exit onto the ramparts where the war hawks and explosive barrels are. At the tower on the west side where the second war hawk holding an explosive barrel is, jump up onto the battlements on the north side. There is a corpse visible with an item (Marred Wooden Shield). Jumping down to the walls beneath will allow the player to get to the shield. Jumping down further will land the player on a ledge that will collapse, causing them to fall far below into some bushes. A Silver Teardrop Scarab holds the Ash of War

details.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Storm Assault: One of the skills that channel the tempests of Stormveil. Leap forward through surrounding storm winds and thrust armament downward. The attack will produce more storm winds at the point of impact."Usable on polearms capable of thrusting, heavy thrusting swords, and twinblades.

items.name: Ash of War: Storm Blade
items.acquisition: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Storm Blade: Lost skill of Stormveil. Surround armament with shearing storm winds that can be fired forward. Can be fired in rapid succession."Usable on swords (colossal weapons and twinblades excepted).

details.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Storm Blade: Lost skill of Stormveil. Surround armament with shearing storm winds that can be fired forward. Can be fired in rapid succession."Usable on swords (colossal weapons and twinblades excepted).

items.name: Ash of War: Storm Stomp
items.acquisition: Found in the southeastern area of Gatefront Ruins . There is a set of stairs that leads to a small room with a treasure chest. This item is found alongside Whetstone Knife .

details.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Storm Stomp: One of the skills that channel the tempests of Stormveil. Stomp hard on the ground to kick up a momentary storm."Usable on all melee armaments.

items.name: Ash of War: Storm Wall
items.acquisition: Find a Teardrop Scarab , defeat it to obtain the Ash of War .

details.description: This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:"Storm Wall: Swing the shield to create a wall of storm winds in front of you, deflecting arrows and other such physical projectiles. Can also be used in the same way as a regular parry."Usable on small and medium shields.

items.name: Ash of War: Stormcaller
items.acquisition: Ash of War Upgrade. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in the northern section of the castle.

details.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:"Stormcaller: One of the skills that channel the tempests of Stormveil. Spin armament to create surrounding storm winds. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks."Usable on swords capable of slashing, axes, hammers, and polearms (small and colossal weapons excepted).

items.name: Ash of War: Swift Slash
items.acquisition: Assist Hornsent in the fight against Needle Knight Leda. You need to progress the quest to find two summoning signs here. Take the golden one to assist Hornsent and defeat Needle Knight Leda .

items.name: Ash of War: Sword Dance
items.acquisition: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab found along the narrow path west of the Minor Erdtree.

details.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:"Sword Dance: Quickly close in to perform a series of spinning upward slashes. Follow up with an additional input to finish with a downward slash."Usable on swords, axes, and polearms capable of slashing (colossal weapons and great spears excepted).

items.name: Ash of War: The Poison Flower Blooms Twice
items.acquisition: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab. From where you found the shadowpothead, move north a bit and turn left, you will see it on the other side of the river. Kill it to obtain a new ash of war. Ash of War The Poison Flower Blooms Twice .

items.name: Ash of War: Thops's Barrier

items.name: Ash of War: Through and Through

items.name: Ash of War: Thunderbolt

details.description: This Ash of War grants an armament the Lightning affinity and the following skill:"Thunderbolt: Skill used by the capital's ancient dragon cult. Raise armament aloft to call down a bolt of lightning. Can be fired in rapid succession."Usable on all melee armaments.

items.name: Ash of War: Troll's Roar

items.name: Ash of War: Unsheathe

items.name: Ash of War: Vacuum Slice

items.name: Ash of War: Wall of Sparks

items.name: Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook 4
items.acquisition: Cookbook found in a gazebo-like structure high above in the heavily-crumbled section in the northwest. To get up here, you will first need to ascend the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple and then head south from the fountain plaza until you reach the Phantom Tree surrounded by pillars. From here, head west and use the top of another group of pillars to make your way to the start of the upper crumbled section. You will need to traverse the massive floating chunks of debris, heading further west. Once you get to the second large chunk, look in the northwest section of it for a series of makeshift stone bridges that will lead you to the gazebo where the cookbook can be looted off a corpse.

details.description: A record of crafting techniques taught by the capital's ancient dragon cult. Details techniques that harness lightning, the weapon of the ancient dragons. Acquire the knowledge to craft the following: - Ancient Dragonbolt Pot - Lightningproof Dried Liver

Following the the hidden path, there are stairs down and will lead to collapsed rafters that you can cross; you can cross the path and follow the stairs down for a safer route, or drop directly below on second set of collapsed rafters. The new palace of the Lord of Blood lies in a swamp of festering blood, and these flies are said to spawn from excrement in that land.

items.acquisition: Incantation . Found on a corpse by one of the pillars on the left side of the Callu Baptismal Church .

details.description: Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers.

items.name: Theodorix's Magma
items.acquisition: Unlocked after the defeat of Great Wyrm Theodorix . This item can then be purchased after its defeat.

details.description: Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of the great wyrm Theodorix. Transforms caster into a great wyrm to spew a large volume of magma breath. Allows one follow-up attack. The name of the ancient troll warrior Theodorix lives on — as a hero of the War against the Giants.

items.name: Triple Rings of Light
items.acquisition: Incantation . Found in a chest locked behind an Imp Statue barrier. Requires 2 Stonesword Keys to unlock.

details.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists. Produces three rings of light and fires them forwards. The rings of light return to a position close to the caster before disappearing. This incantation can be cast repeatedly. A gift from the young Ivliquella to his father, Radagon.

items.name: Unendurable Frenzy
items.acquisition: Incantation . Found in a chest in an underground treasure room in the central section of the Yelough Anix Ruins .

details.description: Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers. Causes the yellow flame of frenzy to violently burst forth from the caster's eyes. Hold to continue channeling the flame. This incantation can be used while in motion. It is the maddening pain and unstoppable tears of those afflicted with the flame of frenzy brought into being.

items.name: Urgent Heal
items.acquisition: Incantation of the Two Fingers faithful.

details.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers faithful.

items.name: Vyke's Dragonbolt
items.acquisition: Dragon Cult Incantation . Received after defeating Vyke, Knight of the Roundtable at Lord Contender's Evergaol .

details.description: Incantation of Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold.

items.name: Watchful Spirit
items.acquisition: Incantation given by Hornsent Grandam if you talk to hear while wearing the Divine Beast Head. Talk to her a few times until she gives the item.

items.name: Whirl, O Flame!
items.acquisition: Dropped from a Teardrop Scarab on the road between Rotview Balcony and Caelem Ruins next to the wagon.

details.description: Superior Incantation of the Fire Monks.

items.name: Wrath from Afar
items.acquisition: Shadow Keep - accessed from the Church District Side. Take the elevator at the Storehouse, Loft site of grace. Once you are on the upper level, turn left, and turn left again. As soon as you can turn right. Beware of the bat hanging from the ceiling. Reach the other side, and take the ladder up. Turn left and move towards the area in which there is a giant gear (the one that does not have a bat on it), once you are aligned fall down to find the spell behind the column.

items.name: Wrath of Gold
items.acquisition: Found at Woodfolk Ruins . Among the enemies, there is a staircase that goes down and leads to a chest that contains this Incantation

details.description: Superior Erdtree Worship incantation. Produces a golden shockwave that knocks back nearby foes. Charging increases the size of the shockwave. This incantation was discovered when the Elden Ring was shattered, and it was feared as a sign of the Erdtree's wrath.

items.name: Academy Glintstone Key
items.acquisition: Key used to unlock the gate of Raya Lucaria Academy

details.description: Key to the seals binding both gates to the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

items.name: Academy Scroll
items.acquisition: Key Item. Give to a mage to unlock more sorceries. It's by one of the big gravestones where the Skeleton Mages are rising.

details.description: Scroll of the Academy of Raya Lucaria, the glintstone sorcerers' place of study.

items.name: Amber Starlight
items.acquisition: Key item requested by Seluvis to progress his quest further.

items.name: Ancient Dragon Prayerbook
items.acquisition: Incantation Tome. Found at ground level in the middle of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace.

details.description: Prayerbook of the capital's ancient dragon cult. A lost tome that never reached the Lands Between.

items.name: Ancient Ruins Cross Message
items.acquisition: Located in the area where you find Devonia, Crucible Knight.

items.name: Assassin's Prayerbook
items.acquisition: Prayerbook of the Roundtable Hold's assassins.

details.description: Prayerbook of the Roundtable Hold's assassins.

items.name: Beast Eye
items.acquisition: Claw-marked stone eye received from Gurranq, Beast Clergyman.

details.description: Claw-marked stone eye received from Gurranq, Beast Clergyman.

items.name: Black Knifeprint
items.acquisition: Black Knifeprint is a Key Item needed to advance in Sorcerer Rogier's questline. Dropped by Black Knife Assassin upon defeat.

details.description: On the Night of the Black Knives, someone stole a fragment of Death from Maliketh, the Black Blade, and imbued its power into the assassins' daggers.

items.name: Carian Inverted Statue
items.acquisition: Quest Item. Given by Ranni after giving her the Fingerslayer Blade .

details.description: Statuette of a scholar, with ground and sky inverted.

items.name: Celestial Dew
items.acquisition: Consumable. Found on a ledge overlooking the Uhl Palace Ruins .

details.description: A hidden Tear found in the Eternal City. Also known as a Night Tear.

items.name: Chrysalids' Memento
items.acquisition: Key Quest Item. Found on top of the pile of corpses surrounded by Rotten Strays in a small room. This room is adjacent to the Grafted Scion 's hall.

details.description: Memento left by the chrysalids sacrificed for grafting. A brooch wrapped in red velvet. Traces of blood are visible.

items.name: Conspectus Scroll
items.acquisition: Looted off a body inside a room. From the Schoolhouse Classroom site of Raya Lucaria Academy , go to the hallway, turn left. You'll see the corpse in front a an illusory wall.

items.name: Cracked Pot
items.acquisition: Crafting Pot. Found on the cliffs overlooking the gardens below.

details.description: This empty pot somehow mends itself when broken.

items.name: Crafting Kit
items.acquisition: Leather bag containing a pestle and mortar, small blade, and various other tools. Enables item crafting from the main menu. Provides both means to fight and means to survive.

details.description: Leather bag containing a pestle and mortar, small blade, and various other tools. Enables item crafting from the main menu. Provides both means to fight and means to survive.

items.name: Cursemark of Death
items.acquisition: Key Item. Found on a body lying at the top of the Divine Tower of Liurnia .

details.description: Cursemark carved into the discarded flesh of Ranni the Witch. Also known as the half-wheel wound of the centipede.

items.name: Dancer's Castanets
items.acquisition: Key Item. Given by Patches in Shaded Castle , before the boss room, after killing Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy and talking to him in Volcano Manor .

items.name: Dark Moon Ring
items.acquisition: Quest Item. Found in a locked chest next to the Raya Lucaria Grand Library Site of Grace. Unlocked using the Discarded Palace Key .

details.description: Ring depicting a leaden full moon. Symbolic of a cold oath, the ring is supposed to be given by Lunar Princess Ranni to her consort.

items.name: Deathroot
items.acquisition: Inside Deathtouched Catacombs. Found on a chest behind the Black Knife Assassin.

details.description: A source that gives rise to Those Who Live in Death.

items.name: Dectus Medallion (Left)
items.acquisition: Key Quest Item. Found in a chest that can be reached by climbing the ladder in the tallest tower of Fort Haight .

details.description: Left half of a split medallion depicting the Erdtree.

items.name: Dectus Medallion (Right)
items.acquisition: Key Quest Item. Found in a chest atop the eastern tower in Fort Faroth , accessible via ladder past all the bats on the bottom level.

details.description: Right half of a split medallion depicting the Erdtree.

items.name: Discarded Palace Key
items.acquisition: A key discarded by Lunar Princess Ranni alongside her very flesh. Opens a treasure chest passed down to Carian Princesses. It is said to be found in the Grand Library of Raya Lucaria with her mother Rennala.

details.description: A key discarded by Lunar Princess Ranni alongside her very flesh. Opens a treasure chest passed down to Carian Princesses. It is said to be found in the Grand Library of Raya Lucaria with her mother Rennala.

items.name: Dragon Cult Prayerbook
items.acquisition: Dropped by a knight patrolling immediately south of the Liurnia Artist Shack

details.description: Prayerbook of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

items.name: Dragon Heart
items.acquisition: Dropped by the Jagged Peak Drake .

details.description: Dragon heart seized by a dragon tracker. It has a bizarre shape, mottled by gravel, and it continues to beat vivaciously. An offering used in the Dragon Communion. Consume a dragon's heart at the altar to make its power yours. While a terrible and savage-looking thing, the heart has a peculiar beauty to it.

items.name: Drawing-Room Key
items.acquisition: Key Item. Given by Tanith after pledging your allegiance to the Volcano Manor .

details.description: Key to Volcano Manor's drawing room.

items.name: Fingerprint Grape
items.acquisition: Dropped by Festering Fingerprint Vyke .

details.description: Eyeball of the knight Vyke, inflamed yellow.

items.name: Fingerslayer Blade
items.acquisition: Quest Item. Found in a chest under the massive skeleton statue in Night's Sacred Ground

details.description: The hidden treasure of the Eternal City of Nokron; a blade said to have been born of a corpse.

items.name: Fire Monks' Prayerbook
items.acquisition: Incantation Tome. Found on a corpse in an enemy outpost in the area.

details.description: Prayerbook of the Fire Monks, who came from the Mountaintops of the Giants far to the north.

items.name: Gaol Lower Level Key
items.acquisition: Lamenter's Gaol. Can be found on a chest in an area full of Living Jar enemies.

items.name: Gaol Upper Level Key
items.acquisition: Can be found within Lamenter's Gaol. When you enter, proceed until you reach a fork in the path. Take the left turn, and after a short walk, enter the room on your right. Inside, you'll find a chest containing the Gaol Upper Level Key.

items.name: Giant's Prayerbook
items.acquisition: Key Item. Give to a Cleric to unlock Incantations: Giantsflame Take Thee and Flame, Fall Upon Them for purchase.

items.name: Godskin Prayerbook
items.acquisition: Can be found at Stormveil Castle , Nearest Site of Grace: Rampart Tower. From the Rampart Tower site of grace, go out the door to the outside (where the birds are). Take a running jump onto the roof across from the door. On the left side of the roof, there will be two separate areas you can drop down to. Drop down to the one without stairs on it, and drop down again. You'll land by a set of steps going down. Go down the steps to find some rats and a white fog wall. You'll need a Stonesword Key to pass through the fog wall, and inside will be two chests. One contains the Godskin Prayerbook, the other contains the Godslayer's Seal . Alternatively, from the Liftside Chamber Site of Grace, exit from the door to the courtyard and turn right. Hug the right side wall past all the enemies. You'll find the set of stairs going down on the wall on the other side.

items.name: Gold Sewing Needle
items.acquisition: Sewing needle made of gold. Unique item made to alter demigod attire. Located inside a chest at the right of Church of Vows' main entrance.

details.description: Sewing needle made of gold.

items.name: Golden Order Principia
items.acquisition: Incantation Tome. From the Erdtree Sanctuary site in Leyndell, Royal Capital, exit the east side of the room. Once outside, climb up the root to the left that circles back into the building's 2nd floor. Once inside, exit the only door and immediately turn left to jump down to a nearby roof. Once on the roof, a broken window can be used to get back inside. After entering the broken window, climb the root crossing the room to reach the Golden Order Principia, which is located in the chair hanging from the ceiling.

missable.lockedBy: Burning the Erdtree (Forge of the Giants)
missable.note: Prayerbook in the Fortified Manor, western Leyndell; Royal Capital only.

items.name: Golden Tailoring Tools
items.acquisition: Tools made of gold brought with the red-haired Radagon when he married into the Carian line. Located inside a chest at the right of Church of Vows' main entrance.

details.description: Tailoring tools made from gold.

items.name: Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left)
items.acquisition: Key Item. Found in the castle's northeast tower after defeating Commander Niall .

details.description: Left half of a split medallion depicting the Haligtree. Brandishing the medallion with both halves conjoined will activate the Grand Lift of Rold, granting access to a hidden path. In other words, this secret medallion will guide the bearer to the land of Miquella's Haligtree.

items.name: Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right)
items.acquisition: Key Item. Hit Albus , who is disguised as a pot past the Perfumer guarding the path up from the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace. This medallion opens the path to a secret location past Lyndell.

details.description: Right half of a split medallion depicting the Haligtree. Brandishing the medallion with both halves conjoined will activate the Grand Lift of Rold, granting access to a hidden path. In other words, this secret medallion will guide the bearer to the land of Miquella's Haligtree.

items.name: Heart of Bayle
items.acquisition: Dropped by Bayle the Dread upon defeat.

items.name: Hefty Cracked Pot
items.acquisition: Special Tool Key Item. From the location of the Ghost NPC, south of the Scorched Ruins. Head north and take the first right to the higher ground. Alongside a group of Shadows, you will find a body containing this item.

items.name: Hole-Laden Necklace
items.acquisition: Given by Ymir when first interacted.

items.name: Igon's Furled Finger
items.acquisition: Will be given by Igon by interacting with him after defeating the Jagged Peak Drake in the area.

items.name: Irina's Letter
items.acquisition: Letter given by Irina, addressed to her father, the commander of Castle Morne. Gorgeous silken handkerchief, lightly stained with blood. Words can be made out within

details.description: Letter given by Irina, addressed to her father, the commander of Castle Morne. Gorgeous silken handkerchief, lightly stained with blood. Words can be made out within

items.name: Letter for Freyja
items.acquisition: Given by Sir Ansbach after handing over the Secret Rite Scroll.

items.name: Lord of Blood's Favor
items.acquisition: Key Item. Obtained from White-Faced Varre after invading other players 3 times and talking to him, then accepting to be knighted.

items.name: Lord of Blood's Favor (Soaked)
items.acquisition: Key Item. Obtained from White-Faced Varre after invading other players 3 times and talking to him, then accepting to be knighted.

items.name: Lost Ashes of War
items.acquisition: A Lost Ashes of War can be found in the middle of the Ellac Greatbridge.

items.name: Mending Rune of the Death-Prince
items.acquisition: Rewarded after defeating Lichdragon Fortissax

items.name: Mending Rune of the Fell Curse
Messmer's Kindling
items.acquisition: Key Item Dropped by Messmer the Impaler

items.name: Miniature Ranni
items.acquisition: Key Item. Found in an open stone coffin in the waters of Ainsel River Main .

details.description: A doll resembling Ranni the Witch.

missable.lockedBy: Betray path or incomplete Millicent questline
missable.note: Use the Unalloyed Gold Needle on Millicent's Scarlet Aeonia after assisting her and defeating Malenia; used in Placidusax's arena to undo the Frenzied Flame.

items.name: Monk's Missive
items.acquisition: Looted off the ground just behind where Hornsent is standing. You'll also acquire the May the Best Win gesture alongside this key item.

items.name: Perfume Bottle
items.acquisition: Key Crafting Item. Found on a body hanging by the edge of the top part of the inner ramparts. You can reach this area by climbing a ladder in the eastern section of the inner courtyard and following the ramparts as it curves to the west.

details.description: Glass bottles used by perfumers. Used to seal various scent compounds.

items.name: Prayer Room Key
items.acquisition: Acquired as a drop upon defeating the NPC Invader Fire Knight Queelign for the second time.

items.name: Ritual Pot
items.acquisition: Special Tool Key Item. Found on a corpse in the northern section of the Laskyar Ruins , in front of a set of pillars.

details.description: This empty pot somehow mends itself when broken. Special item with greater durability than a cracked pot.

items.name: Rold Medallion
items.acquisition: Given by Melina at the Site of Grace once you defeat Morgott, The Omen King .

details.description: Conjoined split medallion depicting the Flame Peak. Brandishing the medallion activates the Grand Lift of Rold, connecting Leyndell to the Mountaintops of the Giants. The forge of the flame of ruin is said to be found upon their peaks, and it is here Melina wishes to travel in resuming your journey together.

items.name: Royal House Scroll
items.acquisition: Head southeast from the Agheel Lake South site of grace, head to the top of a cliff and you'll see a statue of an object that looks like the half piece of a bowl or a circle. Face the other way, to see a Knight. Keep going to a structure to see a man standing watching over the big structure, alongside a dead body. In that body, you will find the Royal House Scroll.

details.description: Sorcery scroll of the Carian royal family, the heads of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

items.name: Ruins Map
items.acquisition: Given by Ymir when first interacted.

items.name: Ruins Map (2nd)
items.acquisition: Given by Ymir after ringing the hanging bell in the center of the Finger Ruins of Rhia.

items.name: Ruins Map (3rd)
items.acquisition: Given by Ymir after completing her questline.

items.name: Rusty Key
items.acquisition: Key Item. Found on a corpse inside the room with the Banished Knight.

details.description: Rusted iron key.

items.name: Secret Rite Scroll
items.acquisition: Located on a table inside the room down the stairs, after progressing outside from the fourth floor. It's near the edge of this area.

items.name: Seedbed Curse
items.acquisition: Key Item. Found after you exit the room with East Capital Rampart grace, continue south past the Oracle Envoys and into the building. Inside, head down the stairs and face west to take the elevator. After the elevator continue west into the next building. Climb up the ladder to your right and go up the stairs. On the highest floor you will find the Seedbed Curse on a corpse sitting in a chair.

details.description: Curse grown on a corpse killed and defiled by the Dung Eater. A tender pox afflicted with omen horns.

items.name: Seluvis's Introduction
items.acquisition: A scroll given by Seluvis . It is addressed to Sorceress Sellen

details.description: Scroll bearing a royal coat of arms.

items.name: Seluvis's Potion
items.acquisition: Key Quest Item. Given by Seluvis after accepting his task.

details.description: Small flask received from Preceptor Seluvis containing a cloudy tonic of bluish black.

items.name: Serpent's Amnion
items.acquisition: Found on the altar after defeating the Godskin Noble Boss in Volcano Manor .

items.name: Sewer-Gaol Key
items.acquisition: Filthy key received from the Dung Eater.

details.description: Filthy key received from the Dung Eater.

items.name: Sewing Needle
items.acquisition: Key Quest Item. Dropped by the Demi-Human Chief boss upon defeat. Return it to Boc the Seamster in the Coastal Cave to further his storyline.

details.description: A large sewing needle, curved like a fang. Boc the demi-human's prized possession.

items.name: Spirit Calling Bell
items.acquisition: Key Item. Given by Renna . Return to the church after getting your horse to find her sitting by the ruins.

details.description: A bell capable of summoning various spirits from ashen remains. It usually requires FP to use.

items.name: Storehouse Cross Message
items.acquisition: Climb the feet of the statue and move towards the head, jump to the next area. You will find the item on a table, next to a Miquella's Cross and a Site of Grace

items.name: Storeroom Key
items.acquisition: From the top of the waterfall, you will find a room with a ladder, enter the room and climb the ladder. At the top, you will find a corpse with the Storeroom Key.

items.name: Tailoring Tools
items.acquisition: Key Item. Dropped by the Demi-Human Chief boss upon defeat.

details.description: A portable set of tailoring tools.

items.name: Talisman Pouch
items.acquisition: Small, withered bag, knitted by hand. Bestowed upon the ruling lord, or those atempting to become lord, by the elderly Finger Reader. Dropped by Margit, the Fell Omen upon defeat.

details.description: Small, withered bag, knitted by hand. Bestowed upon the ruling lord, or those atempting to become lord, by the elderly Finger Reader.

items.name: Two Fingers' Prayerbook
items.acquisition: Located in the first floor of Fortified Manor.

details.description: Prayerbook containing incantations of the Two Fingers. An item once entrusted to Tarnished worthy of lordship.

items.name: Unalloyed Gold Needle
items.acquisition: Key Quest Item. Required to progress Gowry 's questline. Dropped by Commander O'Neil upon defeat.

details.description: An intricately crafted needle of unalloyed gold, snapped in half.

items.name: Valkyrie's Prosthesis
items.acquisition: Key Item. Found by climbing up the ladder in the central-western section of the courtyard that leads up to the top of the inner walls. Follow the walls northwest to find a room with a chest surrounded by statues and guarded by a single Cleanrot Knight .

details.description: Golden prosthesis once used by the one-armed valkyrie. A masterwork of craftsmanship, with practice and skill it can be used as proficiently as a real arm. When Maleigh Marais, Lord of the Shaded Castle, embraced this prosthesis, he claimed to feel the presence of his personal goddess.

items.name: Weathered Dagger
items.acquisition: Dagger received from Fia, the Deathbed Companion.

missable.lockedBy: Burning the Erdtree (Forge of the Giants)
missable.note: Found in the Royal Capital; give to D to advance Fia's questline.

details.description: Dagger received from Fia, the Deathbed Companion.

items.name: Well Depths Key
items.acquisition: From the Whiteflesh Mushroom found on the bridge, enter the room with two enemies and you will find the Well Depths Key there.

items.name: Whetstone Knife
items.acquisition: Key Item. Found in the southeastern area of Gatefront Ruins . There is a set of stairs that leads to a small room with a treasure chest. This item is found alongside the Ash of War: Storm Stomp upgrade.

details.description: Whetstone with a cipher inscription, made to look like a small knifeblade.

items.name: Larval Tear #1
items.acquisition: Key item used for Rebirth. Obtained by defeating a regular Noble enemy, that transforms into a Lesser Rune Bear. If you kill the Bear form a larval tear will drop.

items.name: Larval Tear #2
items.acquisition: Larval Tear dropped by a Troll disguised as a regular enemy.

items.name: Larval Tear #3
items.acquisition: Key Item. Can be found at the graveyard in the Village of the Albinaurics , near the town well.

items.name: Larval Tear #4
items.acquisition: Key item used for Rebirth. Dropped by a Grafted Scion disguised as a Giant Lobster when defeated. Located between Rose Church and Boilprawn Shack .

items.name: Larval Tear #5
items.acquisition: Key Item. Found by touching a ghost at the graveyard. This ghost also gives Juvenile Scholar Cap and Juvenile Scholar Robe . This is the location from the Resurrection Painting .

items.name: Larval Tear #6
items.acquisition: Dropped from a Miniboss disguises as a noble inside the ruins.

items.name: Larval Tear #7
items.acquisition: Dropped by Colossal Wormface disguised as charred corpse when defeated. Due East from the Road of Inequities grace, upon entering the ruined camp, and next to the first corpse fire will be the charred remains enemy

items.name: Larval Tear #8
items.acquisition: Dropped by a Runebear disguised as a pilgrim in the Consecrated Snowfield . The disguised pilgrim is half-buried in snow with two other pilgrims, one carrying a torch, standing around it. They are located southeast of the Inner Consecrated Snowfield site of grace, nearly on the straight-line path between the grace and the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs .

items.name: Larval Tear #9
items.acquisition: Key Item. Dropped by Mimic Tear when defeated.

items.name: Larval Tear #10
items.acquisition: Key Item. Found on a corpse inside a stone building in Nokron, Eternal City .

items.name: Larval Tear #11
items.acquisition: Key Item. Found on a corpse in the middle of a gazebo in Nokron, Eternal City . When first approaching the corpse, slimes will fall from the ceiling.

items.name: Larval Tear #12
items.acquisition: Key Item. Dropped by a Silver Tear disguised as a large inanimate ball in Night's Sacred Ground .

items.name: Larval Tear #13
items.acquisition: Dropped by a Silver Tear disguised as a large inanimate ball on the bridge.

items.name: Larval Tear #14
items.acquisition: Rolls down the stairs across the bridge and then toward players are they enter this location

items.name: Larval Tear #15
items.acquisition: Larval tear can be found here

items.name: Larval Tear #19
items.acquisition: Can be found southeast of Scorched Ruins. This can only be found at night as it's surrounded by glowing gravestones.

items.name: Larval Tear #20
items.acquisition: On an area of illuminated graves. Near a servant of Rot that gives you the Forager Brood Cookbook [2] .

items.name: Larval Tear #21
items.acquisition: Found between glowing gravestones. Only available at night.

items.name: Larval Tear #22
items.acquisition: Larval Tear looted from a spot of glowing graves available at night only, just south from Abandoned Ailing Village.

items.name: Larval Tear #23
items.acquisition: South of the Church of the Crusade . Found between the glowing gravestones. (Only at night)

items.name: Larval Tear #24
items.acquisition: Rauh Base. Found between the glowing gravestones. (only at night)

items.name: Larval Tear #25
items.acquisition: East of Messmer's Army Encampment. Found between the glowing gravestones. (only at night)

items.name: Larval Tear #26
items.acquisition: West of Rabbath's Rise . Found between the glowing gravestones. (only at night)

items.name: Larval Tear #27
items.acquisition: West of the Ravine North Site of Grace . Found between the glowing gravestones. (only at night)

items.name: Map Abyss
items.acquisition: Map of the Abyss at the east of the Gravesite Plain. Found besides a column.

items.name: Map Ainsel River
items.acquisition: Found inside a ruin next to the Nomadic Merchant .

details.description: Map of Ainsel River and environs

items.name: Map Altus Plateau
items.acquisition: Can be found near the round, just north of the Altus Highway Junction site of grace

details.description: Map of Altus Plateau and environs. The Altus Plateau, where the Erdtree's base can be found, contains the Royal Capital of Leyndell to the east, and Mt. Gelmir to the west. Scars from the Shattering remain apparent to this day.

items.name: Map Caelid
items.acquisition: Map Fragment. Reveals the Caelid region excluding Dragonbarrow . Found on a monolith at the Caelid Highway South intersection.

details.description: Map of Caelid and environs.

items.name: Map Consecrated Snowfield
items.acquisition: Map for all of Consecrated Snowfield: follow the road north past the snowstorm until you go down and cross a frozen river, then you will spot the map pillar ahead.

details.description: Map of Consecrated Snowfield and environs. The route through this land, crossed east to west by a frozen river, leads to Miquella's Haligtree. This is the path taken by those unchosen, though it is a trial all the same.

items.name: Map Deeproot Depths
items.acquisition: Map for entire Deeproot Depths area. Can be found on a corpse in a gazebo amid the destroyed ruins

details.description: Map of Deeproot Depths and environs. At the very depths of the Erdtree's majestic roots lies the source of the Ainsel and the Siofra rivers. Here too begins the network of Greattree roots that spread throughout the Lands Between.

items.name: Map Dragonbarrow
items.acquisition: Map Fragment. Reveals the Dragonbarrow region. Found on a monolith along the road east of the Dragonbarrow West Site of Grace.

details.description: Map of Dragonbarrow and environs.

items.name: Map Gravesite Plain
items.acquisition: To find this Map Fragment, travel directly northeast from when you first entered the Shadow Realm.

items.name: Map Lake of Rot
items.acquisition: Found on a corpse by the water's edge at Lake Rot .

details.description: Map of Lake of Rot and environs. A great lake of standing water downstream of the Ainsel River. It is said that the divine essence of an outer god is sealed away in this land.

items.name: Map Leyndell, Royal Capital
items.acquisition: Map Fragment. Reveals the Leyndell region. Found on a monolith near the Outer Wall Phantom Tree Site of Grace.

details.description: Map of the Royal Capital of Leyndell and environs.

items.name: Map Limgrave, East
items.acquisition: At the foot of a pillar with ancient writings on it. Unlocks Eastern Limgrave on your map.

details.description: Map of the eastern region of Limgrave.

items.name: Map Limgrave, West

There's another doorway just behind the rubble, and following the path beyond will lead to a small room with the fragment, next to a Miquella's Cross

items.name: Scadutree Fragment #18
items.acquisition: From the First Rise Site of Grace of Enir-Ilim, progress the area until you're about to reach the Spiral Rise Site of Grace. Near the checkpoint, you'll find a stairway that leads down to a room where you can loot the Inquisitor Ashes. Outside of this room, jump down onto a broken staircase that might look like a dead-end. Check the east side of this staircase to drop onto the narrow edge of the wall. Wrap along the side of it until you reach a platform that has a body holding x10 Golem's Great Arrow. Look south and do a running jump to jump across the pit and towards a window. Drop down to formally arrive in a secret section of Belurat Tower Settlement. Continue forward from here until you find a covered statue where you'll find x1 Scadutree Fragment by the foot of the statue.

items.name: Scadutree Fragment #19
items.acquisition: x1 Scadutree Fragment drops from one of the two Hippopotamus enemies in the area. This area can only be accessed by using the ladder in Shadow Keep to get down to a special teleport coffin. This will take you to Ruins of Unte and you must follow the cliffs downstream, and then carefully drop down to the bottom level to reach it.
