items.name: Albinauric Shield
items.acquisition: Tall oval shield made of metal carried by young Albinaurics. The ornamentation represents the primordial drop of dew from which they are said to have been created. Boasts exceptional magic damage negation. The Albinaurics' most formidable foes were sorcerers, after all.

details.description: Tall oval shield made of metal carried by young Albinaurics. The ornamentation represents the primordial drop of dew from which they are said to have been created. Boasts exceptional magic damage negation. The Albinaurics' most formidable foes were sorcerers, after all.

items.name: Ant's Skull Plate
items.acquisition: Greatshield . Found in a chest in a small room in Nokstella, Eternal City .

details.description: Huge head of one of the giant ants which inhabit the two underground rivers, used without modification as a shield. Excels at repeling enemy attacks. Giant ants are venomous creatures, granting a boost to immunity when wielding the shield.

items.name: Banished Knight's Shield
items.acquisition: A tall medium-sized metal shield. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.

details.description: A tall medium-sized metal shield. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.

items.name: Beast Crest Heater Shield
items.acquisition: A large shield kept inside a chest at a camp.

details.description: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. Features a beast as its crest, serving to remind warriors not to succumb to the arousal of battle. Fight with passion, but become nor its prisoner.

items.name: Beastman's Jar-Shield
items.acquisition: Found in the room next to the site of the grace.

details.description: Shield fashioned from a tall broken jar carried by the beastmen of Farum Azula. There is a particular knack to wielding it. The beastmen have always fired earthenware jars for the express purpose of making shields. Such are their ways, strange though they are.

items.name: Black Leather Shield
items.acquisition: Roundshield covered in black leather. On the larger side for a medium-sized shield. From the north, this shield depicts the polar star in rivets of gold. The inside is lined with fur, protecting the carrier from frost.

details.description: Roundshield covered in black leather. On the larger side for a medium-sized shield. From the north, this shield depicts the polar star in rivets of gold. The inside is lined with fur, protecting the carrier from frost.

items.name: Black Steel Greatshield
items.acquisition: This shield item drops as a reward upon defeating the boss Black Knight Garrew .

items.name: Blue Crest Heater Shield
items.acquisition: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The crest represents a forest and river.

details.description: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The crest represents a forest and river.

items.name: Blue-Gold Kite Shield
items.acquisition: A standard medium-sized shield. Highly reputed for its solid build and reliability. The design represents the Erdtree foreground against a blue sky.

details.description: A standard medium-sized shield. Highly reputed for its solid build and reliability. The design represents the Erdtree foreground against a blue sky.

items.name: Blue-White Wooden Shield
items.acquisition: Shield in Academy Gate Town (near Raya Lucaria Academy Entrance). Can be found on the outskirts of the buildings, towards the west side.

details.description: Small wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a true metal shield. The design is said to represent the stars of the night sky, portending fate.

items.name: Brass Shield
items.acquisition: Found southeast of the map in Limgrave. Head southeast from the Agheel Lake South site of grace, head to the top of a cliff and you'll see a statue of an object that looks like the half piece of a bowl or a circle. Face the other way, to see a Knight. Defeat it to obtain a Brass Shield.

details.description: On the larger side for medium-sized shield, the face has been covered in brass. Commonly employed in the Shattering.

items.name: Briar Greatshield
items.acquisition: Dropped by Elemer of the Briar inside the The Shaded Castle .

details.description: Greatshield from a foreign land, used by Elemer of the Briar. Attacks with this armament utilize the iron thorns that have been wound around its frame. Originates from Eochaid, a land of proudly solitary ascetics.

items.name: Buckler
items.acquisition: A small metal roundshield. The bump in the center enables parrying techniques. A well-timed parry can break an enemy's stance, allowing a critical hit. Best suited for those prepared to take the risk to reap their reward.

details.description: A small metal roundshield. The bump in the center enables parrying techniques. A well-timed parry can break an enemy's stance, allowing a critical hit. Best suited for those prepared to take the risk to reap their reward.

items.name: Candletree Wooden Shield
items.acquisition: In the Sage's Cave , in a chest behind an illusory wall.

details.description: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. Thought to represent a surreptitious prophecy of cardinal sin, the lit candle-tree design was forbidden.

items.name: Carian Knight's Shield
items.acquisition: Dropped by Moongrum Carian Knight .

details.description: A teardrop-shaped shield embedded with blue glintstones. Carried by knights who served the Carian royal family. Excels when facing magic or holy attacks. Just who were these knights preparing to fight?

items.name: Carian Thrusting Shield
items.acquisition: Shadow Keep - accessed from the Church District Side. Past the Storehouse site of grace, continue forward you will reach a room where you find a Fire Knight and a few other enemies. The item is right past the Fire Knight and can be found on a corpse under the table.

items.name: Coil Shield
items.acquisition: Located on a body in Volcano Cave, northeast of the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite in Mt. Gelmir. You will need to drop down a hole and then double back.

details.description: An extremely odd shield adorned with a coiled bronze snake. An excellent choice for attention-seekers. This Shield provides an effective defense against poison - after all, how does one poison a poisonous snake?

items.name: Crossed-Tree Towershield
items.acquisition: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Emblazoned with an old, interleaving tree. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel

details.description: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Emblazoned with an old, interleaving tree. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel

items.name: Crucible Hornshield
items.acquisition: Shield. Dropped by the Lesser Crucible Knight patrolling the bridges of the Siofra Aqueduct .

details.description: Greatshield of red-tinged gold carried by Crucible Knights. Features a great horn. An ancient holiness dwells within. The crucible horn skewers foes when performing shield bashes.

items.name: Cuckoo Greatshield
items.acquisition: Metal Greatshield painted with a peering cuckoo. Carried by the enchanted knights sworn to the academy. Boasting high magic damage negation, this shield is used to hunt down mages. Our Enemys is none other then caria itself

details.description: Metal Greatshield painted with a peering cuckoo. Carried by the enchanted knights sworn to the academy. Boasting high magic damage negation, this shield is used to hunt down mages. Our Enemys is none other then caria itself

items.name: Distinguished Greatshield
items.acquisition: Greatshield featuring sumptuous ornamentation used by the scions of great families. Due to their excessive size, these shields were at times seen as the hallmark of little lordlings who were too timid to earn a few nicks and scratches.

details.description: Greatshield featuring sumptuous ornamentation used by the scions of great families. Due to their excessive size, these shields were at times seen as the hallmark of little lordlings who were too timid to earn a few nicks and scratches.

items.name: Dragon Towershield
items.acquisition: Greatshield. Found in a chest in the terrace section of a building far to the bottom of the plaza southeast from the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. This building can be reached by dropping down a series of cliffs east of the plaza until you see the archway leading into the building. Follow the linear path from here to a lower balcony with a ladder. Climb up the ladder to the terrace and look to the east to find the chest by the railings.

details.description: Tower shield engraved with a dragon, symbol of protection. Heavy even among greatshields, it possesses exceptional guarding ability The ancient dragons, who ruled in the prehistoric era before the Erdtree, would protect their lord as a wall of living rock.

items.name: Dragonclaw Shield
items.acquisition: Greatshield that drops from the Draconic Tree Sentinel guarding the path into the capital.

details.description: Greatshield said to have been whittled from the claw of a great, ancient dragon, wielded by grotesque Tree Sentinels who yet serve the Edrtree. Imbued with lightning.

items.name: Dueling Shield
items.acquisition: From the middle area, take the set of stairs to the next floor. Move to the eastern side, climb the wooden platform, and fight the Vulgar Militiamen. Use the stone platforms to reach the other side, the item is against the wall.

items.name: Eclipse Crest Greatshield
items.acquisition: Drops from Mausoleum Knights wielding it in Liurnia of the Lakes (chance to drop, not guaranteed)

details.description: Metal greatshield painted with a sun in eclipse. Carried by the headless mausoleum knights. The eclipsed sun, drained of color, is the protective star of soulless demigods. It aids the mausoleum knights by keeping Destined Death at bay. No skill. This armament has no skill. If the armament in the other hand has a skill, that skill will be used instead.

items.name: Eclipse Crest Heater Shield
items.acquisition: Ledge of the pillar near Tombsward Site of Grace. Can be reached from the ledge near Minor Erdtree

details.description: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The sun in eclipse is said to be the symbol of the Wandering Mausoleum where the soulless demigods slumber.

items.name: Erdtree Greatshield
items.acquisition: Dropped by the Tree Sentinel duo

details.description: Weighty greatshield forged of gold carried by the order of Tree Sentinels, heavily equipped knights. Blessed by an old incantation of protection. The living rampart of the Erdtree, the Tree Sentinels are the standard to which all defenders of the Erdtree aspire.

items.name: Fingerprint Stone Shield
items.acquisition: Subterranean shunning grounds. Past the Altar you Fight mini boss version of Mohg. After defeating him you can roll/attack the altar behind the chest and it will move down out of the way revealing a path. If you have not defeated Morgott, the Omen King a seal will be blocking further progress. Following this path will lead you to the hardest part which is jumping from coffin to coffin to make your way down to the area. NOTE it is slightly above the bottom floor so do not jump off even if you will survive. If you miss that coffin, you will have to start from the beginning of the coffin descend all over to obtain the shield.

details.description: A great stone shield with an intricately carved fingerprint design. One of the heaviest of all greatshields. Part of the tomb of an ancient god, the Readerless Fingers relayed their message through these imprints, said to be the very seeds from which frenzy first sprouted.

items.name: Flame Crest Wooden Shield
items.acquisition: You can loot the Flame Crest Wooden Shield from a naked commoner's corpse inside one of the cabins.

details.description: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. Carried by soldiers of the village that is afflicted by frenzy. The yellow flame is the symbol of the affliction, serving as a warning to those who might approach the village.

items.name: Gilded Greatshield
items.acquisition: Metal greatshield coated with gold. Carried by knights loyal to Godrick. The red tinge in the gold coat mirrors the primordial matter that became the Erdtree. The color of homeward yearning.

details.description: Metal greatshield coated with gold. Carried by knights loyal to Godrick. The red tinge in the gold coat mirrors the primordial matter that became the Erdtree. The color of homeward yearning.

items.name: Gilded Iron Shield
items.acquisition: Shield. Found on a corpse sitting on a grave in the graveyard.

details.description: Small metal roundshield. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation. Though the gold leaf is peeling and the effect is slight, it still boosts holy damage negation.

items.name: Golden Beast Crest Shield
items.acquisition: Greatshield. Dropped by the Grafted Scion upon defeat.

details.description: Shield of dull gold with a beast engraved as its crest. Lighter than most greratshields, and subsequently easier to wield. The beast depicted is Serosh, aged counselor who guides the golden lineage.

items.name: Golden Greatshield
items.acquisition: Oval greatshield made of gold, carried by knights who protect the Royal Capital of Leyndell. Knights of Leyndell are reputed for their sturdiness, exemplified by this shield's exceptional guard capacity.

details.description: Oval greatshield made of gold, carried by knights who protect the Royal Capital of Leyndell. Knights of Leyndell are reputed for their sturdiness, exemplified by this shield's exceptional guard capacity.

items.name: Golden Lion Shield
items.acquisition: Given by Redmane Freyja after you hand her over the Letter for Freyja.

items.name: Great Turtle Shell
items.acquisition: Small Shield. Found on a corpse atop the eastern-most tower of the Castle Morne Ramparts. This area can be reached by using Torrent to jump from the Spiritspring located just east of the Site of Grace nearby.

details.description: Shield fashioned from a great turtle shell. The natural curve helps it contend with foes' attacks. The turtle is a symbol of tirelessness, and this shield boosts stamina recovery speed.

items.name: Haligtree Crest Greatshield
items.acquisition: Metal greatshield depicting the Haligtree with unalloyed gold. Carried by knights who have vowed to serve Miquella's Haligtree. Possesses high holy damage negation. Yet now, with the Haligtree misshapen, this wondrous rendition is a fleeting fantasy.

details.description: Metal greatshield depicting the Haligtree with unalloyed gold. Carried by knights who have vowed to serve Miquella's Haligtree. Possesses high holy damage negation. Yet now, with the Haligtree misshapen, this wondrous rendition is a fleeting fantasy.

items.name: Hawk Crest Wooden Shield
items.acquisition: Medium Shield. Found on a corpse inside the Armory. Requires a Stonesword Key to dispel the fog gate barring entry.

details.description: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. Adorned with a long-forgotten crest of Stormveil, ancient in design.

items.name: Heater Shield
items.acquisition: A medium-sized metal shield, comparatively easy to handle. Metal shields reliably negate physical damage when guarding, a trait which made them highly trusted on the battlefield.

details.description: A medium-sized metal shield, comparatively easy to handle. Metal shields reliably negate physical damage when guarding, a trait which made them highly trusted on the battlefield.

items.name: Horse Crest Wooden Shield
items.acquisition: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. The circular horsehead design evokes a swift gallop.

details.description: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. The circular horsehead design evokes a swift gallop.

items.name: Ice Crest Shield
items.acquisition: Small Shield. Found on a corpse up on a ledge by a jagged stone pillar. This area is in the gardens, jumping up on the rocks from the Teardrop Scarab nearby.

details.description: Small metal roundshield. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation. The ice crest originates from a Carian princess. Thogh the effect is slight, it boosts magic damage negation and resistance to frost.

items.name: Icon Shield
items.acquisition: Found inside a crumbling building. Beware of the enemies inside.

details.description: Greatshield painted with a divine scene; the recipients of a blessed tear from the Erdtree. An item that looks back fondly on the age of plenty. The divine scene acts in and of itself as a sacred invocation; gradually restoring the carrier's HP.

items.name: Inverted Hawk Heater Shield
items.acquisition: Southwest of Siofra River Bank site, up a hill and past 3 enemies on a body.

details.description: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The inverted hawk is the emblem of the company of slaves ordered to explore the Eternal City.

items.name: Inverted Hawk Towershield
items.acquisition: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Features an inverted hawk crest. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

details.description: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Features an inverted hawk crest. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

items.name: Iron Roundshield
items.acquisition: An ordinary small roundshield made of metal. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation. Finely balanced, this shield is easy to use.

details.description: An ordinary small roundshield made of metal. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation. Finely balanced, this shield is easy to use.

items.name: Jellyfish Shield
items.acquisition: On a dead body surrounded by four Jellyfish directly north of the Foot of the Four Belfries Site of Grace.

details.description: The head of a spirit jellyfish, commonly found floating above sacred ground throughout the Lands Between, wielded without modification as a shield. The see-through head is extremely light, but its flesh is supple, providing absolutely no protection from piercing attacks

items.name: Kite Shield
items.acquisition: A standard medium-sized metal shield. Metal shields reliably negate physical damage when guarding, a trait which made them highly trusted on the battlefield.

details.description: A standard medium-sized metal shield. Metal shields reliably negate physical damage when guarding, a trait which made them highly trusted on the battlefield.

items.name: Large Leather Shield
items.acquisition: A round shield covered in leather. One of the larger categories of medium-sized shield. Though its damage negation may be lacking compared to a metal shield, it can handle wider range of attack affinities.

details.description: A round shield covered in leather. One of the larger categories of medium-sized shield. Though its damage negation may be lacking compared to a metal shield, it can handle wider range of attack affinities.

items.name: Lordsworn's Shield
items.acquisition: Wooden tower shield. Lightweightfor a greatshield and easy to handle. Commonly used in the Shattering. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

details.description: Wooden tower shield. Lightweightfor a greatshield and easy to handle. Commonly used in the Shattering. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

items.name: Man-Serpent's Shield
items.acquisition: Small copper dome-shaped roundshield carried by the man-serpents of Mt. Gelmir. Said to have been tempered in lava, it boasts great resistance to fire.

details.description: Small copper dome-shaped roundshield carried by the man-serpents of Mt. Gelmir. Said to have been tempered in lava, it boasts great resistance to fire.

items.name: Manor Towershield
items.acquisition: Greatshield. From the Secluded Cell site of grace, backtrack to the west and up the ramp where the Living Jars are and turn around towards the wooden platform. At the end of the platform, jump onto the ledge on the wall and follow it to the right towards some archways. Past the archways, enter the storage room on the right and head up the stairs to a walkway above. Head to the left towards a larger storage room full of Commoners . You can find the shield under the second set of stairs in this room.

details.description: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Depicts the Roundtable Hold, gathering place of champions. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

items.name: Marred Leather Shield
items.acquisition: Shield. Found on a corpse on a wooden platform, outside the castle walls.

details.description: Leather shield of Stormveil soldiers. Miuch like the castle, it is marred by mottling and thorns. Some say it is the curse of grafting which causes such affliction, while others talk of its root being something altogether more sinister hidden deep within the castle.

items.name: Marred Wooden Shield
items.acquisition: Medium Shield. From the Rampart Tower site of grace, exit onto the walkway with explosive barrels and War Hawks . Kill the War Hawk sitting on the western tower and then jump down the edge onto a ledge below. Follow the ledge north and jump down to the broken pillar below to find the shield.

details.description: "Wooden shield of the Stormveil soldiers. Much like the castle, it is marred by mottling and thorns. Some say it is the curse of grafting which causes such affliction, while others talk of its root being something altogether more sinister hidden deep within the castle."

items.name: One-Eyed Shield
items.acquisition: Shield. Dropped by mini-boss NPC Chief Guardian Arghanthy inside Guardian's Garrison .

details.description: Tricksome shield made from white stone depicting a malformed one-eyed god. The barrel of a firearm pokes through the open mouth. Once worshipped by the giants, this evil deity is believed to have been slain by Queen Marika.

items.name: Perfumer's Shield
items.acquisition: Golden shield used by the perfumers of Leyndell during military service. Made to be thin and light of weight, even those lacking strength can employ this immunity-boosting shield.

details.description: Golden shield used by the perfumers of Leyndell during military service. Made to be thin and light of weight, even those lacking strength can employ this immunity-boosting shield.

items.name: Pillory Shield
items.acquisition: Small Shield. Found inside Gaol Cave .

details.description: Pillory made to punish serious felons, used as a shield. Though made of good, sturdy wood, it is only a makeshift tool and performs as such. Perhaps due to its use as a device with which the guilty were made to endure prolonged suffering, it raises vitality.

items.name: Red Crest Heater Shield
items.acquisition: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The crest symbolizes red wings.

details.description: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The crest symbolizes red wings.

items.name: Red Thorn Roundshield
items.acquisition: A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to use, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield. Its emblem is an ancient red thorn design. Though it isn't much, it boosts fire damage negation.

details.description: A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to use, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield. Its emblem is an ancient red thorn design. Though it isn't much, it boosts fire damage negation.

items.name: Redmane Greatshield
items.acquisition: Greatshield shaped like a fang, featuring the crest of red-maned lion. Carried by the Redmane Knights who fought alongside Radahn.

details.description: Greatshield shaped like a fang, featuring the crest of red-maned lion. Carried by the Redmane Knights who fought alongside Radahn.

items.name: Rickety Shield
items.acquisition: A creaky old wooden shield, circular in shape. Roughly reinforced with vines or some such. There are countless other shields available of better make. This piece of scrap isn't worth the effort of equipping.

details.description: A creaky old wooden shield, circular in shape. Roughly reinforced with vines or some such. There are countless other shields available of better make. This piece of scrap isn't worth the effort of equipping.

items.name: Rift Shield
items.acquisition: Small metal roundshiled depicting a sinister rift. An antiquated charm that glares back at an enemy, it boosts focus.

details.description: Small metal roundshiled depicting a sinister rift. An antiquated charm that glares back at an enemy, it boosts focus.

items.name: Riveted Wooden Shield
items.acquisition: Small wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a true metal shield. The design riveted to the center represents both sword and tree.

details.description: Small wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a true metal shield. The design riveted to the center represents both sword and tree.

items.name: Round Shield
items.acquisition: A wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. Comparatively light for its size, this shield is easy to handle but lacks a true metal shield's ability to negate damage.

details.description: A wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. Comparatively light for its size, this shield is easy to handle but lacks a true metal shield's ability to negate damage.

items.name: Scorpion Kite Shield
items.acquisition: A standard medium-sized metal shield. Highly reputed for its solid build and reliability. Emblazoned with a yellow scorpion, a warning of surprise attacks and sudden strikes.

details.description: A standard medium-sized metal shield. Highly reputed for its solid build and reliability. Emblazoned with a yellow scorpion, a warning of surprise attacks and sudden strikes.

items.name: Scripture Wooden Shield
items.acquisition: A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield. An ancient cipher engraving linesd the circumference. Though it isn't much, it boosts holy damage negation.

details.description: A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield. An ancient cipher engraving linesd the circumference. Though it isn't much, it boosts holy damage negation.

items.name: Serpent Crest Shield
items.acquisition: Obtained by completing the "Incursion" Painting Puzzle.

items.name: Shield of Night
items.acquisition: Shield of Night is a new small shield that can be found in Bonny Gaol . The top level of this gaol can be accessed after using the jar lift near the bridge twice. You need to jump off at the bridge level, activate the switch, and then ride the jar going up. You will find this on the ledge behind the corpse on top of a table.

items.name: Shield of the Guilty
items.acquisition: In the cellar area of the Demi-Human Forest Ruins , before the main building with the Demi-Human Queen mini-boss. You will need to jump over a wall to access the stairs leading into the cellar.

details.description: Shield made to venerate a maiden whose eyes were crushed by Briars of Sin before being reborn in these lands. Venerating the repose of the soul, this shield boosts focus. The briars can be used to attack foes.

items.name: Silver Mirrorshield
items.acquisition: Shield found in the Apostate Derelict church.

details.description: Shield of radiant silver, festooned with amber and carried by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. The shape is said to imitate that of a sacred drop of dew, which inspired the absurd rumor that Loretta herself was an Albinauric.

items.name: Smithscript Shield
items.acquisition: Jump from the opening left to the Lever, and instead of heading forward turn left. There are two Smithing Golems there, one that uses fire. Once defeated, stick to the right and go up to the upper platform using the crumbled column. You will find the item at the end of the hallway. Beware of the fire blob that falls from the ceiling.

items.name: Smoldering Shield
items.acquisition: Small Shield. Found on a corpse on the sitting by some tombstones on the same level as the lava in the Volcano Manor dungeon.

details.description: Small shield made upon Mt. Gelmir forged from uncooling lava. Resists frost with its heat, and can even be used to deal fire damage if wielded as a weapon.

items.name: Spiked Palisade Shield
items.acquisition: On dead body under a Golem, west of Deep Siofra Well, Caelid

details.description: Designed to perform shield bashes, these attacks riddle the enemy with holes, earning it the nickname of "pard shield"

items.name: Spiralhorn Shield
items.acquisition: Found a corpse near Mausoleum Compound. NW of Ruined Labyrinth Site of grace.

details.description: Small shield of antlers arranged in an eddy-like pattern. If used to attack a foe, the shield's antlers inflict blood loss. Once given to a Tarnished warrior who cultivated close ties to the ancestral followers. Though the effect is only slight, it boosts immunity, robustness, and focus.

items.name: Sun Realm Shield
items.acquisition: Shield of honor depicting a city crowned by the sun. It has seen better days. Much like the wear upon the shield, the Seat of the Sun is long faded away.

details.description: Shield of honor depicting a city crowned by the sun. It has seen better days. Much like the wear upon the shield, the Seat of the Sun is long faded away.

items.name: Twinbird Kite Shield
items.acquisition: Medium Shield dropped by nighttime spawn Deathbird near Leyndell's Hermit Merchant's Shack.

details.description: Shield featuring a vividly painted twinbird. The twinbird is said to be the envoy of an outer god, and mother of the Deathbirds. At dwindling levels of HP, this shield slightly boosts both attack and defense.

items.name: Verdigris Greatshield
items.acquisition: Can be looted from Moore's body after defeating him in Enir-Ilim .

items.name: Visage Shield
items.acquisition: Greatshield. Found in a chest in a small room behind the Mad Pumpkin Head duo bosses. Accessible after defeating them.

details.description: Tricksome bronze shield depicting the face of a Fire Giant. Several tongues leap from its open mouth. The dreadful visage and burning flames are designed to remind one of the horror of facing a Fire Giant. In other words, this shield has an instructional function.

items.name: Wolf Crest Shield
items.acquisition: Located inside a storeroom you'll find a treasure chest that has the Wolf Crest Shield. The storeroom is found by following the staircase down instead of heading into the chapel to fight Moonrythil

items.name: Wooden Greatshield
items.acquisition: Greatshield. Found in a guardhouse near the northern section of the castle courtyard.

details.description: Wooden greatshield reinforced with a metal ornamentation. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

items.name: Adula's Moonblade
items.acquisition: Dropped by the Glintstone Dragon Adula in the Cathedral of Manus Celes .

details.description: Sorcery of Adula, the Glintstone Dragon. Conjures a cold magic greatsword, then delivers a sweeping blow that launches a blade-like projectile of frost. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly. Adula, a devourer of sorcerers, was bested by Ranni and subsequently swore a knightly oath to her Dark Moon.

items.name: Ambush Shard
items.acquisition: Weeping Peninsula : Found on a corpse in the underground jail of the Witchbane Ruins .

details.description: One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery. Launches a projectile from a distance removed from the caster, so as to strike the enemy from behind. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly. The Sellian sorcerers were assassins, and it is said that they often hunted their fellows.

items.name: Ancient Death Rancor
items.acquisition: Dropped by the Death Rite Bird in Liurnia of the Lake , to the east of Raya Lucaria Academy at night, south of the Gate Town North site of grace.

details.description: Sorcery of the servants of Death.

items.name: Briars of Punishment
items.acquisition: Sorcery. Found at the leftmost dead tree next to three Lesser Fire Monks just before the long stone bridge with the Golem Archer at the end in the Mountaintops of the Giants region

details.description: An aberrant sorcery discovered by exiled criminals. Theirs are the sorceries most reviled by the academy. Wounds the caster with thorns of sin, sending a trail of bloodthorns running over the ground to impale enemies from below. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly. The guilty, their eyes gouged by thorns, lived in eternal darkness. There, they discovered the blood star.

items.name: Briars of Sin
items.acquisition: Liurnia of the Lakes : Dropped by a mob directly north-west from the Artists Shack. Jump across the rocks and they'll be by a group of fire slugs.

details.description: An aberrant sorcery, discovered along with red glintstone by those exiled to the north for their crimes. Summons large thorns from a whorl of blood shed by one's own hand in penance for sins. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly. The Academy reviles this sorcery, which draws its power from faith.

items.name: Cannon of Haima
items.acquisition: Found in the chest at the top of the Converted Fringe Tower .

details.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Lobs an explosive magic projectile that flies in an arc. Charging enhances potency. Drawn from the conspectus of Haima, the adjudicator of the academy, this sorcery employs might as a means to quell conflict.

items.name: Carian Greatsword
items.acquisition: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family. Conjures a magic greatsword and then delivers a sweeping blow. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly. Armed with this spell, sorcerers gain the strength of knights, their loyalty sworn to the moon.

details.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family. Conjures a magic greatsword and then delivers a sweeping blow. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly. Armed with this spell, sorcerers gain the strength of knights, their loyalty sworn to the moon.

items.name: Carian Phalanx
items.acquisition: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

details.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

items.name: Carian Piercer
items.acquisition: Sorcery . Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab behind the gardens near the east.

details.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

items.name: Carian Retaliation
items.acquisition: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

details.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

items.name: Carian Slicer
items.acquisition: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

details.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

items.name: Cherishing Fingers
items.acquisition: It can be picked up in the graveyard to the west of the Chathedral of Manus Metyr after completing Count Ymir's questline in full.

items.name: Collapsing Stars
items.acquisition: Gravity Sorcery . Looted from a chest inside the War-Dead Catacombs . In the main chamber with 4 staircases, drop into the lower level from the left side to find the chest amongst the ghostly knights fighting each other.

details.description: One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces.

items.name: Comet
items.acquisition: Found behind an Illusory Wall before the Debate Hall Site of Grace.

details.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Fires a great magical comet. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Charging enhances potency. The greatest of the Karolos Conspectus's sorceries, that only a very few sorcerers have ever mastered.

items.name: Comet Azur
items.acquisition: Sorcery . Acquired from Primeval Sorcerer Azur .

details.description: Legendary sorcery devised by Azur, primeval sorcerer. Fires a tremendous comet in a torrent akin to the distant starry expanse, the place said to be the origin of glintstone. Hold to continue releasing the sorcery's power. When Azur glimpsed into the primeval current, he saw darkness. He was left both bewitched and fearful of the abyss.

items.name: Crystal Barrage
items.acquisition: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

items.name: Crystal Burst

details.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Fires a burst of glintstone crystal shards. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Charging increases potency. A sorcery of the Crystal Cadre, a group of sorcerers who pursued the wisdom of stone - the secrets locked in the faint cogitation of the Crystalians.

items.name: Crystal Release
items.acquisition: Sorcery Spell . Dropped by the Crystalians duo bosses inside the Academy Crystal Cave upon their defeat.

details.description: Sorcery of the mysterious Crystalians. Creates a mass of crystal, then shatters it to scour a wide area with a violent rain of crystal shards. This sorcery is used by high-ranking adepts among the Crystalians. Some also call this sorcery "the Crystal Sun."

items.name: Crystal Torrent
items.acquisition: Dropped by Crystalians Trio boss in Sellia Hideaway

details.description: Sorcery of the mysterious Crystalians.

items.name: Eternal Darkness
items.acquisition: Night Sorcery . Found in a jail cell inside the Swamp Lookout Tower .

details.description: Forbidden sorcery of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

items.name: Explosive Ghostflame
items.acquisition: Drops from a Death Rite Bird southeast Apostate Derelict (late game area). It's a clearing in the frozen river, and you must go there at night.

details.description: Sorcery of the servants of Death.

items.name: Fia's Mist
items.acquisition: Obtained by defeating Fia's Champions in Deeproot Depths . After unlocking the Across the Roots Grace, head north and defeat the boss.

details.description: Sorcery of Fia, the Deathbed Companion. Creates a deathly mist before the caster, which inflicts Death blight upon those who enter. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging enhances range of the mist. This sorcery was developed to oppose the Roundtable Hold, and is effective only against the Tarnished.

items.name: Founding Rain of Stars
items.acquisition: Glinstone Sorcery. Found inside a chest at the top of Heretical Rise . You must access the tower by crossing an invisible bridge from the other side of the ravine.

items.name: Freezing Mist
items.acquisition: Sorcery said to have been used by the old snow witch.

items.name: Frozen Armament
items.acquisition: Sorcery . Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in an area behind Caria Manor. This area is accessible after completing the manor and defeating Royal Knight Loretta .

details.description: Sorcery said to have been used by the old snow witch. Enchants armament held in the right hand with frost. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. The snowy crone taught the young Ranni to fear the dark moon as she imparted her cold sorcery.

items.name: Gavel of Haima
items.acquisition: Found in the chest at the top of the Converted Fringe Tower .

details.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Creates a magical greathammer and slams it down. Allows one follow-up attack. Drawn from the scholarly conspectus of Haima, the adjudicator of the academy, this sorcery employs might as a means to quell conflict.

items.name: Gelmir's Fury
items.acquisition: Glintstone Sorcery . Given by Resucant Bernahl after completing three contracts for Tanith at Volcano Manor .

details.description: One of the sorceries developed from the magma of Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Glintblade Phalanx
items.acquisition: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

details.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

items.name: Glintblade Trio
items.acquisition: The Glintblade Trio spell is found by looting it off a corpse. After passing through the iron gate just beyond the chapel in the midpoint of the castle, then dropping off the side of the bridge and climbing up the ladders to the rooftop of the chapel. You can then drop down on the north side of the roof to get to the corpse hanging over a ledge that has the spell.

items.name: Glintstone Arc
items.acquisition: Fires a horizontal arc of magic that spreads outward. This sorcery can be cast repeteadly and while in motion.

details.description: Fires a horizontal arc of magic that spreads outward. This sorcery can be cast repeteadly and while in motion.

items.acquisition: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Fires a magical comet with a trailing tail. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Charging enhances potency. A sorcery of the Karolos Conspectus, the most venerable of the academy.

items.acquisition: Dropped by the Fallingstar Beast .

items.name: Gravity Well
items.acquisition: Dropped by the Monolith Guardian enemy that appears from a gravity portal. The section is near the graveyard and the large rotating lift of Raya Lucaria Academy .

details.description: One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces. Fires a projectile of condensed gravitational force. Those struck by it will be pulled toward the caster. Charging enhances potency. A gravitational technique studied by the young Radahn. His master was an Alabaster Lord with skin of stone.

items.name: Great Glintstone Shard
items.acquisition: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. The glintstone serves as a conduit, launching large magical projectiles at foes. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Those unworthy of the stone crown typically end their brief journey into sorcery here.

items.name: Great Oracular Bubble
items.acquisition: Sorcery . Obtained by defeating the Teardrop Beetle found inside the large stone ruin at the highest level of the Siofra River .

details.description: Sorcery of the claymen who served as priests in the ancient

items.name: Greatblade Phalanx
items.acquisition: Sorcery . Dropped by Bols, Carian Knight inside the Cuckoo's Evergaol .

details.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family. Creates a defensive arch of larger magic glintblades overhead, which automatically attack nearby foes. Used by the enchanted troll knights. They were the comrades of the young Rennala, bound by oath.

items.name: Impenetrable Thorns (spell)
items.acquisition: In Shadow Keep from the Storehouse, Seventh Floor site of grace, cross the center of the storeroom after pulling the lever to rotate the center beams. Once outside, carefully walk off the ledge (you'll see a bat below). You'll find the spell on a corpse

items.name: Loretta's Greatbow
items.acquisition: Sorcery . Dropped by Royal Knight Loretta upon defeat.

details.description: Sorcery used by Royal Knight Loretta. Creates a magic greatbow and fires a great arrow. Charging enhances potency. Hold to keep the great arrow nocked. It is said that the bow was Loretta's favored weapon.

items.name: Loretta's Mastery
items.acquisition: Sorcery. Dropped by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree

details.description: Sorcery used by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. Creates a magic greatbow and fires four great arrows simultaneously. Charging enhances potency. Hold to keep the great arrows nocked. Developed by Loretta after her long, bloody journey to seek out a place where the Albinaurics could live in peace.

items.name: Lucidity
items.acquisition: Dropped by Preceptor Miriam in the secret area of the Carian Study Hall unlocked using the Carian Inverted Statue .

details.description: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

items.name: Magic Downpour
items.acquisition: Magic Downpour is a Sorcery dropped by Preceptor Miriam in the Carian Study Hall.

items.acquisition: An old sorcery of the Carian Royal Family.

items.name: Mantle of Thorns
items.acquisition: This item drops from the Lesser Ulcerated Spirit enemy that emerges beneath the ground, near the large tree.

items.name: Mass of Putrescence
items.acquisition: From the Fissure Waypoint site of grace, head northeast. Just after hopping over the little gap, drop down on the left (north) side and make your way north where you'll find the spell on a corpse.

items.name: Meteorite
items.acquisition: Sorcery . Dropped by the Alabaster Lord upon defeat.

details.description: A glintstone sorcery that draws on gravitational force, used by a great white king with stone skin. Calls small meteorites down from the sky. The meteor shower continues for as long as the sorcery is in effect. It is said that, in the Eternal City, now lost in ruin underground, meteorites held the same import as stars.

items.name: Meteorite of Astel
items.acquisition: Gravity Sorcery. Dropped by Astel, Stars of Darkness , the boss of Yelough Anix Tunnel.

details.description: One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces. Summons a void that emits a hail of meteorites. Hold to continue the effect. A manifestation of the power with which Astel leveled the Eternal City.

items.name: Night Comet
items.acquisition: Night Sorcery spell. Found in a chest in the central section of town. This location is initially sealed by a barrier that can be dispelled by lighting a brazier atop a tower in the southwest of town.

details.description: One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

items.name: Oracle Bubbles
items.acquisition: Can be found by killing one of the Teardrop Scarab on top of a broken statue in the first structure on the right from the Siofra River Deep Wells site of grace. You have to go through some ruins and jump on top of them and follow them over to another side where there is a Teardrop Scarab down below. Kill he Scarab to get this spell

items.name: Ranni's Dark Moon
items.acquisition: Sorcery Spell. Found in a chest at the top of Chelona's Rise after unlocking the tower's seal.

details.description: Legendary sorcery associated with the Carian queen.

items.name: Rennala's Full Moon
items.acquisition: Sorcery associated with the Carian queen. Uses the caster as a vessel to incarnate a full moon, then sends it floating toward foes. The full moon dispels all sorcery that touches it, and temporarily reduces magic damage negation for those it strikes. Queen Rennala encountered this enchanting moon when she was young, and later, it would bewitch the academy.

items.name: Rock Sling
items.acquisition: Gravity Sorcery . Found inside a chest in a cellar in the northern section of the Street of Sages Ruins .

details.description: One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces.

items.name: Roiling Magma
items.acquisition: Sorcery . Found on a corpse inside the Hermit's Shack .

details.description: One of the sorceries developed from the magma of Mt. Gelmir. Fires a lump of condensed magma that explodes a short delay after hitting the target. Charging enhances potency and further delays the explosion. After discovering the ancient hexes of Gelmir, Rykard, son of Queen Rennala, brought them back into practical use as new forms of sorcery.

items.name: Rykard's Rancor
items.acquisition: The terrible power of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.

items.acquisition: Sorcery. Found on a corpse in the second-to-last level of Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel . Inside an opening in the north.

details.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Imbues the ferrule of the caster's staff with magic, then thrusts it into the ground to create a magical shockwave. Allows one follow-up attack. A Stonedigger sorcery used by the glintstone miners of the crystal tunnel. At the academy, use of this sorcery was a stigma that marked out failed scholars.

items.name: Shattering Crystal
items.acquisition: Looted off a corpse on the second floor, west side, of the Church of the Cuckoo in Raya Lucaria Academy . The only way to reach this is going through the broken glass window of the church via the rooftops

details.description: Sorcery of the mysterious Crystalians. Creates a mass of crystal, then shatters it in a forward burst. Charging enhances potency. The Crystalians are inorganic beings, yet they live. They cleave close to the ideals of the primeval current, and as such, they are revered guests of the sorcerers.

items.name: Star Shower
items.acquisition: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Fires six magic shooting stars that pursue the target. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging enhances potency. The most difficult to master of the Olivinus Conspectus sorceries.

details.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Fires six magic shooting stars that pursue the target. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging enhances potency. The most difficult to master of the Olivinus Conspectus sorceries.

items.name: Starlight
items.acquisition: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

details.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

items.name: Stars of Ruin
items.acquisition: Given by Master Lusat when interacted with inside the Sellia Hideaway behind an arcane ward in the second pit. Requires the Sellian Sealbreaker to get through arcane ward (Acquired during Sorceress Sellen Questline).

details.description: Legendary sorcery devised by Lusat, primeval sorcerers.

items.name: Swift Glintstone Shard
items.acquisition: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. The glintstone serves as a conduit, launching swift magical projectiles at foes. This sorcery can be used without delay after performing another action. Those unworthy of the stone crown typically end their brief journey into sorcery here.

details.description: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. The glintstone serves as a conduit, launching swift magical projectiles at foes. This sorcery can be used without delay after performing another action. Those unworthy of the stone crown typically end their brief journey into sorcery here.

items.name: Terra Magica
items.acquisition: Sorcery . Found at the top of a tower in the middle of the Raya Lucaria Academy. This area is accessed by completing the Academy Crystal Cave dungeon and taking the lift behind the boss' door.

items.name: Thops's Barrier
items.acquisition: The lifelong pursuit of Thops the Bluntstone.

details.description: The lifelong pursuit of Thops the Bluntstone.

items.name: Tibia's Summons
items.acquisition: Drops from the Tibia Mariner at Wyndham Ruins .

details.description: Sorcery of the servants of Death. Summons a group of Those Lost in Death. Three skeletons will appear some distance from the caster and attack foes before disappearing. The dead have long been left to wander; what they need is leadership.

items.name: Unseen Blade
items.acquisition: Found at the top of Mirage Rise. Can be found alongside Unseen Form

details.description: One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery. Enchants armament held in right hand, making it completely invisible. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Used by Sellian assassins to present themselves as unarmed sorcerers.

items.name: Unseen Form
items.acquisition: Found at the top of Mirage Rise. Can be found alongside Unseen Blade

details.description: One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery. Makes the caster semi-invisible. While on horseback, effect extends to cover the mount. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. The Sellian assassins considered every option that aided their dirty work.

items.name: Zamor Ice Storm
items.acquisition: Snow Witch Sorcery . Found on a corpse in the southern section of the Zamor Ruins , by a stone archway.

details.description: Ice sorcery of the Town of Zamor.

items.name: Albinauric Ashes
items.acquisition: Found on a corpse in the graveyard area east of Caria Manor . This area is accessible only after completing the manor and defeating Royal Knight Loretta .

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two Albinaurics.

items.name: Ancestral Follower Ashes
items.acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Obtained from defeating the Ancestor Spirit in Siofra River .

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of an ancestral follower.

items.name: Ancient Dragon Florissax
items.acquisition: WARNING: DOING THIS WILL LOCK YOU OUT OF THE PRIESTESS HEART (The one that buffs dragon cult incantations, You can get a different dragon transformations stone called ''Rock Heart'' from another place that buffs dragon communion spells instead.) Find Thiollier near Pillar Path Cross (after the bridge and on your way to dragon's pit, the leftmost/eastmost path leading to a small swamp on map). Exhaust her dialogue. Just to clarify that the road doesn't really lead to the swamp (which is down below the cliff), it just looks like so on the map) Go back to the blessing outside Belurat and talk toMoore. He will give you an item for Thiollier. Deliver the item to Thiollier and exhaust her dialogue again to obtain another item. Give the item to the dragon priestess (near Grand Altar of Dragon Communion) at night, this will put her to sleep. Wait for a few rounds and she will have woken up, exhaust her dialogue. Kill Bayle the Dread. Remember to summon Igon (his sign is within the arena, to the left after you enter the mist) Go to the Altar and talk to her, confess to putting her to sleep and accept to become her lord. collect her ash.

items.name: Ancient Dragon Knight Kristoff
items.acquisition: Spirit Ash Summon. Dropped by the Ancient Hero of Zamor found in the Sainted Hero's Grave .

items.name: Archer Ashes
items.acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Found on a corpse tucked behind a building in Nokstella, Eternal City .

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon three archer spirits.

items.name: Avionette Soldier Ashes
items.acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Located on a corpse after taking the rotating lift down in Raya Lucaria Academy.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two avionette soldiers. Spirits of marionette soldiers with avian features that were created to serve a sorcerer. Equipped with long-hafted scythes, they also attack from the skies by lobbing fire pots. Can sometimes malfunction when damaged.
details.effect: Summon the spirits of two avionette soldiers

items.name: Azula Beastman Ashes
items.acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Found at the bottom level of the Dragon Temple accessed by turning around to face west from the Site of Grace and then jumping down the crumbled ledges below. From here, head into the central archway and then turn right to find a crypt with several sarcophagi. The ashes can be found on the sarcophagus in the back.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two Azula beastmen. Spirits of beastmen from doomed Farum Azula, the slowly crumbling ruins in the skies. These ruins are said to be the remains of a giant mausoleum enshrining an ancient dragon, guarded by chosen beastmen who wield weapons clad in lightning.

items.name: Banished Knight Engvall
items.acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by the boss of Murkwater Catacombs: Grave Warden Duelist, after Patch 1.03.

items.name: Banished Knight Oleg
items.acquisition: This Spirit is obtained after Defeating the Ulcerated Tree Sprit located within Fringefolk Hero's Grave .

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Oleg, the Banished Knight.

items.name: Battlemage Hugues (Spirit Ash)
items.acquisition: Boss of Sellia Evergaol , drops Battlemage Hugues Ashes

items.name: Bigmouth Imp Ashes
items.acquisition: The Bigmouth Imp Ashes can be found inside a treasure chest at the Darklight Catacombs location.

items.name: Black Knife Tiche
items.acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader upon defeat.

details.description: Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of Black Knife Tiche.
details.effect: Summons spirit of Black Knife Tiche

items.name: Black Knight Captain Huw
items.acquisition: Scorpion River Catacombs . Past the first ceiling with the falling spikes, reach the Yellow Fulgurbloom and turn right, you will see x2 Messmer Soldiers and a Black Knight. Between both of you, there is another ceiling with spikes, be mindful when engaging in combat. Once those enemies are defeated, head to the coffin at the end to find the Spirit Ashes.

items.name: Black Knight Commander Andreas
items.acquisition: It's located by following the Fog Rift Catacombs past a black knight guarded by 3 Messmer Soldiers and then jumping on to the top of the spike trap the falls from the ceiling and then crossing it into a corridor. The Spirit Ashes is lying in a coffin.

items.name: Blackflame Monk Amon
items.acquisition: Spirit Ash. Dropped by the Stray Mimic Tear boss found in the secret catacombs underneath the Hidden Path to the Haligtree .

items.name: Bloodfiend Hexer's Ashes
items.acquisition: Dropped by the Chief Bloodfiend at Rivermouth Cave.

items.name: Bloodhound Knight Floh
items.acquisition: Dropped by the Red Wolf of the Champion

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Floh, the Bloodhound Knight.
details.effect: Summons spirit of Bloodhound Knight Floh

items.name: Clayman Ashes
items.acquisition: Located on a corpse in Ainsel River, Lake of Liurnia which is south from the Uhl Palace Ruins. Easiest way to reach these is ashes is while doing Ranni's questline (the portal you enter from Renna's Rise will take you near the ashes). After entering Ainsel River proceed south along the tunnel entering into the next main room with enemies, proceed southwest while hugging the edge until you can find some Clayman walking about, after disposing them look for the corpse near the corner of the area by the top of a waterfall.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two claymen. Bowed with age, these spirits are sluggish but hard to stagger. The warped remains of priests who searched for revelation in service of the ancient dynasty, they employ two sorceries that produce smaller and larger bubbles.

items.name: Cleanrot Knight Finlay
items.acquisition: Located in a chest protected by a knight in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree . From the Prayer Room site of grace, head straight down a few sets of stairs until you reach a small landing where two crossbow guards are stationed above. Jump over the railing on the landing onto the angled brace, then jump onto the platform with the gazebo. The ashes are in a chest in a room next to the gazebo.

items.name: Crystalian Ashes
items.acquisition: Located in a chest protected by three masked magic users in a room that is located down a pathway up the purple crystals next to the Trio Putrid Crystallin's (bosses) boss door in�� Sellia Hideaway .

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Crystalian. Spirit that wields round crystalline blades, both big and small. Its sturdy body, itself hewn from crystal long ago, is hard enough to blunt its opponent's blades, but blows from bludgeoning weapons can shatter it easily.

items.name: Curseblade Meera
items.acquisition: This item is obtained as a reward for defeating Curseblade Smith found within Bonny Gaol .

items.name: Demi-Human Ashes
items.acquisition: Found within Impaler's Catacombs . Dropped by Erdtree Burial Watchdog

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of five demi-humans.

items.name: Demi-Human Swordsman Yosh
items.acquisition: This spirit ash drops from the Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze boss located within the depths of the Belurat Gaol .

items.name: Depraved Perfumer Carmaan
items.acquisition: Spirit Ash. Found behind a hidden room in the secret passageway of Volcano Manor . After heading in the secret passage, before going downstairs, turn left and go through the hallway full of snails. At the dead end where you get the cookbook, smack the left wall to reveal the hidden room.

items.name: Divine Bird Warrior Ornis
items.acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Climb the crumbled structure of the building in Temple Town Ruins which can only be reachbed by jumping on the Spiritspring. Once on top, turn right and jump to the platform. Move forward inside the cave, turn left and enter the room with a chest containing this item.

items.name: Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Puppet
items.acquisition: One of Seluvis's favorite puppets. Use to summon the spirit of Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Spirit of a handsome archer who dressed in the style of a man. Called the Silent Hunter by some, she fires St. Trina's arrows from her shortbow. Dolores once belonged to the Roundtable Hold, where she was both a critic and a friend of Gideon the All-Knowing. It was because of her that he and Seluvis went their separate ways.

details.description: One of Seluvis's favorite puppets. Use to summon the spirit of Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Spirit of a handsome archer who dressed in the style of a man.
