It was because of her that he and Seluvis went their separate ways.
details.effect: Summons spirit of Solores the Sleeping Arrow

items.name: Dung Eater Puppet
items.acquisition: One of Seluvis's puppets. Use to summon the spirit of the Dung Eater. Spirit of a man who murdered thousands and defiled their corpses with the Seedbed Curse. Wields a spine greatsword and hurls curses. The Dung Eater despaired at how he met his end. How hideous and sinister this puppet is, and yet, its utter despair invites one to care for it.

details.description: One of Seluvis's puppets. Use to summon the spirit of the Dung Eater. Spirit of a man who murdered thousands and defiled their corpses with the Seedbed Curse. Wields a spine greatsword and hurls curses. The Dung Eater despaired at how he met his end. How hideous and sinister this puppet is, and yet, its utter despair invites one to care for it.
details.effect: Summons spirit of the Dung Eater

items.name: Fanged Imp Ashes
items.acquisition: Ashes remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon two fanged imp spirits.

details.description: Ashes remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon two fanged imp spirits.

items.name: Finger Maiden Therolina Puppet
items.acquisition: Spirit Ashes . Can be bought from a body in Seluvis's Rise for Starlight Shards after reaching the end of Ranni's questline.

details.description: One of Seluvis's puppets.
details.effect: Summons spirit of Finger Maiden Therolina

items.name: Fingercreeper Ashes
items.acquisition: Go east from Fingerstone hill Grace. You'll find a two fingers emote but continue onward until you find 2 leech-men as well as 2 hands buried in the ground. Soon after those hands there's an opening in the ground by the cliff guarded by many fingercreepers. Drop down and face against a GIANT hand, defeat it (fire works well) and grab the spirit ashes.

items.name: Fire Knight Hilde
items.acquisition: Shadow Keep - accessed from the Church District Side. From the gear in which you found Wrath from Afar, jump towards the next platform and head to the ladder on the left. Climb it up. Once at the top, take the wooden beam on your left and turn right towards the lift. Activate the lift but quickly return to the platform. Another lift will appear do the same, and jump on the first lift Roof. Stay there until it stops. Jump across the platform to reach the corpse on the other side and loot the Spirit Ash.

items.name: Fire Knight Queelign
items.acquisition: Use Iris of Grace on the NPC in the Prayer Room to receive the Spirit Ash Fire Knight Queelign .

items.name: Fire Monk Ashes
items.acquisition: Spirit Ash. Found inside the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs : Descend the first lift you find and then step on the plate again to send it back up. When fully raised, there is a second platform on the lift that will take you to the lowest levels of the catacombs. Continue through this path past two frost breath traps. The spell is found in a chest behind the second trap.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Fire Monk. Spirit of a stout monk who monitored the Giants' Flame. Versed in fire incantations, and himself steeled against fire. Though he was charged with keeping watch over the Flame, after many years of solemn duty, he has succumbed to its allure.

items.name: Giant Rat Ashes
items.acquisition: Can be found in a wooden shack located left of the windwill.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three giant rats.

items.name: Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes
items.acquisition: Inside Road's End Catacombs. Defeat the Spirit-Caller Snail to obtain.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a glintstone sorcerer.

items.name: Godrick Soldier Ashes
items.acquisition: Found at the Cemetery at the west of Stormhill that is filled with Spirit Jellyfish, next to a grave. Check both sides of each grave to find it.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two of Godrick's soldiers.

items.name: Gravebird Ashes
items.acquisition: Use the spiritspring to reach the area, you'll find this item surrounded by gravestones.

items.name: Greatshield Soldier Ashes
items.acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Found on a corpse in a graveyard in Nokron, Eternal City guarded by a Fallen Hawk .

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon five greatshield soldier spirits.

items.name: Haligtree Soldier Ashes
items.acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Found under a large decorative chalice in the northern edge of the main city proper.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of four Haligtree soldiers. Spirits of common soldiers who carry the sacred light. When weakened, they explode to deliver a last-ditch attack. This was the bitter revelation discovered by the desperate soldiers who awaited the return of their lord to the rotted Haligtree. May the flash of our deaths guide Miquella's return.

items.name: Horned Warrior Ashes
items.acquisition: After jumping down the broken staircase, head up and enter the room, you'll find this on a corpse on the left side.

items.name: Inquisitor Ashes
items.acquisition: They can be found on a corpse in Enir-Ilim, beneath the second to last enemy before reaching the Spiral Rise site of grace (coming from First Rise site of grace).

items.name: Jarwight Puppet
items.acquisition: Spirit Ashes . Can be bought from a body in Seluvis's Rise for Starlight Shards after reaching the end of Ranni's questline.

details.description: One of Seluvis' puppets. Use to summon the spirit of a jarwight.

items.name: Jolán and Anna
items.acquisition: Found at the very top of Rabbath's Rise, only accessible by carefully dropping down from the Hinterlands area above. You can only obtain this Ashes if you progressed Count Ymir's questline and finished Jolan's invasion, then gave her the IRIS OF GRACE to obtain her Spirit Ashes. Interact with the puppet in this room and you can merge Jolan and Anna to create this spirit ash. You can interact again to undo the merge.

items.name: Kaiden Sellsword Ashes
items.acquisition: Found within Cliffbottom Catacombs . Dropped by Erdtree Burial Watchdog.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.Use to summon the spirit of a Kaiden sellsword.

items.name: Kindred of Rot Ashes
items.acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by the Cemetery Shade in the Caelid Catacombs .

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon a spirit of the Kindred of Rot. This spirit takes the form of a crawling pest, its chitinous body making a dry rustling sound. Attacks enemies by secreting sticky threads. The Kindred of Rot are the servants of the Goddess of Rot—servants that have been forsaken.

items.name: Land Squirt Ashes
items.acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Found at a grave with several groups of land squirts nearby on the east shore of Liurnia Lake. To reach it, start at the Gate Town Bridge site of grace, go down to ground level, and simply travel north along the shore.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three land squirts Summoning consumes HP rather than FP. These spirits appear some distance from the summoner. The firm, fleshy tubes of the creatures remain rooted to the spot, spraying poisonous liquid over their surroundings

items.name: Latenna the Albinauric (Spirit Ash)
items.acquisition: In order for Latenna to be friendly and become a spirit, one has to have the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right) , give to the player by Albus at the Village of the Albinaurics .

items.name: Leyndell Soldier Ashes
items.acquisition: Found inside the Sainted Hero's Grave . After a floor collapsed, make your way back up and retrieve from a corpse.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two Leyndell soldiers. Spirits of soldiers each equipped with a spear and greatshield. The soldiers of Leyndell fight their battles defensively. During the Shattering, they were the ramparts that fortified the royal capital.

items.name: Lhutel the Headless
items.acquisition: Dropped by the Cemetery Shade inside the Tombsward Catacombs

details.description: Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of Lhutel the Headless.
details.effect: Summons spirit of Lhutel the Headless

items.name: Lone Wolf Ashes
items.acquisition: Given to players by Renna at the Church of Elleh in Limgrave. Return to the Church after getting the ability to summon your Spectral Steed from Melina . You will find Renna sitting by the ruins of the church.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three lone wolves.

items.name: Mad Pumpkin Head Ashes
items.acquisition: Spirit Summon Ash. Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog duo bosses within the Minor Erdtree Catacombs .

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a mad pumpkin head. Spirit of a mad soldier with a large, brawny physique. Though he has stifled his panic within the dark confines of his helmet, he rampages as if driven mad when agitated by bloodshed or the humming of insects. This mad soldier is all that is left of a broken gladiator.
details.effect: Summon the spirit of a mad pumpkin head

items.name: Man-Fly Ashes
items.acquisition: Spirit Ashes looted from a grub corpse in Village of the Flies. Can only be accessed by going down the river from Shadow Keep and unlocking the Recluses River Downstream site of grace area. The Ashes are found on the top part of the village, guarded by two shadow casters and several man-fly enemies.

items.name: Man-Serpent Ashes
items.acquisition: Spirit Ash. Found on an altar protected by some enemies in Volcano Manor's dungeon.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a man-serpent. Spirit of a deformed man-serpent that wields a whip of magma. It is said that long ago, the elder serpent that dwelled on Mt. Gelmir devoured a demigod, and the birth of the man-serpents followed.

items.name: Marionette Soldier Ashes
items.acquisition: When you reach the graveyard section, as you cross the other side of the bridge, make a hard left and drop down to find a path that curves to where the Marionette Soldiers are, kill the two soldiers and then loot the corpse that is hanging by the ledge to find this item.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two marionette soldiers.

items.name: Mausoleum Soldier Ashes
items.acquisition: Found at the far north cliff, by breaking a petrified tree.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of five mausoleum soldiers. Spirits of five headless soldiers who confound foes by disappearing and reappearing at will. The mausoleum is where the bodies of soulless demigods are lain to rest, and these soldiers followed their masters into Death by severing their own heads from their bodies.

items.name: Messmer Soldier Ashes
items.acquisition: From the area where you fight the Omenkiller, cross the whole room to the other side, it will lead outside, You will find the spirit ashes near a grave.

items.name: Mimic Tear Ashes
items.acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Found in a chest locked behind an imp statue door in Nokron, Eternal City .

details.description: Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of a mimic tear. Summoning consumes HP rather than FP.

items.name: Miranda Sprout Ashes
items.acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Found behind a hidden wall in Caelid Catacombs . You must attack a wall to the right of the staircase to reveal a path to the ashes.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of five miranda sprouts. Summoning consumes HP rather than FP. Spirits of sweet little miranda flowers, carnivorous blossoms that feed upon human flesh. They creep slowly, scattering toxic pollen. Vulnerable to fire—do take care of the little darlings

items.name: Nepheli Loux Puppet
items.acquisition: One of Seluvis's favorite puppets. Use to summon the spirit of Nepheli Loux. Puppet of a warrior who was betrayed by her pure heart. Wields a Stormhawk Axe in both hands and uses the Thunderstorm skill. A diamond in the rough, deserving of special care lest its potential be squandered. Nepheli Loux truly was a warrior.

details.description: One of Seluvis's favorite puppets. Use to summon the spirit of Nepheli Loux. Puppet of a warrior who was betrayed by her pure heart. Wields a Stormhawk Axe in both hands and uses the Thunderstorm skill. A diamond in the rough, deserving of special care lest its potential be squandered. Nepheli Loux truly was a warrior.

items.name: Nightmaiden & Swordstress Puppets
items.acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Found in a chest locked behind an imp statue in Nokstella, Eternal City protected by two Swordstresses .

items.name: Noble Sorcerer Ashes
items.acquisition: Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog inside the Stormfoot Catacombs .

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a noble sorcerer. Spirit of a nobleman who once asked to be given a place at Raya Lucaria to learn glintstone sorceries. His talents were insufficient to be worthy of donning the stone crown, however, and he is only capable ofusing the most rudimentary sorcery.

items.name: Nomad Ashes
items.acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Found on a corpse in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds beneath the capital. This is in a large, multi-level section in the east.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a nomad.

items.name: Omenkiller Rollo
items.acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by the Fell Twins bosses.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Omenkiller Rollo.

items.name: Oracle Envoy Ashes
items.acquisition: Miquella's Haligtree near Haligtree Town site of grace

details.description: Ashen Remains in which spirits yet dwell.

items.name: Page Ashes
items.acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Found in Cliffbottom Catacombs, in an altar right before you pull the lever to open the Boss Door.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a page.

items.name: Perfumer Tricia
items.acquisition: Optional Duo Boss Fight. Perfumer Tricia is found at the end of the Unsightly Catacombs and is accompanied by a Misbegotten Warrior.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Tricia, the perfumer.

items.name: Putrid Corpse Ashes
items.acquisition: Spirit Ash. Dropped by the boss of Gaol Cave : Frenzied Duelist

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of four putrid corpses.

items.name: Radahn Soldier Ashes
items.acquisition: Spirit Ashes found within War-Dead Catacombs Go up the stairs to the back right of the first room and go left. Past the archer at the end of the hall turn right, turning right again at the end of that hall past the greatsword knight. Jump through the window to the right near the end of this hall. Go left up the stairs and the ashes will be in a room in front of you behind a knight.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two of Radahn's soldiers.

items.name: Raya Lucaria Soldier Ashes
items.acquisition: Found inside a chest at the end of the Road's End Catacombs . Hit the final wall to dispel the illusion, allowing you to move on. Beware of the many Imps in the final room.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three Raya Lucaria soldiers.
details.effect: Summons three Raya Lucaria soldier spirits

items.name: Redmane Knight Ogha
items.acquisition: Dropped by the Putrid Tree Spirit in the War-Dead Catacombs located in eastern Caelid. To find the entrance of the catacombs, travel to the site of grace that appears after defeating Starcourge Radahn and proceed to head north until you have reached the upper most corner of the area, you'll be able to see the small door along the cliffside.

details.description: Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of Ogha, the Redmane Knight. Spirit of a mighty knight versed in the use of a greatbow. A valiant warrior who will attack immediately after being summoned. The longest-serving member of the Redmane Knights, Ogha studied techniques to manipulate gravity alongside Radahn. May use a rain of gravitational arrows in response to a war cry, but only once.
details.effect: Summons spirit of Redmane Knight Ogha

items.name: Rotten Stray Ashes
items.acquisition: Found on a body within a broken building, there is a Rotten Stray nearby.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a rotten stray. Spirit of a stray dog corrupted by the scarlet rot.  Through it is only a small creature, it is as violent as it is nimble, and its fangs fester with poisonous rot

items.name: Skeletal Bandit Ashes
items.acquisition: Spirit Ash that drops from the Tibia Mariner

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of a skeletal bandit.

items.name: Skeletal Militiaman Ashes
items.acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Obtained when defeating the Tibia Mariner in Summonwater Village .

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two skeletal militiamen.

items.name: Soldjars of Fortune Ashes
items.acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by the Grave Warden Duelist boss at the end of the Auriza Side Tomb .

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three little living jars. Summoning consumes HP rather than FP. These reckless spirits sacrifice themselves to vanquish their summoner's foes, and explode upon death. Though their bravery is admirable, their explosions can harm friend as well as foe, and they will also immediately explode on contact with fire. "Tell the others—tell them how brightly a fire jar burns."
details.effect: Summons three little living jar spirits

items.name: Spider Scorpion Ashes
items.acquisition: In the area where the spider-scorpion hangs from a ceiling and there are a bunch of items on the ground. One of them is this.

items.name: Spirit Jellyfish Ashes
items.acquisition: Obtained from Roderika form Stormhill Shack while pursuing her questline.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon a spirit jellyfish.

items.name: Stormhawk Deenh
items.acquisition: Spirit Ash. Found in a chest on the wooden walkway above the southern wing's main room. Accessible from where The Stormhawk King key item is found.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Deenh the Stormhawk.

items.name: Swordhand of Night Jolán
items.acquisition: Jolan is a Knight of Night that serves Count Ymir. After completing Ymir's questline, give Jolan the Eye of Occulation to receive the Sword of Night , or the Iris of Grace to receive Swordhand of Night Jolan Spirit Ashes. Note: if you don't get these spirit ashes, you cannot get the "Jolan and Anna" spirit ashes either.

items.name: Taylew the Golem Smith
items.acquisition: Return to the platform in the middle that you have moved with the lever, and head up. Jump to the left once you are near the top. Take the stairs up in the area, and interact with the furnace to receive the Spirit Ashes along with an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

items.name: Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes
items.acquisition: Dropped by the Cemetery Shade boss of the Black Knife Catacombs

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Twinsage sorcerer.

items.name: Vulgar Militia Ashes
items.acquisition: Spirit Ashes found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave : In the large Chariot Hall where two Chariots are running side by side with a short delay between them, head all the way down to the large pit behind some pillars. Looking down, you can find several wooden beams you can drop down onto. Navigate your way across the beams, heading north to find a hidden area on the right with a statue. Head into the corridor behind the statue and to the right to access a small room where a corpse holding the ashes can be found.

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three vulgar militiamen. Spirits of the vulgar militia who wield long-hafted, serrated hatchets. These brutal weapons are particularly effective at causing blood loss to opponents. In the Lands Between, the small were scorned, and so they formed their vulgar militia as a means to make a living, albeit in ignominy.

items.name: Wandering Noble Ashes
items.acquisition: Located on a corpse that is resting against a stone coffin in the Stormfoot Catacombs in Limgrave. Proceed through the catacombs as normal until reaching a ladder that is going up, once you've reached the top continue forward past some Jade Goblins until reaching a dead end room that is being guarded by two Jade Goblins, the corpse resting against the stone coffin will hold the ashes

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of five wandering nobles.

items.name: Warhawk Ashes
items.acquisition: Rewarded upon finding the location Prophecy Painting depicts. The location is north of the Church of Pilgrimage .

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a warhawk. Spirit of a Stormveil warhawk, the talons of which have been sliced off so that razor-fine swords could be grafted in their place. With its lord vanquished, and its wings wounded, the hawk perished as it solemnly gazed at its former home. The storm is a warhawk's cradle.

items.name: Winged Misbegotten Ashes
items.acquisition: Spirit Ash. Found on a corpse in a pit inside the Unsightly Catacombs .

details.description: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a winged misbegotten.

items.name: Stonesword Key #1
items.acquisition: Stonesword Key . Found on a corpse partially hanging from a wooden platform. The platform can be found by walking down west from the nearby Site of Grace and back onto a section of the castle. Look to the left edge.

items.name: Stonesword Key #2
items.acquisition: Stonesword Key . Found on a corpse sitting in a chair at the northern edge of the plateau, overlooking the sea.

items.name: Stonesword Key #3
items.acquisition: Stoneword Key Found on the ground by a wooden barricade at the southern end of the Bridge of Sacrifice .

items.name: Stonesword Key #4
items.acquisition: Held by a corpse within Fringefolk Hero's Grave . Look for the body on a platform above the chariot.

items.name: Stonesword Key #5
items.acquisition: Stoneword Key Found inside a small room, protected by a Rat.

items.name: Stonesword Key #6
items.acquisition: Stoneword Key found at Stormhill Shack next to the Site of Grace.

items.name: Stonesword Key #7
items.acquisition: Found within the Gaol Cave , near Wakizashi .

items.name: Stonesword Key #8
items.acquisition: Stonesword Key . Found on a corpse inside a building section with a broken roof. Accessed from the very top of the Rampart Tower with careful platforming.

items.name: Stonesword Key #9
items.acquisition: Held by a corpse above the Grafted Scion .

items.name: Stonesword Key #10
items.acquisition: At Stormveil Castle's Underground Crypt.

items.name: Stonesword Key #11
items.acquisition: Stonesword Key . Found on a corpse sitting high above on a ledge connecting two buildings. Accessible by jumping across the rooftops.

items.name: Stonesword Key #12
items.acquisition: On top of a large rock with bodies and chairs on top.

items.name: Stonesword Key #13
items.acquisition: Stonesword Key. Found on a body in the ravine south of the Deep Siofra Well , near the cliff.

items.name: Stonesword Key #14
items.acquisition: Stonesword Key . Found on a corpse on a ledge on the outside of the tower. Accessible via careful platforming.

items.name: Stonesword Key #15
items.acquisition: Found within a chest, in one of the small islands next to the Raya Lucaria Academy .

items.name: Stonesword Key #16
items.acquisition: Found in Raya Lucaria through an Illusory Wall just before the Site of Grace at Debate Parlor.

items.name: Stonesword Key #17
items.acquisition: Looted on a fountain, center of the academy's courtyard.

items.name: Stonesword Key #18
items.acquisition: Found inside the Academy Crystal Cave . Head to the left to where the Sages are, and enter the next room. You will find it inside a cage.

items.name: Stonesword Key #19
items.acquisition: Held by a sitting corpse outside the Academy , beneath the bridge.

items.name: Stonesword Key #20
items.acquisition: Key Item. Found on a body sitting on a chair, in the open field, north from Ainsel River Well.

items.name: Stonesword Key #21
items.acquisition: Key Item. Found on a corpse in a semi-open area in the back of the temple to the east. From the Dragon Temple site of grace, head inside the temple and turn right then down the stairs on the left. Take another right when you can and then another left into a long hallway. The said area is to the left at the end of this hallway and the corpse can be found in the crumbled edge past the pillars.

items.name: Stonesword Key #22
items.acquisition: Key Item. Found atop the Frenzied Flame Village outer walls.

items.name: Stonesword Key #23
items.acquisition: Crafting Material. Three can be looted from a corpse on the Western Walls of Caria Manor. It is guarded by a Giant Crab.This area can only be reached by dropping down from Three Sisters after defeating the main boss, and finding the path from the south-west of the chapel's rooftop.

items.name: Stonesword Key #24
items.acquisition: Stonesword Key. One found in the Sealed Tunnel . At the bottom of the chamber with the lift, dispel two illusory walls to the south. In the next chamber, walk on the overgrown root and jump to the right onto the wooden platform below, right in front of a tunnel. Follow the tunnel to find the key on a corpse.

items.name: Stonesword Key #25
items.acquisition: Found on a corpse located on a camp northeast from the Grand Lift of Dectus.

items.name: Stonesword Key #26
items.acquisition: Found on a corpse below West Capital Rampart Site of Grace . Drop down, jump on petrified dragon foot onto barn, then into 2nd story wooden building.

items.name: Stonesword Key #27
items.acquisition: On top of a gazebo, held by a corpse.

items.name: Stonesword Key #28
items.acquisition: Found on a small shack past the Fortified Manor, west of the Lower Capital Chuch Site of Grace. You have to jump around in order to reach it. There is a Smithing Stone (6) on that same shack.

items.name: Stonesword Key #29
items.acquisition: Found in front of a grave, there are three enemies in the vicinity

items.name: Stonesword Key #30
items.acquisition: Found in the lower platform, open a door and find it inside the chest.

items.name: Stonesword Key #31
items.acquisition: On the rooftop of one of the buildings, held by a corpse.

items.name: Stonesword Key #32
items.acquisition: Stonesword Key . One found in the Aqueducts section of the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds . From the Underground Roadside site of grace, head northeast and drop down into an opening in the ground to enter the aqueducts. From here, head northwest past the rats and look for a tunnel on the right. Follow this tunnel until you see slimes and drop into the hole in front of them. Follow the path all the way to the end to grab the key on a corpse.

items.name: Stonesword Key #33
items.acquisition: At Auriza Hero's Grave , one can be found while passing the third part of the giant chariots, on a small platform in the middle.

items.name: Stonesword Key #34
items.acquisition: Stonesword Key. One can be found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave : In the first Chariot Hall, drop down the openings on either side just before the second ramp. In the room below, head west and up the steps then turn right to reach a second Chariot hall where two chariots are running side by side with a short delay between them. As you exit into this hall, turn left to find the key on a corpse between two ramps.

items.name: Stonesword Key #35
items.acquisition: Held by a Noble's sitting corpse.

items.name: Stonesword Key #36
items.acquisition: Can be found behind an illusory wall, in the same room where you fight an Axe Skeleton, within Sage's Cave

items.name: Stonesword Key #37
items.acquisition: Found at the exit of Rya's room, reachable through the window.

items.name: Stonesword Key #38
items.acquisition: Held by a corpse lying on the stairs within the Volcano Manor area.

items.name: Stonesword Key #39
items.acquisition: Key Item. Found under a large burnt tree near the cliffs.

items.name: Stonesword Key #40
items.acquisition: Found on a body on a stone ledge, reached by traversing the rocks leading from the eastern wall all the way to the ledge. A set of slugs can be found underneath looking at the body.

items.name: Stonesword Key #41
items.acquisition: Stonesword Key found on a corpse on a broken bridge near Corpse-Stench Shack .

items.name: Stonesword Key #42
items.acquisition: Stonesword Key. Held by a corpse in front of the fort's entrance.

items.name: Stonesword Key #43
items.acquisition: Stonesword Key. Found inside a small open structure in the northern section of the ruins.

items.name: Stonesword Key #44
items.acquisition: Held by a corpse sitting on a chair, near the edge of the cliff.

items.name: Stonesword Key #45
items.acquisition: Stonesword Key held by a corpse located on the rooftop in the northern section.

items.name: Stonesword Key #46
items.acquisition: Key Item. Found on a corpse lying at the tip of a branch in Miquella's Haligtree canopy right behind you when you enter the area.

items.name: Stonesword Key #47
items.acquisition: Key Item. Found on a corpse lying at the tip of a branch in Miquella's Haligtree canopy.

items.name: Stonesword Key #48
items.acquisition: Stonesword Key found on a corpse at the very end of a tall ruined wall in Siofra River . A gust of wind can be found at the edge of the cliff closest to the ruin, boosting you up to the top.

items.name: Stonesword Key #49
items.acquisition: Stonesword Key. Found on a corpse by the cliffs east of the mausoleum, behind some praying corpses.

items.name: Stonesword Key #50
items.acquisition: Key Item. Found on a corpse laying by a ledge overlooking the ruined temple in Nokron, Eternal City with the deer carcass. This ledge is a level lower than the cliff with the spirit jellyfish.

items.name: Stonesword Key #51
items.acquisition: Stonesword Key found by climbing across the wall's support beams and pillars in Siofra River .

items.name: Stonesword Key #52
items.acquisition: Key Item. Found on a corpse next to a Giant Poison Flower in northern Uhl Palace Ruins .

items.name: Stonesword Key #53
items.acquisition: Key Item. Found on a corpse laying on a ledge overlooking the waters of Nokstella, Eternal City .

items.name: Stonesword Key #54
items.acquisition: At the top of the high building, accessed by jumping on the Spiritspring behind.

On reaching the top turn left to take another latter leading to the uppermost level of the tower, where a treasure chest resides that holds the Talisman.

items.name: Boltdrake Talisman +2
items.acquisition: Talisman. Found on a corpse hanging off an opening in a tall tower south of the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. Reaching this area is a bit complex: You will first need to head southeast to the large plaza guarded by a stationary Farum Azula Dragon which is constantly raining red lightning all around the area. From here, drop down a series of cliffs to the east to reach the opening at the bottom of a large building. Follow the linear path here to a balcony with a ladder leading up to a terrace. Directly in front of the ladder is a lift building. Take the lift up to a series of slopes leading to a hallway underneath the same bridge you crossed to get to the southeast plaza. Fight your way through the hallway to reach a ladder at the end. Climb up the ladder to reach the opening where the corpse holding the talisman can be found.

items.acquisition: In the center of the Finger Ruins of Rhia. Go to the large ring of fingers (as shown by the Ruins Map given by Count Ymir), and then sound the hanging bell from one of the fingers that's pointing down. The Hole-Laden Necklace given by Ymir is required to sound it.

items.name: Crucible Feather Talisman
items.acquisition: Talisman found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave . Reaching it is quite complex: From the first Chariot Hall, drop down through the opening on either side just before the second ramp. In the room below, head west and up the steps, then turn right into the next corridor that leads to a large hall with two Chariots running almost side by side, with a short delay between them. Head all the way down towards the pit behind the pillars. Looking down, you will see several wooden beams that you can drop onto. Navigate your way to the lowest beam and then head south towards the archway with a ladder at the back. Climb the ladder to reach a third Chariot Hall with a single Chariot. Head all the way down this hall, using the alcove on the left about halfway through to avoid the Chariot (unless you've previously destroyed it). At the bottom, turn left into a corridor and head straight to find a small room guarded by an Omen . The talisman can be found on a corpse behind the Omen, sitting by a statue.

details.description: A talisman fashioned from feathers that embody the aspects of various creatures. Said to have grown on the human body long ago.
details.effect: Improves dodge rolling but increases damage taken

items.acquisition: Talisman. Found in a chest on an elevated platform inside the large building in the northeast, guarded by several Pests. This platform can be reached by heading through the eastern exit from the Drainage Channel site of grace and then navigating across the branches and concrete beams to reach the roof of the building. While there are many branches and beams to traverse, the path is fairly linear. Once on the roof, drop through one of the holes onto the wooden beams below and then carefully make your way onto the platform after killing the Pests from range.

details.description: Legendary talisman of wrought iron depicting a massive ancient dragon. Enormously boosts physical damage negation.

From the Dragon Temple Lift site of grace, take the lift back down and then head east and down the spiral staircase. Around halfway down the steps where you see some broken railings, jump off the edge to a series of floating debris below. Once you reach the lowest platforms, turn around and look for a small platform underneath one of the upper ones to find the corpse with the talisman.

items.name: Dried Bouquet

From where you got the Bone Bow, as you exit the doorway, make a hard left and you'll see a pile of rubble that you can jump on and you'll see there's a secret room tucked behind it. Go inside a large storeroom where you can find the following items: x5 Thin Beast Bones, x1 Scadutree Fragment, and x1 Dried Bouquet. You can click on the images below to enlarge them.

items.acquisition: After using the lever to move the statues in Specimen Storeroom, head to the second floor where the Fire Knight is gazing at the center of the room in the wooden structure. Head to his right and reach the rail to find the statue's head with this item.

items.name: Perfumer's Talisman
items.acquisition: In a chest underground below stairs in the room with the yellow Giant Poison Flower.

details.description: A talisman depicting a set of perfume bottles. Raises potency of perfume items.

items.name: Primal Glintstone Blade
items.acquisition: Talisman. Found in an underground area of the Stargazer's Ruins . The entrance is sealed by a barrier and there is a talking jellyfish atop the steps. Summon the Spirit Jellyfish next to her to unlock the seal.

details.description: An old glintstone blade that has been stained with blood.
details.effect: Spells consume less FP, but maximum HP is reduced

items.name: Prince of Death's Cyst
items.acquisition: Dropped by a Runebear, fiound in a cave behind a waterfall

details.description: A fetid, overgrown cyst taken from facial flesh. Greatly raises vitality. (Vitality governs resistance to the effects of Death.)

items.name: Prince of Death's Pustule
items.acquisition: Looted off a corpse that can be found at the pit of the castle's crypt after defeating the Ulcerated Tree Spirit . The body can be found next to a giant face.

details.description: A fetid pustule taken from facial flesh. Raises vitality. (Vitality governs resistance to the effects of Death.)

items.name: Prosthesis-Wearer Heirloom
items.acquisition: Finish the sidequest given by Gowry in Caelid, then return to Millicent to receive the talisman.

items.name: Radagon Icon
items.acquisition: Found inside a treasure chest on the second floor of the Debate Hall Site of Grace. From the gate entrance leading to the courtyard, make a hard right and jump over the fence. Climb up the ladder and head through the broken glass window. The treasure chest is on the east section.

details.description: A legendary talisman depicting the Elden Lord Radagon. Shortens the casting time of sorceries and incantations.

items.name: Radagon's Scarseal
items.acquisition: Dropped by Ancient Hero of Zamor

details.description: An eye engraved with an Elden Rune. Said to be the seal of King Consort Radagon.
details.effect: Raises attributes, but also increases damage taken.

items.name: Radagon's Soreseal
items.acquisition: Talisman. Found on a corpse by dropping down the opening on the roof and looking around the wooden walkways.

details.description: This legendary talisman is an eye engraved with an Elden Rune, said to be the seal of King Consort Radagon.
details.effect: Greatly raises attributes, but also increases damage taken

items.name: Red-Feathered Branchsword
items.acquisition: Dropped by the Deathbird at Liurnia of the Lakes

details.description: A talisman adorned with red feathers, once used in ancient death rituals.
details.effect: Raises attack power when HP is low.

items.name: Rellana's Cameo
items.acquisition: The talisman can be looted on top of an altar inside a chapel.

items.name: Ritual Shield Talisman
items.acquisition: From the West Capital Rampart site of grace in Leyndell, follow the marble stairway heading South-Southwest, past a Valiant Gargoyle near a Golden Seed and up the stair toward a giant Colloseum, the talisman is at the top of the hill, in front of the door of the Colloseum.

details.description: A talisman patterned after shields used in ritual combat held to honor the Erdtree.
details.effect: Raises defense when HP is at maximum.

items.name: Ritual Sword Talisman
items.acquisition: Located in Lux Ruins , in a chest after defeating Demi-Human Queen Gilika

details.description: A talisman patterned after swords used in ritual combat held to honor the Erdtree.
details.effect: Raises attack power when HP is at maximum.

items.name: Roar Medallion
items.acquisition: Dropped by Stonedigger Troll . Located in Limgrave Tunnels.

items.name: Rotten Winged Sword Insignia
items.acquisition: Earned after choosing to assist Millicent and successfully defeat her sisters.

missable.lockedBy: Betray path at Elphael (red summon sign) or incomplete Millicent questline
missable.note: From Millicent's corpse on the assist path (gold sign vs her four sisters at Elphael). Mutually exclusive with Millicent's Prosthesis.

items.name: Sacred Scorpion Charm
items.acquisition: Talisman. Dropped by invader Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater when defeated.

details.description: A talisman carried by assassins who strike unseen. Patterned on a scorpion freshly shed of its exoskeleton, its claws seizing a heart with a blessed glow.
details.effect: Raises holy attack, but lowers damage negation.

items.name: Sacrificial Twig
items.acquisition: Special Consumable Talisman. Found on a corpse on a stone platform jutting out of the cliff to the east. Accessible from above only, by heading east from Malefactor's Evergaol.

details.description: A talisman fashioned from a dried twig, so slender that it might snap at the slightest touch.
details.effect: Will be lost on death in place of runes.

items.name: Shabriri's Woe
items.acquisition: Found on a body at the edge of the Frenzied Flame Village

details.description: Disturbing likeness of a man whose eyes have been gouged out. The corners of his mouth are upturned in an almost flirtatious manner.

items.name: Shard of Alexander
items.acquisition: Drops from Iron Fist Alexander after completing his questline.

details.description: Shard of the late Alexander, a shattered warrior jar.
details.effect: Greatly boosts the attack power of skills.

items.name: Sharpshot Talisman
items.acquisition: Found inside Albinauric's Shack

items.name: Shattered Stone Talisman
items.acquisition: Moorth Ruins. Fall on the first rooftop visible from the gap on the ground, turn left, and walk on the ledge to find the Talisman.

items.name: Silver Scarab
items.acquisition: Found in a chest in Hidden Path to the Haligtree . The chest is found past an illusory wall, behind a Grave Glovewort (9) inside the first alcove that you can access by jumping down onto the invisible walkways under the staircase in the main hall.

items.name: Smithing Talisman
items.acquisition: The talisman is looted from a corpse. The body is inside a room filled with Fire Blob enemies, on the upper-most level of the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past.

items.name: Spear Talisman
items.acquisition: Talisman found in a chest within Lakeside Crystal Cave

details.description: A talisman depicting a spear and a soldier. Enhances the counterattacks that are unique to thrusting weapons.
details.effect: Enhances counterattacks unique to thrusting weapons

items.name: Spelldrake Talisman
items.acquisition: Talisman. Acquired by defeating the Runebear boss inside Earthbore Cave .

details.description: Talisman depicting a blue ancient dragon. Boosts magic damage negation.

items.name: Spelldrake Talisman +1
items.acquisition: Upgraded Talisman. Found in a chest in a small room the northwest section of town. Right below where the Staff of Loss is obtained. This room is initially sealed by a barrier that can be dispelled by lighting a brazier atop a tower in the southwest of town.

items.name: Spelldrake Talisman +2
items.acquisition: Upgraded Talisman. Found in the secret catacombs underneath the Hidden Path to the Haligtree by turning right just before the Stray Mimic Tear 's boss door, following the corridor and taking the lift up. The talisman is found on a corpse in an alcove at the top.

items.name: Spelldrake Talisman +3
items.acquisition: A +3 variant of the Spelldrake Talisman can be looted off a corpse. The body is located inside a storeroom underneath the castle front bridge of Castle Ensis.

items.name: St. Trina's Smile
items.acquisition: Obtained as a drop upon defeating Thiollier. Thiollier only becomes a hostile enemy if you pursue Thiollier and St. Trina's NPC quest. Please visit the Thiollier or St.Trina 's page for the NPC quest guide.

items.name: Stalwart Horn Charm
items.acquisition: Can be found in Eastern Liurnia. Fast travel to Mausoleum Compound, head up the light incline to the left towards the cliff to the West. When you are at the cliff, look South for a hole in the wall. The talisman can be found on a corpse on a cliff through the hole.

details.description: An accoutrement worn by the ancestral followers. Greatly raises robustness. (Robustness governs resistance to blood loss and frost.)  Said to be a budding horn. The ancestral followers believe that the horns of a long-lived beast continue to bud like antlers, over and over again, until the beast one day becomes an ancestral spirit.

items.name: Stalwart Horn Charm +1
items.acquisition: Found to the east of Yelough Anix Tunnel

items.name: Stalwart Horn Charm +2
items.acquisition: Bonny Gaol. After you jump down the hole, head east past the rats and climb up the ladder. Defeat the Inner Jar monster, you will find the talisman in the room.

items.name: Stargazer Heirloom
items.acquisition: Talisman . Found on a body lying at the top of the Divine Tower of Liurnia .

details.description: A talisman engraved with the legend of a queen. Raises intelligence.

items.name: Starscourge Heirloom
items.acquisition: Looted from a chest in Fort Gael . It's outside the watchtower on the upper-section of the fort, under a canopy tent.

details.description: A talisman engraved with a scene from a heroic tale. Raises strength.

items.name: Taker's Cameo
items.acquisition: Talisman . Awarded by Tanith after completing the third letter quest.

details.description: A talisman engraved with a stern likeness of Praetor Rykard, master of Volcano Manor.

items.name: Talisman of All Crucibles
items.acquisition: Start at the Ancient Ruins, Grand Starway Site of Grace, and head southwest to the elevator. At the bottom of the elevator looking south west, there are 2 paths of floating platforms, go to the left one, follow it around and it loops to the chest with this talisman.

items.name: Talisman of Lord's Bestowal
items.acquisition: Can be found beside the big golden tree.

items.name: Talisman of the Dread
items.acquisition: Can be found on a corpse inside Elder's Hovel.

items.name: Twinblade Talisman
items.acquisition: Talisman. Found in the tower section of the walls of Castle Morne. Climb up the ladder and go around the tower to find a chest containing the talisman.

details.description: A talisman depicting a twinblade and a confessor. Enhances the final hit ending a chain of attacks.
details.effect: Enhances final hit of chain attacks.

items.name: Two Fingers Heirloom
items.acquisition: Talisman. Found in a chest inside a hidden cellar in the Purified Ruins . The cellar entrance is concealed by wooden planks and barrels that you can roll onto or attack to destroy.

details.description: A talisman engraved with the legend of the Two Fingers. Raises faith.

items.name: Two-Handed Sword Talisman
items.acquisition: Temple Town Ruins . After the fight with the Horned Warrior, just continue up to the next room to find a chest with this item inside.

items.name: Two-Headed Turtle Talisman
items.acquisition: It's inside a cave beneath a waterfall guarded by enemies Just east of Rivermouth Cave

items.name: Verdigris Discus
items.acquisition: Ancient Rauh Ruins: Can be found in front of a giant statue in a lower area only accessible by jumping down from the second Divine Beast Lion encounter, or by teleporting to this platform from the waygate in Scadu Altus

items.name: Viridian Amber Medallion
items.acquisition: Viridian Amber Medallion Raises maximum stamina. It is dropped by Miranda the Blighted Bloom, found inside the Tombsward Cave.

details.description: A medallion with viridian amber inlaid. Boosts maximum stamina. The Erdtree's old sap becomes amber, treasured as the most precious of jewels in the age of Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. A primordial life energy resides inside

items.name: Viridian Amber Medallion +1
items.acquisition: can be found in Altus Plauteau, south of the Outer Wall Battleground Site of Grace. You should hear Margit whisper, "I see you, Tarnished..." to you before appearing on the road. Defeat him again and it will drop.

items.name: Viridian Amber Medallion +2
items.acquisition: The closest site of grace is the Haligtree Town Plaza. Run to the roof with the Summoning Snail, jump to the building on the right (it's lower), immediately turn around and jump inside the building. There will be a chest with the medallion and some mushroom people

items.name: Viridian Amber Medallion +3
items.acquisition: Darklight Catacombs : In a chest found by dropping down a ledge in the main area, and going to the archway in the wall

items.name: Warrior Jar Shard
items.acquisition: Shard of a shattered warrior jar.

details.description: Shard of a shattered warrior jar.
details.effect: Boosts the attack power of skills.

items.name: Winged Sword Insignia
items.acquisition: Talisman. Dropped by the Cleanrot Knight boss inside the Stillwater Cave .

details.description: A talisman depicting a raised prosthetic blade. An honor bestowed upon the knights who fought alongside Malenia the Severed.
details.effect: Raises attack power with successive attacks

items.name: Ancestral Infant's Head
items.acquisition: Key Item. Found in a chest in a submerged ruin in Nokron, Eternal City . Guarded by an Ancestral Follower .

details.description: Skull of a very young ancestral spirit. Just think how many sproutings It might bear.

items.name: Ancient Dragon's Blessing
items.acquisition: Given by Dragon Communion Priestess located near the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion.

items.name: Baldachin's Blessing
items.acquisition: Favor bestowed by a deathbed companion. Protection of a hidden

details.description: Favor bestowed by a deathbed companion. Protection of a hidden

items.name: Blasphemous Claw
items.acquisition: Reusable Tool. Dropped by the invader Recusant Bernahl upon defeat.

details.description: A slab of rock engraved with traces of the Rune of Death.

items.name: Blessing of Marika
items.acquisition: Dropped by the Tree Sentinel .

items.name: Bloody Finger
items.acquisition: Key Multiplayer Item. Reward for advancing White-Mask Varre questline and giving him the blood-soaked Lord of Blood's Favor item.

details.description: Item for online play. Attempts an invasion of another player's world. If successful, your objective will be to defeat the Host of Fingers of the world to which you were summoned. The nail of this finger is shot through with streaks of fresh, glistening blood. The finger's sickly pale skin feels nothing now, but the nail still aches with sweetest pain.

items.name: Blue Cipher Ring
items.acquisition: Item for online play. Puts the wearer in ready state to answer should someone in another world call for rescue. You will be summoned to their world as a hunter. When summoned to rescue another player, your objective will be to defeat the invader.

details.description: Item for online play. Puts the wearer in ready state to answer should someone in another world call for rescue. You will be summoned to their world as a hunter. When summoned to rescue another player, your objective will be to defeat the invader.

items.name: Bondstone
items.acquisition: Can be found behind an illusory wall inside a tunnel area guarded by scorpions

items.name: Duelist's Furled Finger
items.acquisition: Creates competitive multiplayer summon sign.

details.description: Item for online play. Creates a summon sign for competitive multiplayer. Your objective will be to defeat the Host of Fingers of the world to which you were summoned. A finger of corpse wax, furled like a hook. The bronze adornments are the mark of a duelist.

items.name: Finger Severer
items.acquisition: Multiplayer Item. Found on a corpse by the wall just past the Site of Grace in the Stranded Graveyard. Found along with the Tarnished's Furled Finger .

details.description: Item for online play.

items.name: Flask of Cerulean Tears
items.acquisition: A sacred flask modelled after a golden holy chalice that was once graced by a tear of life. Filled with cerulean tears, this flask restores FP with use. Rest at a site of grace to replenish. It is said that a Finger Maiden will bestow two such chalices upon the chosen Tarnished when they meet.

items.name: Flask of Wondrous Physick
items.acquisition: Laying on the ground in front of the statue. Bestows various special effects.

details.description: A relic of the physick chemists, priests of the Erdtree. Harnesses the powers of crystal tears, which only form after the passage of many moons. Various specials effects are bestowed upon the drinker, dependent on the specific mixture of crystal tears. Rest at a site of grace to replenish. It is said that in the Lands Between, pools of crystal tears amass at the bases of Minor Erdtrees.

items.name: Horned Bairn
items.acquisition: Dropped by the Ulcerated Tree Spirit found under the Ellac Greatbridge.

items.name: Iris of Grace
items.acquisition: Directly below of the Ash of War: Wall of Sparks location. Take the left lift down from the Storehouse, first floor site of grace. Take the first exit to the right and continue forward until the end of the hallway. Kill the enemy, and take the right path down. Kill the enemies and turn left all the way to find the item.

items.name: Iris of Occultation
items.acquisition: This item drops from a second Lesser Ulcerated Spirit enemy that can be found around this section of the sunken chapel.

items.name: Lamenter's Mask
items.acquisition: A stone mask twisted into an expression of rapturous grief. Use while disrobed to transform into a lamenter. Dropped by Lamenter at Lamenter's Gaol.

items.name: Lantern
items.acquisition: A small waist-worn lantern that illuminates surroundings. Use once to turn on, and again to turn off. While its light is dimmer than that of a torch, it has the advantage of freeing up the user's hands.

details.description: A small waist-worn lantern that illuminates surroundings. Use once to turn on, and again to turn off. While its light is dimmer than that of a torch, it has the advantage of freeing up the user's hands.

items.name: Margit's Shackle
items.acquisition: A fetish bathed in golden magic. Shackles were used to bind the accursed people called the Omen, and these ones were made to keep a particular Omen under strictest confinement. Though faint, the shackles still retain vestiges of power — enough to trap the once-bound Margit on earth, if only for a short time.

items.name: Memory of Grace
items.acquisition: A phantom vision of the first grace, which once guided the Tarnished to the Lands Between. Lose all runes and return to last site of grace at which you rested. It all repeats. Be seen by the Elden Ring. Become the Elden Lord.

details.description: A phantom vision of the first grace, which once guided the Tarnished to the Lands Between. Lose all runes and return to last site of grace at which you rested. It all repeats. Be seen by the Elden Ring. Become the Elden Lord.

items.name: Mimic's Veil
items.acquisition: Reusable Key Item. Found in a chest inside the assembly room with the large war table. There is a Banished Knight in this room.

details.description: Golden veil of intricate design.

items.acquisition: A fetish bathed in golden magic.

details.description: A fetish bathed in golden magic.

items.name: Omen Bairn
items.acquisition: Doll of a curseborn bairn.

details.description: Doll of a curseborn bairn.

items.name: Prattling Pate "Apologies"
items.acquisition: Reusable Item. Found on a corpse in the Unsightly Catacombs , along the corridors in the room with the lever that opens the final door.

details.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a human head. Emits a voice that says "Apologies."

items.name: Prattling Pate "Hello"
items.acquisition: Can be found in Stormfoot Catacombs on a corpse behind the first pillar that exudes fire.

details.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a human head.

items.name: Prattling Pate "Lamentation"
items.acquisition: Lamenter's Gaol. Climb up the long ladder, cross the connecting stone bridge, and enter the room on the left, you'll find this key item on a corpse.

items.name: Prattling Pate "Let's get to it"
items.acquisition: Found within Sainted Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau . Found by the entrance of the room with the shadow enemy that, when killed, opens the final door.

items.name: Prattling Pate "My beloved"
items.acquisition: Pratting Pate " My beloved " can be found on Miquella's Haligtree , shortly after taking the way gate from Ordina, Liturgical Town. It is two branches down from where you are transported to.

items.name: Prattling Pate "Please help"
items.acquisition: Found within Impaler's Catacombs , held by a corpse in the water underneath the spikes trap.

details.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a human head. Emits a voice that says "Please help."

items.name: Prattling Pate "Thank you"
items.acquisition: Reusable Item. Obtained inside the Tombsward Catacombs . Found on a corpse at the end of the main path, past the flamethrowing pillar.

details.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a human head.

items.name: Prattling Pate "Wonderful"
items.acquisition: Found in Cliffbottom Catacombs , in the very bottom level of the large multi-leveled hall. You can drop down to this level via the gap on either side of the central stair-bridge. Check around the corridors here for several items, one of which is the Prattling Pate.

details.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a human head. Emits a voice that says "Wonderful."

items.name: Prattling Pate "You're beautiful"
items.acquisition: Tool Item. Found by a door just near the Hierodas Glintstone Crown in Hermit Village.

details.description: Twisted clay sculpt in the shape of a demi-human head. Emits a voice that says "You're beautiful."

items.name: Priestess Heart
items.acquisition: The Dragon Communion Priestess drops this item at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion after defeating Bayle The Dread.

items.name: Pureblood Knight's Medal
items.acquisition: Key Tool Item. Reward for advancing White-Mask Varre questline and giving him the blood-soaked Lord of Blood's Favor item. Gives player early access to Mohgwyn Dynasty underground.

items.name: Radiant Baldachin's Blessing
items.acquisition: Protection of a hidden temple in the guise of a bedchamber. This blessing is of the utmost rarity. Uses FP to temporarily raise poise. The effect lasts longer than a mere favor. It's said a deathbed companion will only produce a blessing of this kind for a champion but once in her entire life. The sole blessing which she imbues of her own volition.

items.name: Recusant Finger
items.acquisition: Multiplayer Item. Found in a locked room with the Letter from Volcano Manor after pledging your services to the Volcano Manor .

details.description: Item for online play.

items.name: Regal Omen Bairn
items.acquisition: Doll of a curseborn bairn from the Erdtree's royal line.  Uses FP to unleash many wraiths that chase down foes.

details.description: Doll of a curseborn bairn from the Erdtree's royal line.  Uses FP to unleash many wraiths that chase down foes.

items.name: Rock Heart
items.acquisition: A special item obtained from completing the "Domain of Dragons" Painting puzzle. Allows players to transform into an Ancient Dragon

items.name: Small Golden Effigy
items.acquisition: Multiplayer Item. Found on the Summoning Pool a few steps west of The First Step Site of Grace.

details.description: Online multiplayer item. Sends a summon sign for cooperative multiplayer to a nearby summoning pool. In cooperative multiplayer, you will be summoned to another world to help defeat the area boss.

items.name: Small Red Effigy
items.acquisition: Sends competitive sign to summoning pool.

details.description: Item for online play. Sends a competitive sign to a nearby summoning pool. In competitive multiplayer, your objective will be to defeat the Host of Fingers of the world to which you were summoned.

items.name: Spectral Steed Whistle
items.acquisition: A delicate goldwork ring. Can be used as a finger whistle. Sound the whistle to summon and ride spectral steed. (Dismounts steed when used while on horseback.) Upon death, the spectral steed can be summoned again, but doing so consumes the Flask of Crimson Tears.

details.description: A delicate goldwork ring. Can be used as a finger whistle. Sound the whistle to summon and ride spectral steed. (Dismounts steed when used while on horseback.) Upon death, the spectral steed can be summoned again, but doing so consumes the Flask of Crimson Tears.

items.name: Tarnished's Furled Finger
items.acquisition: Item for online play. Creates a summon sign for cooperative multiplayer. Your objective will be to defeat the area boss of the world to which you were summoned. A finger of corpse wax, furled like a hook. It is a relic of those who came before, left to help those who would come after.

items.name: Tarnished's Wizened Finger
items.acquisition: Can be found at the beginning of the game, on a body against a wall on the right side of the tutorial area.

details.description: Item for online play. (Can also be used from the Messages menu.) Use to write messages. Your messages will be conveyed to other worlds, allowing other players to read them. A finger of corpse wax, so emaciated the bone is visible. It is a relic of those who came before, left to help those who would come after.

items.name: Taunter's Tongue
items.acquisition: Item for online play. Lures in invaders. This allows your world to be invaded without any Furled Finger cooperators present, and it also shortens the interval between windows of opportunity for invasion. Additionally, enables the arrival of a second invader. (When two invaders are present, you will be limited to one cooperator.)

Additionally, enables the arrival of a second invader. (When two invaders are present, you will be limited to one cooperator.)

items.name: Telescope
items.acquisition: Astrology tool used by members of the Carian royal family. Part of a larger instrument, removed and stolen away. Allows the viewer to better see faraway things. During the age of the Erdtree, Carian astrology withered on the vine. The fate once writ in the night skies had been fettered by the Golden Order.

items.name: White Cipher Ring
items.acquisition: Item for online play. Allows you to automatically request for a hunter from another world to come to your rescue when your world is invaded. (You may be unable to summon rescuers under certain circumstances). A lost mystic code, enchanted to take the form of a ring. One of the fetishes said to have been bestowed by the Two Fingers.
