items.name: Wraith Calling Bell
items.acquisition: Offensive Consumable Item. Found in a chest in a small room of an underground aea in the northwestern section of the Laskyar Ruins . Find a set of steps leading downwards to locate the area.

details.description: Bell used by worshippers of revenants.

items.name: Academy Glintstone Staff
items.acquisition: Staff. Can be found on Sorcerer Thops' body near the Schoolhouse Classroom site of grace after giving him the Academy Glintstone Key.

details.description: Staff of the Academy of Raya Lucaria, embedded with a turquoise glintstone. Only a recognized sorcerer is permitted to wield this staff.

items.name: Alabaster Lord's Sword
items.acquisition: Drops from an enemy in the Underground. You have to raise the platforms to get up to him by stepping on the buttons around the swamp. There are two buttons that are next to small columns or obelisks. Once you get raised on the platform, take on the long and narrow path, after a few meters you will be greeted by this enemy. kill him to obtain the Alabastrer Lord's Sword.

details.description: Greatsword forged from a blue-white meteoric ore. The blade conceals gravity-manipulating magic. A weapon unique to the Alabaster Lords, a race of ancients with skin of stone who were said to have risen to life when a meteor struck long ago.

items.name: Albinauric Bow
items.acquisition: Longbow featuring delicate silverwork. Wielded by Albinauric wolfback archers. This bow requires dexterity over strength to master.

details.description: Longbow featuring delicate silverwork. Wielded by Albinauric wolfback archers. This bow requires dexterity over strength to master.

items.name: Albinauric Staff
items.acquisition: Found in Volcano Manor near the Guest Hall grace. Head left from the bonfire, then left again, taking the stairs to the next floor. Head outside and take the ladder to your left onto the roof. Go to the back of the roof and jump off the right side to be taken to a room with an Omenkiller, the Albinauric Staff, and Albinauric Mask.

details.description: Short staff with a blue glintstone embedded. Wielded by the albinaurics of old.  The albinaurics harbor a secret; they cast sorcery with their innate arcaneness.

items.name: Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword
items.acquisition: The weapon is acquired after examining the altar of the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past. The altar is found on the second level. To reach the altar, you must pull the lever to make the iron door rise, and use it as a platform to jump across to the second level where the altar is.

items.name: Antspur Rapier
items.acquisition: Thrusting Sword. Dropped by Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan upon defeat.

details.description: Spur of a giant ant which has been fashioned into a rapier. The blade drips with scarlet rot.  Scarlet rot is an old legend, of which Maleigh Marais of the Shaded Castle was a private believer. And indeed, he eventually found his own personal goddess.

items.name: Anvil Hammer
items.acquisition: Ruined Forge Lava Intake. Use the column you have lowered with the lever as a bridge and climb it until the end. Beware of the fire blob, and then at the top, turn right and jump to reach the stairs. Climb them up and interact with a furnace to obtain this weapon and an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

items.name: Arbalest
items.acquisition: Using a Stonesword Key to access, additionally obtaining the Godskin prayerbook and Godslayer Seal: From the Rampart Tower bonfire, take the shortcut lift down to where the Grafted miniboss is fought inside the storeroom (or reach this point manually). Exit into the courtyard with the flamethrowers and barricades. Take an immediate left and hug the wall until you enter a cellar containing rats. You will hit a fog wall that requires one Stonesword Key to open. Continue past this fog wall until you reach an outdoors area again. Pull an immediate right and hug the wall until you reach a ladder. Continue past this point and almost all the way across the bridge, then jump to the rocky outcropping to your right (it's a tight jump). Continue and jump back into a walled-in area with a ballista. The Arbalest is on a corpse in that area.

details.description: Large crossbow made from composite materials. One of the largest of all bolt.firing devices. Its limbs are more pliable than metallic ones, allowing bolts fired from this weapon to pierce even forged of steel.

items.name: Astrologer's Staff
items.acquisition: Staff of the astrologers. A glintsone is embedded in the tip, enabling it to be used as a catalyst for sorceries.  Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.

details.description: Staff of the astrologers. A glintsone is embedded in the tip, enabling it to be used as a catalyst for sorceries.  Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.

items.name: Axe of Godfrey
items.acquisition: Weapon of Godfrey, Elden Lord. It was broken in a battle fought as leader of the Tarnished during the Long March. This weapon is symbolic of Godfrey's vow to conduct himself as a lord, later becoming an emblem of the golden lineage. In the days of the past, a crown was warranted with strength.

details.description: Weapon of Godfrey, Elden Lord. It was broken in a battle fought as leader of the Tarnished during the Long March. This weapon is symbolic of Godfrey's vow to conduct himself as a lord, later becoming an emblem of the golden lineage. In the days of the past, a crown was warranted with strength.

items.name: Axe of Godrick
items.acquisition: Greataxe wielded by Godrick the Grafted. This golden battleaxe is emblazoned with the figure of a beast, representing the strength of Godfrey, First Elden Lord and patriarch of the golden lineage. "I command thee kneel! For I am the lord of all that is golden!"

details.description: Greataxe wielded by Godrick the Grafted. This golden battleaxe is emblazoned with the figure of a beast, representing the strength of Godfrey, First Elden Lord and patriarch of the golden lineage. "I command thee kneel! For I am the lord of all that is golden!"

items.name: Azur's Glintstone Staff
items.acquisition: Looted on the ground inside a room that is full of crystals. It's on the east side, the second floor of the Church of the Cuckoo within Raya Lucaria Academy.

details.description: Staff of the primeval glintstone sorcerer Azur. Only those who have glimpsed what lies beyond the wisdom of stone may wield it. Reduces casting time of all sorceries, but consumes additional FP.

items.name: Backhand Blade
items.acquisition: Besides a coffin, in the Inquisitor enemies area.

items.name: Banished Knight's Greatsword
items.acquisition: A finely-crafted greatsword intricately engraved with an ancient motif. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.

details.description: A finely-crafted greatsword intricately engraved with an ancient motif. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.

items.name: Banished Knight's Halberd
items.acquisition: An upgraded Banished Knight's Halberd dropped by Edgar the Revenger .

details.description: A finely-crafted halberd intricately engraved with an ancient motif. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.

items.name: Barbed Staff-Spear
items.acquisition: Dropped by Jori, Elder Inquisitor , and grants 260000 Runes upon defeat.

items.name: Bastard's Stars
items.acquisition: Flail which deals magic damage, having been imbued with power by the remembrance of Astel. Formed of the same many-colored star debris that comprised the form of the Naturalborn of the Void.

details.description: Flail which deals magic damage, having been imbued with power by the remembrance of Astel. Formed of the same many-colored star debris that comprised the form of the Naturalborn of the Void.

items.name: Bastard Sword
items.acquisition: A large sword with a straight blade. This heavy sword is normally wielded with two hands, but those with sufficient strength can wield it in one alone. The hefty blade can be swung into multiple foes at once thanks to the broad, sweeping attack, making fending off crowds all the easier.

details.description: A large sword with a straight blade. This heavy sword is normally wielded with two hands, but those with sufficient strength can wield it in one alone. The hefty blade can be swung into multiple foes at once thanks to the broad, sweeping attack, making fending off crowds all the easier.

items.name: Battle Axe
items.acquisition: A thick, heavy blade attached to a handle. A versatile, standard weapon Capable of powerful attacks thanks to the weighty blade, these weapons are also regarded for their powerful charge attacks.

details.description: A thick, heavy blade attached to a handle. A versatile, standard weapon Capable of powerful attacks thanks to the weighty blade, these weapons are also regarded for their powerful charge attacks.

items.name: Battle Hammer
items.acquisition: Dropped by Grave Warden Duelist in Murkwater Catacombs .

details.description: Large iron warhammer designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike.

items.name: Beast Claw (weapon)
items.acquisition: Drops from killing this hostile NPC in Gravesite plains in the forest, southeast of the Gravesite Plain Site of Grace.

items.name: Beast-Repellent Torch
items.acquisition: A torch which burns oil infused with a special incense. The aroma pacifies wild beasts. Torches such as these were used to keep unwelcome beasts away from treasure troves hidden in caves.

details.description: A torch which burns oil infused with a special incense. The aroma pacifies wild beasts. Torches such as these were used to keep unwelcome beasts away from treasure troves hidden in caves.

items.name: Beastclaw Greathammer
items.acquisition: Given by Gurranq after turning in their 7th Deathroot.

details.description: Greathammer with a striking end modelled to resemble five beastly claws. The black nails protruding from golden fur are said to represent Serosh, Lord of Beasts, who went to become King Godfrey's Regent.

items.name: Beastman's Cleaver
items.acquisition: Curved greatsword of colossal size forged of dull iron and wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula. The blade is incredibly heavy, but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers. It's clear the beastmen possess knowledge beyond human ken.

details.description: Curved greatsword of colossal size forged of dull iron and wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula. The blade is incredibly heavy, but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers. It's clear the beastmen possess knowledge beyond human ken.

items.name: Beastman's Curved Sword
items.acquisition: Curved sword forged of dull iron wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula. The blade is heavy but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers.

details.description: Curved sword forged of dull iron wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula. The blade is heavy but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers.

items.name: Black Bow
items.acquisition: Bow that can be found on the roof on the right that overlooks the area. Need to jump from roof to roof in order to reach it.

details.description: Longbow carved from black wood to resemble a blade. One of the most difficult bows to master. The blade-like body of the bow is light and cuts through the air. Though a longbow, it can be wielded similarly to a shortbow.

items.name: Black Knife
items.acquisition: Dagger dropped from the Black Knife Assassin

details.description: Dagger once belonging to one of the assassins who murdered Godwyn the Golden on the Night of the Black Knives.  A ritual performed on the oddly misshapen blade imbued it with the power of the stolen Rune of Death.

items.name: Black Steel Greathammer
items.acquisition: Greathammer dropped by the heavy armored guard of the Church of Consolation. This is a guaranteed drop when you first kill him.

items.name: Black Steel Twinblade
items.acquisition: Drops from Black Knight at the top of the hill encampment. He is guarded by many Messmer Soldiers along the way.

items.name: Blade of Calling
items.acquisition: From the Forbidden Lands site of grace, turn back and head towards the elevator. Face southwest before activating the elevator, and then watch for an opening to jump off into. The Blade of Calling is on the table in the room at the end of this hall

details.description: Dagger given to one who set out on a journey to fulfill her duty long ago. The power of its former owner, the kindling maiden, is still apparent. The one who walks alongside flame, Shall one day meet the road of Destined Death.

items.name: Blasphemous Blade
items.acquisition: Sacred sword of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy. Remains of the countless heroes he has devoured writhe upon the surface of this blade. Now they share the same blood, bound together as family. Some HP is restored upon defeating an enemy.

details.description: Sacred sword of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy. Remains of the countless heroes he has devoured writhe upon the surface of this blade. Now they share the same blood, bound together as family. Some HP is restored upon defeating an enemy.

items.name: Bloodfiend's Arm
items.acquisition: Colossal Weapon. Guaranteed drop from the chief Bloodfiend at the top of Prospect Town. One time only.

items.name: Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear
items.acquisition: The Bloodfiend west of Taylew's Ruined Forge drops this when killed.

items.name: Bloodhound Claws
items.acquisition: Claw. Dropped by the Bloodhound Knight in the secret passage of Volcano Manor .

details.description: Large curved claws used by Bloodhound Knights. The curve allows the weapon to slip through an enemy's guard.

items.name: Bloodhound's Fang
items.acquisition: Curved Greatsword. Dropped by the boss of Forlorn Hound Evergaol , Bloodhound Knight Darriwil .

details.description: Curved greatsword with a gently undulating blade wielded by Bloodhound Knights. A fearsome blade capable of brutal airborne attacks.

items.name: Bloodstained Dagger
items.acquisition: Dropped by Demihuman chief/Demihuman assassin sleeping before the wooden bridge leading to the minor eldtree in the weeping peninsula.

details.description: Dagger with a bloodstained blade. Afflicts targets with blood loss. As blood darkened the dagger through repeated slashing and stabbing, its blade only grew sharper and harder.

items.name: Bloody Helice
items.acquisition: Can be found inside a chest, in the same room of the boss in Writheblood Ruins

details.description: Ominous piercing sword with a winding blade. Carried by the noble servants of the Lord of Blood. Designed to bore into flesh, causing severe blood loss at the wound. The extracted blood trickles gracefully down the length of the blade.

items.name: Bolt of Gransax
items.acquisition: Can be found in Leyndell, Royal Capital after beating Godfrey, First Elden Lord; walk outside of the west door, take the elevator down, and walk up the spear.

missable.lockedBy: Burning the Erdtree (Forge of the Giants)
missable.note: On the giant spear in the Avenue plaza of the Royal Capital; gone in the Ashen Capital.

details.description: Spear whittled from the weapon wielded by Gransax. One of the legendary armaments.  A great ancient dragon, Gransax once rained calamity upon the Royal Capital - the only time in historical record that Leyendell's walls have fallen. This marked the dawn of the war against dragons.

items.name: Bone Bow
items.acquisition: A Bone Bow can be found being protected by 2 giant Spider-Scorpions, inside the massive tower.

items.name: Bonny Butchering Knife
items.acquisition: Below a small shed, outside a house. Near the broken bridge.

items.name: Brick Hammer
items.acquisition: Can be found on the 3rd floor. It is in a corpse dangling from a window.You have to access from the 4th floor, using the wooden platforms outside.

details.description: Large iron warhammer designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike.

items.name: Broadsword
items.acquisition: A straight sword with a wide blade, suited to slashing attacks. Horizontal swings boast wide attack range, making it easier to connect with foes.

details.description: A straight sword with a wide blade, suited to slashing attacks. Horizontal swings boast wide attack range, making it easier to connect with foes.

items.name: Butchering Knife
items.acquisition: Greataxe . Dropped by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater .

details.description: Huge carving knife made to cleanly butcher the human body. Signature weapon of the Ogress Anastasia, known to have eaten countless Tarnished while disguised as a Finger Maiden.  Restores a very small amount of HP when it squarely strikes an enemy.

items.name: Caestus
items.acquisition: A weapon built for striking with the fists, made of tough leather inlaid with iron rivets. Fist weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will equip it to both hands.

details.description: A weapon built for striking with the fists, made of tough leather inlaid with iron rivets. Fist weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will equip it to both hands.

items.name: Cane Sword
items.acquisition: West Capital Ramparts Site of Grace, Go south out of the room with the site of grace and down the flight of stairs to the floor underneath, make a complete U-turn in the room with the stairs to find a corpse with the sword

details.description: Beloved sword of an aged knight whose last quest was long behind him, repurposed into a walking stick. The tip is rather worn.  Though bent of back and without the brawn required even to raise the sword aloft, still he wished to meet his end with weapon in hand.

items.name: Carian Glintblade Staff
items.acquisition: Staff. Found on the top floor of the Highway Lookout Tower in Liurnia .

details.description: Staff embedded with a blue glintstone. One of two types of Carian staff. Gifted to enchanted knights, it enhances Glintblade sorceries.

items.name: Carian Glintstone Staff
items.acquisition: Found at the Carian Study Hall.

details.description: Staff embedded with a blue glintstone. One of two types of Carian staff. Given to sorcerers that they might enact the role of knight. Enhances Carian sword sorceries.

items.name: Carian Knight's Sword
items.acquisition: Straight Sword. Found in a chest at the back of a large stagecoach being pulled by 2 Trolls.

details.description: Straight sword embedded with a blue glintstone.  Weapon of knights sworn to Carian royalty. These knights' swords could serve as catalysts, letting them wield sorcerous battle skills. Despite numbering fewer than twenty, this power made them a match for even the champions of gold in battle.

items.name: Carian Regal Scepter
items.acquisition: Magic scepter of Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. The glintstone is known as a Carian Blue, enhancing full moon sorceries. Only those of the highest intelligence may wield this, the finest of all glintstone staves.

details.description: Magic scepter of Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. The glintstone is known as a Carian Blue, enhancing full moon sorceries. Only those of the highest intelligence may wield this, the finest of all glintstone staves.

items.name: Carian Sorcery Sword
items.acquisition: In a chest after dropping down into Castle Ensis from Scadu Altus.

items.name: Celebrant's Cleaver
items.acquisition: Cleaver decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.

details.description: Cleaver decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.

items.name: Celebrant's Rib-Rake
items.acquisition: Rake decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.

details.description: Rake decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.

items.name: Celebrant's Sickle
items.acquisition: Sickle decorated with flowers and many-coloured fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes on landing attacks.

details.description: Sickle decorated with flowers and many-coloured fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes on landing attacks.

items.name: Celebrant's Skull
items.acquisition: Warhammer. Found on a corpse at the cliff directly north from Windmill village site of grace

details.description: Large bludgeon ecorated with flowers and many-colored fabrics.  Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village.   The striking end is a skull too large in size to be human. Grants trace amounts of runes on landing attacks.

items.name: Chainlink Flail
items.acquisition: A spiked iron tube attached by a chain wielded by Mad Pumpkin Heads. Especially large for a flail, wielding it requires more strength than it does dexterity.

details.description: A spiked iron tube attached by a chain wielded by Mad Pumpkin Heads. Especially large for a flail, wielding it requires more strength than it does dexterity.

items.name: Chilling Perfume Bottle
items.acquisition: Can be found within Lamenter's Gaol. In a small room at the lower floor area, the first room to the right after exiting the ladder room.

items.name: Cinquedea
items.acquisition: Dagger. Found outside the bestial sanctum, after a long series of platforms starting on the west side to drop down onto the external structure's base.

details.description: Short sword given to high ranking clergymen of Farum Azula. Raises potency of bestial incantations. The design celebrates a beast's five fingers, symbolic of the intelligence once granted upon their kind.

items.name: Cipher Pata
items.acquisition: One of the weapons originating from the Two Fingers. A formless sequence of ciphers comprise its blade, and as such no shield can repel it. Deals holy damage. The furtive inscription appears to hang in the air; the language of light spoken by the Two Fingers.

details.description: One of the weapons originating from the Two Fingers. A formless sequence of ciphers comprise its blade, and as such no shield can repel it. Deals holy damage. The furtive inscription appears to hang in the air; the language of light spoken by the Two Fingers.

items.name: Clawmark Seal
items.acquisition: A sacred seal given by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman. A rare trinket which allows incantations to be scaled with strength.  The claw mark represents Gurranq's wrath. Enhances bestial incantations learned from Gurranq.

details.description: A sacred seal given by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman. A rare trinket which allows incantations to be scaled with strength.  The claw mark represents Gurranq's wrath. Enhances bestial incantations learned from Gurranq.

items.name: Claws of Night
items.acquisition: Dropped by NPC invader Swordhand of Night Anna, found in the ruins underneath Cathedral of Manus Metyr. This area can only be accessed by progressing Ymir's questline.

items.name: Clayman's Harpoon
items.acquisition: Harpoon with a tip made from a sharpened meteorite shard. Wielded by the claymen who infest dynastic remains. The blade emits a faint light and deals magic damage.

details.description: Harpoon with a tip made from a sharpened meteorite shard. Wielded by the claymen who infest dynastic remains. The blade emits a faint light and deals magic damage.

items.name: Claymore
items.acquisition: Greatsword. From the main courtyard entrance, hug the right wall past the burning corpses and harpies to reach the entrance to the building in the north. The sword is found in a chest to the left as you enter.

details.description: A large sword with a long, straight blade. This heavy sword is usually wielded with two hands, but for those with enough strength, one is sufficient. In addition to the heavy sweeping attacks, it can also make a heavy piercing thrust making this a versatile weapon.

items.name: Cleanrot Knight's Sword
items.acquisition: Piercing sword of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Mainly used as a backup weapon, in combination with a long- handled armament.

details.description: Piercing sword of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Mainly used as a backup weapon, in combination with a long- handled armament.

items.name: Cleanrot Spear
items.acquisition: Spear of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Melania, Blade of Miquella. The winged golden blade deals holy damage. The diminutive shieldd is blessed with an incnantation that wards off rot.

details.description: Spear of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Melania, Blade of Miquella. The winged golden blade deals holy damage. The diminutive shieldd is blessed with an incnantation that wards off rot.

items.name: Clinging Bone
items.acquisition: Horrific weapon made of a hardened skeletal arm. Wielded by Ensha of the Royal Remains. Fitted by placing one's hands into the fists' grips until they dig in. ""O clinging creature. A king relinquishes not the hand.""

details.description: Horrific weapon made of a hardened skeletal arm. Wielded by Ensha of the Royal Remains. Fitted by placing one's hands into the fists' grips until they dig in. ""O clinging creature. A king relinquishes not the hand.""

items.name: Club
items.acquisition: A thick, solid lump of wood. Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill. A simple, primitive weapon that requires only brute strength and persistence to hammer your foe into the ground.

details.description: A thick, solid lump of wood. Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill. A simple, primitive weapon that requires only brute strength and persistence to hammer your foe into the ground.

items.name: Coded Sword
items.acquisition: Found in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Look for an abandoned horse stable, then climb onto its roof and enter the building. Keep going until you find a broken round table. Look for the double door. Inside that room you will find the coded sword.

details.description: Hidden sword once granted to the Tarnished of the Roundtable by the Two Fingers. A formless cipher comprises its blade, which deals holy damage no shield can repel. Champions would gather at the Roundtable Hold in days long past, when the Two Fingers were masters of oration, their flesh yet full of vigor.

items.name: Commander's Standard
items.acquisition: Halberd. Dropped by Commander O'Neil upon defeat.

details.description: A beaten red battle standard is furled around this time-worn halberd. Even after his lord was fled, Commander O'Neil continued to brandish this flag in the devastation of the rot-eaten field of battle, the sole veteran who remembers this battle with pride.

items.name: Composite Bow
items.acquisition: Bow composited from a mix of Materials.  Demands high attributes, and is tricky to wield, but is a fearsome tool when mastered.

details.description: Bow composited from a mix of Materials.  Demands high attributes, and is tricky to wield, but is a fearsome tool when mastered.

items.name: Cranial Vessel Candlestand
items.acquisition: Warhammer. Found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave on a corpse at the end of the large hall locked behind an Imp Statue barrier. This is directly above the room with the flamethrower pillar.

details.description: Candlestand used in worship of Birac, the most hallowed Monk Prelate of the Giants' Flame. Concerned over the lazy arrogance with which the monks treated the Flame, Birac severed his own head as a lesson to the others, intending it be used as a  candlestand. His faith yet smolders from within the cranial vessel.

items.name: Crepus's Black-Key Crossbow
items.acquisition: Black crossbow featuring a long stock. Used for sniping, it has a very long range. Weapon of Crepus, who served the Two Fingers from the shadows of the Roundtable as the head confessor.

details.description: Black crossbow featuring a long stock. Used for sniping, it has a very long range. Weapon of Crepus, who served the Two Fingers from the shadows of the Roundtable as the head confessor.

items.name: Crescent Moon Axe
items.acquisition: Greataxe with a large, arcing blade and long handle. The "Crescent Moon" of its name is said to have been spurred by nostalgia. Specializes in sweeping through foes by making use of its long handle.

details.description: Greataxe with a large, arcing blade and long handle. The "Crescent Moon" of its name is said to have been spurred by nostalgia. Specializes in sweeping through foes by making use of its long handle.

items.name: Cross-Naginata
items.acquisition: Spear. Found on a corpse inside the Gael Tunnel , in the cavern filled with Land Octopi and a single Giant Land Octopus.

details.description: Weapon consisting of a three-pronged blade affixed to a long pole. The long central blade closely resembles a katana. A weapon of the Land of Reeds, known for its ability to be wielded as a spear while still being capable of performing slashing attacks.

items.name: Crystal Knife
items.acquisition: Dagger. Found in a chest inside the storage room in the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel protected by Marionettes.

details.description: A knife made by sharpening hard crystal. Signature weapon of glintstone miners.  Used as a tool to extract glintstone from broken rock, and as such a faint magic enwreathes the blade.

items.name: Crystal Spear
items.acquisition: Can be found inside Sellia Hideaway . It can be found in a chest to the right of the entrance of the second room with huge crystal formations. The hidden wall is on the left side of a corpse

details.description: Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. The inscrutable Crystalians have but one clear purpose; to safeguard their crystals unto the end. One theory posits that they yearn for the return of their creator who will carve for them new brethren.

items.name: Crystal Staff
items.acquisition: Crystal Staff can be found in Academy Crystal Cave . It's in a room guarded by a sorcerer behind a fog wall, located right before the boss gate. The path to the chest containing the staff is through an illusory rock wall on the left side of the tunnel, just before the stone archway.

details.description: Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enhances Crystalian sorceris. The Crystalian's faint cognition is know as the "wisdom of stone." This staff can only be weilded by those of intellect high enough to grasp such wisdom.

items.name: Crystal Sword
items.acquisition: CStraight Sword. Can be found at Village of the Albinaurics . Past the well and the wooden bridge, on a body near the edge.

details.description: Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. The inscrutable Crystalians have but one clear purpose; to safeguard their crystals unto the end. One theory posits that they yearn for the return of their creator who will carve for them new brethren.

items.name: Curved Club
items.acquisition: Hard, curved club, shaped like a crescent moon. Wielded instead of a curved sword by Albinaurics lacking dexterity. The only point of similarity between the two is the shape.

details.description: Hard, curved club, shaped like a crescent moon. Wielded instead of a curved sword by Albinaurics lacking dexterity. The only point of similarity between the two is the shape.

items.name: Curved Great Club
items.acquisition: Large curved club of hard wood, shaped like a crescent moon. Wielded by Albinaurics lacking the dexterity demanded by a curved sword, and who prefer the added weight and destructive force.

details.description: Large curved club of hard wood, shaped like a crescent moon. Wielded by Albinaurics lacking the dexterity demanded by a curved sword, and who prefer the added weight and destructive force.

items.name: Dagger
items.acquisition: Looted from a Foot Soldier upon defeat.

details.description: A standard dagger with a straight blade.  Though modest in reach and capacity fo harm, this weapon is light enough to jab in rapid succession and delivers devastating critical hits.

items.name: Dancing Blade of Ranah
items.acquisition: Dropped by defeating Dancer of Ranah at the Southern Nameless Mausoleum

items.name: Dark Moon Greatsword
items.acquisition: Greatsword . Found below the Cathedral of Manus Celes after progressing Ranni 's questline.

details.description: A Moon Greatsword, bestowed by a Carian queen upon her spouse to honor long-standing tradition. One of the legendary armaments. Ranni's sigil is a full moon, cold and leaden, and this sword is but a beam of its light.

items.name: Deadly Poison Perfume Bottle
items.acquisition: Can be purchased from the Thiollier for 9000 Runes.

items.name: Death Knight's Longhaft Axe
items.acquisition: The weapon is obtained as a reward for defeating the Death Knight boss located at the Scorpion River Catacombs .

items.name: Death Knight's Twin Axes
items.acquisition: The weapon is obtained as a reward for defeating the Death Knight boss located at the Fog Rift Catacombs .

items.name: Death Ritual Spear
items.acquisition: Spear. Dropped by the Death Rite Bird boss upon defeat.

details.description: Ritual spear used by priests of old who were permitted to come among the Deathbirds. The priests became guardians of the birds through the rite of Death, which also serves as an oath sworn to their distant resurrection.

items.name: Death's Poker
items.acquisition: Greatsword. Dropped by miniboss Death Rite Bird that appears only at night.

details.description: Barbed rod carried by Deathbirds. The birds are graveyard fire keepers; it is said they rake out the ashen remains of the dead from their kilns.

items.name: Demi-Human Queen's Staff
items.acquisition: Dropped by the Demi-Human Queen elite enemy in Demi-Human Forest Ruins.

details.description: Glintstone staff styled as a scepter. A gift once given to the demi-humans to foster peace, it can be wielded even by those of low intelligence. Sneered at by fools in the academy.

items.name: Devonia's Hammer
items.acquisition: Devonia, Crucible Knight, Grants 16289 runes, and drops Devonia's Hammer , and Crucible Hammer-Helm .

items.name: Devourer's Scepter
items.acquisition: Great Hammer. Dropped by the invader Recusant Bernahl upon defeat.

details.description: Scepter in the shape of a serpent devouring the world. This weapon will one day become the very symbol of the Lord of  Blasphemy. One of the legendary armaments. A vision of the future briefly seen by Rykard in his final moments before being devoured by the great serpent.

items.name: Digger's Staff
items.acquisition: Drops from Diggers inside the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel .

details.description: Staff of a sorcerer-miner who extracts glintstone from crystal tunnels. The staff itself is a tool used to mine, and the ferrule is also embedded with a glintstone.   Boosts the power of Stonedigger sorceries

items.name: Dismounter
items.acquisition: This curved greatsword wielded by the brawny sellswords of Kaiden combines the blades of a scimitar with the heft of a hatchet.  A difficult to handle weapon that demands much of the wielder's strength and dexterity, but with practice and ability, it can serve as a versatile weapon even on horseback.

details.description: This curved greatsword wielded by the brawny sellswords of Kaiden combines the blades of a scimitar with the heft of a hatchet.  A difficult to handle weapon that demands much of the wielder's strength and dexterity, but with practice and ability, it can serve as a versatile weapon even on horseback.

items.name: Dragon Communion Seal
items.acquisition: Found in the Fringefolk Hero's Grave . Progress down the tunnel with the mechanized chariot until the path splits and you can go either up or down. Go up until you reach the end of the tunnel and inside the small room is an enemy that once killed will give you the weapon.

details.description: Formless drakeblood seal with a dragon communion crest. Enhances Dragon Communion incantations. The sacrificial devouring of the heart gives power. Indeed, Dragon Communion is too primal in nature for the term "incantation" to be appropriate. This seal scales incantations with one's arcane attribute.

items.name: Dragon Greatclaw
items.acquisition: Colossal Weapon that drops from the Draconic Tree Sentinel

details.description: Weapon said to have been whittled from the claw of a great, ancient dragon, wielded by grotesque Tree Sentinels who yet serve the Erdtree. The claw is enwreathed with lightning,and tears through the dragons' feeble descendants with ease.

items.name: Dragon Halberd
items.acquisition: Halberd. Obtained when defeating the Dragonkin Soldier in Siofra River .

details.description: Halberd shaped like a dragon, enwreathed with both ice and lightning. Alas, the Dragonkin Soldiers never attained immortality, and perished as decrepit, pale imitations of their skyborn kin.

items.name: Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana
items.acquisition: Dropped by the Ancient Dragon-Man mini-boss located in the Dragon's Pit.

items.name: Dragon King's Cragblade
items.acquisition: Piercing Gravel Stone sword containing primeval lightning. A portion of the Dragonlord's power, gained from a remembrance. This weapon commands great power over the paltry, mortal dragons of today.

details.description: Piercing Gravel Stone sword containing primeval lightning. A portion of the Dragonlord's power, gained from a remembrance. This weapon commands great power over the paltry, mortal dragons of today.

items.name: Dragonscale Blade
items.acquisition: Dropped by Dragonkin Soldier

details.description: A weapon made by sharpening a Gravel Stone scale, thought to be the source of ancient dragon immortality, into an unclouded blade. Alas, the Dragonkin Soldiers never attained immortality, and perished as decrepit, pale imitations of their skyborn kin.

items.name: Dryleaf Seal
items.acquisition: Sacred Seal looted from a platform under the message in the lower areas of this region.

items.name: Duelist Greataxe
items.acquisition: Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. A weapon reserved for duelist champions, the charge attack is particularly ferocious.

details.description: Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. A weapon reserved for duelist champions, the charge attack is particularly ferocious.

items.name: Eclipse Shotel
items.acquisition: Curved Sword. Found at the altar of the Church in the southeast section of the castle.

details.description: Storied sword and treasure of Castle Sol that depicts an eclipsed sun drained of color. One of the legendary armaments. In Sol, the sight of an eclipse inspires a dreadful awe, preventing an onlooker from averting his gaze.

items.name: Eleonora's Poleblade
items.acquisition: Dropped by Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger

details.description: Twinned naginata forged in the Land of Reeds. Chosen weapon of Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger. Her mastery of the sword was such that her onslaught was likened to a whirlwind, but now her legacy is stained by accursed blood.

items.name: Envoy's Greathorn
items.acquisition: Fanned golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

details.description: Fanned golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

items.name: Envoy's Horn
items.acquisition: Golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

items.name: Envoy's Long Horn
items.acquisition: Long golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

items.name: Erdsteel Dagger
items.acquisition: Dagger. Rewarded by Kenneth Haight for clearing out Fort Haight .

details.description: An erdsteel dagger with a grass crest engraved upon its blade. Carried by the Erdtree royalty for self-defense in times of peace.  Though forged to a high standard, the weapon is difficult to wield.  Attack power also scales with faith.

items.name: Erdtree Bow
items.acquisition: Climb the root found at the east, head up to the west, once outside again, jump on the roof to the left and enter inside the window. Loot the chest.

details.description: Longbow featuring Erdtree styling. In times of old, when faith and battle went hand in hand, this weapon was created in tandem with the Golden Arrow. Scales all arrow damage with faith, revealing its true worth when used with holy-infused arrows.

items.name: Erdtree Greatbow
items.acquisition: Dropped from the Chariot inside Fringefolk Hero's Grave

details.description: Greatbow featuring Erdtree styling. In times of old, when faith and battle went hand in hand, this weapon was created in tandem with the Golden Great Arrow. Scales all arrow damage with faith, revealing its true worth when used with holy-infused arrows.

items.name: Erdtree Seal
items.acquisition: Sacred Seal. Found on a corpse in a building close to the Omenkiller in the Volcano Manor dungeon.

details.description: A formless sacred seal decorated with an Erdtree crest, once the focus of religion in the Lands Between. Even though the Elden Ring is shattered, and the Erdtree has dulled from its former radiance, earnest faith continues to hold the answers.

items.name: Estoc
items.acquisition: Large piercing sword with a long, hard bladed edge which is also capable of slashing attacks.  For its large size, it can be wirleded rather nimbly, leaving little opportunity for the enemy to counter.

details.description: Large piercing sword with a long, hard bladed edge which is also capable of slashing attacks.  For its large size, it can be wirleded rather nimbly, leaving little opportunity for the enemy to counter.

items.name: Euporia
items.acquisition: Found after dropping down a secret area in Enir Ilim, after doing some difficult platforming

items.name: Executioner's Greataxe
items.acquisition: Bulky cleaver welded to a long haft. Said to have been used to dispatch the remnants of defeated armies, felling them like timber. Perhaps that is the reason it excels at critical hits.

details.description: Bulky cleaver welded to a long haft. Said to have been used to dispatch the remnants of defeated armies, felling them like timber. Perhaps that is the reason it excels at critical hits.

items.name: Falchion
items.acquisition: Dropped by Demi-Human enemies under the bridge.

details.description: A curved sword with a single-sided blade. Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against thick armor and hides covered in tough scales. Wielders of the weapon employ a unique style that enhances attacks with spinning motions.

items.name: Fallingstar Beast Jaw
items.acquisition: Colossal Weapon Dropped by Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast

details.description: Part of a Falling star Beast's jaw, hard and shining black, fashioned into a weapon.  With its sharp point, this colossal weapon can skewer foes.

items.name: Falx
items.acquisition: Dropped by Hornsent when he is defeated in the staircase leading to the Church of the Bud in Ancient Ruins of Rauh after invading you.

items.name: Family Heads
items.acquisition: Flail. Dropped from boss of Sage's Cave , Necromancer Garris.

details.description: Three bludgeoning copper heads attached to a handle by chains. Signature weapon of Necromancer Garris, the heretical sage. The heads were made to resemble those of his wife and two children.

items.name: Finger Seal
items.acquisition: A sacred seal given by maidens of the Finger Readers which serves as a catalyst for casting sacred incantations. Incantations must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a sacred seal must be equipped to cast them.

details.description: A sacred seal given by maidens of the Finger Readers which serves as a catalyst for casting sacred incantations. Incantations must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a sacred seal must be equipped to cast them.

items.name: Fire Knight's Seal
items.acquisition: Shadow Keep . In the area with the giant Queen Marika statue, it is behind the statue. You have to use the lever to lower the water level.

items.name: Firespark Perfume Bottle
items.acquisition: Weapon. Found in a chest guarded by both Perfumers and Messmer Soldiers.

items.name: Flail
items.acquisition: It can be found in a charriot, defended by a group of soldiers. near the Gatefront Ruins

details.description: Weapon consisting of a bludgeoning head attached to a handle by chain. The iron ball is spiked and induces blood loss.  Blows from this weapon cannot be parried. The charge attack whirls the iron ball around for increased force before striking.

items.name: Flamberge
items.acquisition: Greatsword found on a corpse on the roof of the building in the southeast of Redmane Castle .

details.description: Greatsword featuring a flame-like undulation. Shreds enemy flesh, inducing blood loss.  Scarlet rot is kept at bay with flame at Redmane Castle, and as such, this beloved sword of Jerren's eventually became the symbol of the castle itself.

items.name: Flowerstone Gavel
items.acquisition: The Dragon Communion Priestess drops this item at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion after defeating Bayle The Dread.

items.name: Flowing Curved Sword
items.acquisition: Curved Sword. Found within the chest of the Enemy Caravan traveling the Consecrated Snowfield south-western area.

details.description: Legends speak of a master of the sword garbed in blue, and his curved blade that was patterned after flowing water. Strong attack unleashes a series of strikes akin to a dance, offering a glimpse into the legend. Skill: Spinning Slash Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

items.name: Forked Greatsword
items.acquisition: Oddly shaped greatsword wielded by imps. The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue"                   and causes blood loss.

details.description: Oddly shaped greatsword wielded by imps. The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue"                   and causes blood loss.

items.name: Forked Hatchet
items.acquisition: Peculiar hatchet wielded by imps. The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.

details.description: Peculiar hatchet wielded by imps. The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.

items.name: Frenzied Flame Seal
items.acquisition: Weapon. Reward from completing Hyetta's Questline. Hyetta can be finally found at Frenzied Flame Proscription, Leyndell, Royal Capital. Upon accepting the Three Fingers flame, return to Hyetta and talk to her once more. Exhaust her dialogue, and she will give you the Frenzied Flame Seal, completing her questline.

details.description: Formless sacred seal bestowed by the maiden of the Three Fingers. Enhances incantations of the frenzied flame. This seal is the mark of the Lord of Frenzied Flame. Scales incantations using strength, dexterity, intelligence, and faith all together.

items.name: Frenzyflame Perfume Bottle
items.acquisition: The weapon is looted from a dead body located by the northern interior of the Abandoned Church.

items.name: Freyja's Greatsword
items.acquisition: Can be looted from Freyja's body after defeating her in Enir-Ilim .

items.name: Frozen Needle
items.acquisition: Thrusting Sword. Found in a chest inside a small room in an underground area of the ruins. The Royal Revenant needs to be defeated to gain access to this room.

details.description: A razor-thin piercing blade of ice. Forged by Ijii, the carian Royal Blackmith. Can inflict frost upon enemies, and launch its blade with a strong attack.  The blade immediately regenerates.

items.name: Full Moon Crossbow
items.acquisition: Weapon. From the Debate Parlor Site of Grace, head out into the courtyard and to the left to reach the rooftops. Continue along the rooftops until the tower past the Glintstone Sorcerer and three Avionette Soldiers. Across from the tower on another rooftop, an item will be visible. Drop down to the rooftop below and jump on top of the spike near the right edge. From the spike, turn left and jump onto the gargoyle (architectural, not an enemy) protruding from a corner of the building. Another jump will bring you to the rooftop with the item, a Smithing Stone [4]. Alternatively, you can reach this item by jumping from the tower onto a roof opposite the Full Moon Crossbow's chest in the tower. From that roof, a long jump will be required to reach the rooftops with the patrolling Marionette Soldier with spears. Sprinting before the jump is required, as a normal jump will not cover the distance. Note that there is a delay before sprinting starts (likely to determine whether the player is trying to roll or sprint). Continue along the rooftops to the left, past the four Marionette Soldiers and jump onto a platform connected to a tower. Inside, two Marionette Soldiers will ambush you from either side. Climb up the ladder to find a chest with the Full Moon Crossbow.

details.description: One-of-a-kind enchanted crossbow of exquisitely detailed craftsmanship. Made to celebrate the matrimonial union, and reconciliation, between the houses of the Erdtree and the Full Moon, Leyndell and Raya Lucaria. The two rings dance when reloading the weapon. Reveals true worth when used with holy- infused bolts.

items.name: Gargoyle's Black Axe
items.acquisition: Greataxe. Dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the path to the Grand Lift of Rold .

details.description: Bronze greataxe wielded by Valiant Gargoyle, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage. Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

items.name: Gargoyle's Black Blades
items.acquisition: Twinblades. Dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the path to the Grand Lift of Rold .

details.description: Bronze twinblade wielded by Valiant Gargoyle, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage. Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

items.name: Gargoyle's Black Halberd
items.acquisition: Halberd dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the entrance to the Bestial Sanctum .

details.description: Bronze halberd wielded by Valiant Gargoyle, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage. Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

items.name: Gargoyle's Blackblade
items.acquisition: Greatsword dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the entrance to the Bestial Sanctum .

details.description: Broze greatsword wielded by Valiant Gargoyle mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage.  Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

items.name: Gargoyle's Great Axe
items.acquisition: Dropped by Gargoyle . From the Outer Wall Phantom Tree .Site of Grace go northeast the Slope/long Stairs up until it spawns.

details.description: Description  "Bronze greataxe wielded by Valiant Gargoyle. Just like the wielder, the missing part have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions."

items.name: Gargoyle's Greatsword
items.acquisition: Dropped by the Valiant Gargoyle when both bosses are defeated

details.description: Bronze greatsword wielded by Valiant Gargoyle.  Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.

items.name: Gargoyle's Halberd
items.acquisition: Dropped by the Lesser Black Blade Kindred.

details.description: Bronze halberd wielded by Valiant Gargoyle Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.

items.name: Gargoyle's Twinblade
items.acquisition: Dropped by Vailant Gargoyle (Twinblade) when both bosses are defeated

details.description: Bronze twinblade wielded by Valiant Gargoyle.  just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.

items.name: Gelmir Glintstone Staff
items.acquisition: Staff with a forked tip, embedded with red glintstones. Enhances lava sorceries.  The Man-Serpents of Mt. Gelmir draw from faith in addition to intelligence to enhance the potency of their sorcery.

details.description: Staff with a forked tip, embedded with red glintstones. Enhances lava sorceries.  The Man-Serpents of Mt. Gelmir draw from faith in addition to intelligence to enhance the potency of their sorcery.

items.name: Ghiza's Wheel
items.acquisition: Colossal Weapon. Dropped by Inquisitor Ghiza in Volcano Manor .

details.description: Great iron wheel lined with flesh-flaying blades. Device of torture used by Inquisitor Ghiza. As the wheel spins it causes severe pain and blood loss. The design was adopted for use as the iconic weapon wielded by Iron Virgins.

items.name: Ghostflame Torch
items.acquisition: Ghostflame Torch can be found on a body at Nokron, Eternal City. To find it, you must start from the beginning of Nokron, Eternal City, entering from the Meteorite Crater. Once you get to the first set of rooves in Nokron, you will see a derelict tower off to the right of the roof ramp. You will need to jump from the ramp to the tower to reach torch. There is no other way to reach the Ghostflame Torch if you proceed to the lower roof platforms of Nokron. There is no way back up except to start over from the Crater again.

details.description: Metal torch that burns with cold ghostflame. Tool of the Fallen Hawks who prowl the underground rivers. When the band's last embers were used up in their long search, they began to burn the bones of their fellows, acquiring the cold ghostflame, but sealing their fate as dwellers of the underground for all eternity.

items.name: Giant-Crusher
items.acquisition: Colossal Weapon. Can be found in a chest inside an unmarked military camp directly to the south of Outer Wall Phantom Tree site of grace.

details.description: A hammer made from a boulder, used in the War against the Giants. One of the heftiest weapons in the entire Lands Between. After the giants were quelled, and man turned against man in violence, this weapon was all but forgotten. Man has grown feeble in comparison to his forebears.

items.name: Giant's Red Braid
items.acquisition: Hefty whip woven from the flame-red hair of a Fire Giant. Every giant is red of hair, and Radagon was said to have despised his own red locks. Perhaps that was a curse of their kind.

details.description: Hefty whip woven from the flame-red hair of a Fire Giant. Every giant is red of hair, and Radagon was said to have despised his own red locks. Perhaps that was a curse of their kind.

items.name: Giant's Seal
items.acquisition: Sacred Seal found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave : In the large hall with the Troll, drop down from either side of the platform into a room with a Prelate . Defeat it and check the right side of the room for a corpse holding the seal. Alternatively, you can reach this room by descending the lift and sending it back up. Pull the lever in the alcove to the right and then enter the small space in the raised lift to descend further down. In the next hall, sprint past the Lesser Burial Watchdog and turn left. Climb the ladder at the end of this path.

details.description: Sacred seal depicting the one eyed god of the Fire Giants, adorned with braids of red hair. Sacred seal wielded by Fire Monks and Prelates, this catalyst enhances Giants' Flame incantations.

items.name: Glaive
items.acquisition: Weapon comprised of a sharp blade affixed to a long grip. It is in fact a sickle repurposed to be a tool of war. This far-reaching weapon excels at slashing attacks.

details.description: Weapon comprised of a sharp blade affixed to a long grip. It is in fact a sickle repurposed to be a tool of war. This far-reaching weapon excels at slashing attacks.

items.name: Glintstone Kris
items.acquisition: Ritual blade once presented to Leyndell by the Academy of Raya Lucaria to celebrate their newfound peace. Though the weapon is embedded with precious glintstones and features Erdtree ornamentation, the undulating blade is symbolic of an ancient ritual.

details.description: Ritual blade once presented to Leyndell by the Academy of Raya Lucaria to celebrate their newfound peace. Though the weapon is embedded with precious glintstones and features Erdtree ornamentation, the undulating blade is symbolic of an ancient ritual.

items.name: Glintstone Staff
items.acquisition: Staff with a glintstone embedded at the tip. A catalyst for casting sorceries.  Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.

details.description: Staff with a glintstone embedded at the tip. A catalyst for casting sorceries.  Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.

items.name: Godskin Peeler
items.acquisition: Dropped by the Godskin Apostle fought at the Windmill Village .

details.description: Unique twinblade wielded by Godskin Apostles characterized by its disturbing design. One end features a sickle for slicing attacks while the other boasts a winding spike for boring into flesh. Much skill is required to wield this weapon due to its asymmetric nature.

items.name: Godskin Stitcher
items.acquisition: Dropped by Godskin Noble

details.description: Elegant piercing sword with a celadon colored blade wielded by Godskin Nobles. The nobles possess skill with the sword unmatched by any lowborn. Despite its size, successive attacks from this weapon are swifter than the eye can follow.

items.name: Godslayer's Greatsword
items.acquisition: Greatsword found in a chest in a room behind the Godskin Apostle's arena at the Divine Tower of Caelid after defeating him.

details.description: Sacred sword of the Dusk-Eyed Queen who controlled the Godskin Apostles before her defeat at the hands of Maliketh. The black flames wielded by the apostles are channeled from this sword.

items.name: Godslayer's Seal
items.acquisition: Found in a room barred by an Imp Statue seal, requiring a to access. From the Rampart Tower, take the lift that leads to the Grafted Scion 's hall. Exit into the courtyard where plenty of Castle Guards are mounted on ballistae. Take a hard left from this exit to find a small stairway leading into a cellar. There are several Rats in this cellar and the Imp Statue barrier behind them. The Seal is found in one of the chests behind the barrier.

details.description: Sacred seal of the Godskin Apostles, inlaid with obsidian. Said to represent the manipulation of black flame, this catalyst enhances godslayer incantations.

items.name: Golden Epitaph
items.acquisition: Straight Sword . Found on a corpse in a room locked behind an Imp Statue Seal just past the Site of Grace. Use a Stonesword Key to unlock the seal and beware the Basilisk guarding the treasure.

details.description: A sword made to commemorate the death of Godwyn the Golden, first of the demigods to die. Infused with the humble prayer of a young boy; "O brother, lord brother, please die a true death."

items.name: Golden Halberd
items.acquisition: Drops from Tree Sentinel

details.description: Weighty halberd forged of gold. Wielded by the Order of Tree Sentinels, heavily equipped knights.  Deals holy damage. A masterfully crafted weapon that lives up to its heft, but is difficult for one mere human strength to wield.

items.name: Golden Order Greatsword
items.acquisition: Found inside Cave of the Forlorn . Dropped by Misbegotten Crusader

details.description: Greatsword made of light, modeled after the Elden Ring itself. Forged by King Consort Radagon to proudly symbolize the tenets of the Golden Order. One of the legendary armaments. Telltale signs betray that this was once the greatsword bequeathed to him by his first wife, Rennala.

items.name: Golden Order Seal
items.acquisition: Found right at the base of the Minor Erdtree surrounded by the remains of the Church.

details.description: A formless sacred seal depicting the ceremonial observation of Order. Enhances Golden Fundamentalist incantations.  Fundamentalism is scholarship in all but name. Scales incantation using both intelligence and faith.

items.name: Golem Greatbow
items.acquisition: Chance to drop by Golem Archer.

details.description: Greatbow of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Weapon of the Guardian Golem. Extremely heavy, this greatbow requires enormous strength just to draw, suggesting it was not designed for human use.

items.name: Golem's Halberd
items.acquisition: Dropped by one of the Golems at the bridge.

details.description: A great halberd of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Wielded by the Guardian Golem.

items.name: Grafted Blade Greatsword
items.acquisition: Greatsword. Dropped by Leonine Misbegotten upon defeat.

details.description: The storied sword of Castle Morne. A revenger's weapon, it is burdened with oceans of anger and regret.  One of the legendary armaments.  A lone surviving champion from a country now vanished was so determined to continue fighting that he claimed the swords of an entire clan of warriors.

items.name: Grafted Dragon
items.acquisition: The embodiment of the power that still remained in the dragon's head that was granted to Godrick's left arm. The wielder's arm will take the form of a small dragon, sprouting sharp dragon fangs at the fist. This weapon cannot be two-handed.

details.description: The embodiment of the power that still remained in the dragon's head that was granted to Godrick's left arm. The wielder's arm will take the form of a small dragon, sprouting sharp dragon fangs at the fist. This weapon cannot be two-handed.

items.name: Grave Scythe
items.acquisition: Greatscythe comprised of a large blade affixed to a crooked stick. Weapon wielded by the aged grave keepers who tend the forgotten graveyards throughout the Lands Between. This weapon is said to have served as a charm against evil spirits in times of old.

details.description: Greatscythe comprised of a large blade affixed to a crooked stick. Weapon wielded by the aged grave keepers who tend the forgotten graveyards throughout the Lands Between. This weapon is said to have served as a charm against evil spirits in times of old.

items.name: Gravel Stone Seal
items.acquisition: From the West Capital Rampart site of grace in Leyndell, walk north to the next room with the single guard inside. Jump over the balcony railing to get to the area next to the Fortified Manor with the dragon foot. The knight with the spear supported by an archer drops this seal.

items.name: Great Club
items.acquisition: Hammer Weapon. Dropped by the Stonedigger Troll boss inside the Old Altus Tunnel upon defeat.

details.description: An enormous club of hardwood. Wildly hammering foes with this striking weapon requires no dexterity; only brute force. While it may seem sacrilegious, this weapon is said to be a withered branch of the Erdtree. Imbued with holy power, this weapon will never snap.

items.name: Great Épée
items.acquisition: Head southeast from the Agheel Lake South site of grace, head to the top of a cliff and you'll see a statue of an object that looks like the half piece of a bowl or a circle. Face the other way, and get down, you will find a group of enemies. The Great Epee is inside a chest. on the right side.

details.description: Large rapier featuring a thin, sharp blade.  Commonly used in life or death duels. Like its smaller counterparts, its made for thrusting attacks, and can be used while guarding with a shield.

items.name: Great Katana
items.acquisition: The Great Katana can be found next to the sleeping Ghostflame Dragon on the lake, west of the Abandoned Ailing Village site of grace.

items.name: Great Knife
items.acquisition: Large knife with a broad, curved blade. This weapon is designed to Spinning Slash and rend, inflicting blood loss upon the recipient.

details.description: Large knife with a broad, curved blade. This weapon is designed to Spinning Slash and rend, inflicting blood loss upon the recipient.

items.name: Great Mace
items.acquisition: Can be found inside a chest, in the bandit camp.

details.description: Huge bludgeon with sharp protrusions. An enlarged version of its smaller cousin. Maintains all the advantages of smaller bludgeons, boasting few deficiencies while being very capable at breaking enemy guards and stances. A shrewd choice for simple slugging matches.

items.name: Great Omenkiller Cleaver
items.acquisition: Greataxe. Dropped by the boss duo of Perfumer's Grotto : Omenkiller and Miranda the Blighted Bloom .

details.description: The blade of this huge, loathsome cleaver comprises a row of amputated Omen horns. Weapon of slaughter wielded by Omen ktillers. The hideous horns cause blood loss, adding vibrant colors to the ongoing mayhem.

items.name: Great Stars
items.acquisition: On a guarded wagon in Altus Plateau, traveling on the road SouthWest of the Road of Iniquity Side Path site of grace.

details.description: Huge bludgeon with three stars at the striking end. Though primarily a striking weapon, the stars' spikes cause blood loss. A blood-stained star is an ill omen, a fact not lost upon those against whom this weapon is brought to bear. Landing attacks slightly restores HP.

items.name: Greataxe
items.acquisition: Found inside the treasure chest within the carriage being pulled by two large Trolls and defended by militia and aristocracy.

details.description: Greatxe akin to a huge lump of iron. Recognized as the weapon of choice of badland chieftains. Too heavy to be wielded by those of merely ordinary strength, blows from this axe will flatten enemies, and the force of its charged attack is a sight to behold.

items.name: Greatbow
items.acquisition: Found in a chest at the top of the Highway Lookout Tower .

details.description: Enormous greatbow larger than any man. Can not be drawn with any ordinary level of strength, but the force of its shots is extraordinary. A greatbow can only fire great arrows.

items.name: Greathorn Hammer
items.acquisition: Dropped by Ancestral Follower located in Siofra River

details.description: Huge thick horn carved with tree ring-like markings adapted into a bludgeoning weapon. Wielded by ancestral follower warriors. The ancient horn is imbued with the power of ancestral spirits. A small amount of HP is restored upon defeating an enemy.

items.name: Greatsword
items.acquisition: Colossal Sword. Looted from the chest in the enemy caravan traveling the Caelid Highway .

details.description: A coarse iron lump of an ultra greatsword. Mows down foes by utilizing its incredible weight. Though handling it likely requires the wielder to have surpassed the realm of the merely human, it is precisely for this reason the weapon is used to slaughter even inhuman foes.

items.name: Greatsword of Solitude
items.acquisition: This item is obtained after defeating the Blackgaol Knight . This boss is located inside the Western Nameless Mausoleum.

items.name: Grossmesser
items.acquisition: Curved sword boasting a large blade.  This weapon is designed to make use of its weight in combination with its sharp cutting edge.  A thoroughly reliable choice of weapon for those who can master its particulars.

details.description: Curved sword boasting a large blade.  This weapon is designed to make use of its weight in combination with its sharp cutting edge.  A thoroughly reliable choice of weapon for those who can master its particulars.

items.name: Guardian's Swordspear
items.acquisition: Weapon comprising a long handle and broad blade sharpened from the hard wood of old trees.  Wielded by guardians of the Minor Erdtrees, known as experts in the arts of combat. The power of this weapon scales greatly with dexterity.

details.description: Weapon comprising a long handle and broad blade sharpened from the hard wood of old trees.  Wielded by guardians of the Minor Erdtrees, known as experts in the arts of combat. The power of this weapon scales greatly with dexterity.

items.name: Halberd
items.acquisition: A long-handed polearm that combines the functions of both axe and spear.  Can be used to press a single enemy with continuous thrusting attacks or swept at groups, taking advantage of its great reach and cleaving blade. A versatile weapon for any situation.

details.description: A long-handed polearm that combines the functions of both axe and spear.  Can be used to press a single enemy with continuous thrusting attacks or swept at groups, taking advantage of its great reach and cleaving blade. A versatile weapon for any situation.

items.name: Halo Scythe
items.acquisition: War scythe of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella. This was the weapon of commanders in Malenia's army, and the half-halo blade deals holy damage.

details.description: War scythe of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella. This was the weapon of commanders in Malenia's army, and the half-halo blade deals holy damage.

items.name: Hammer
items.acquisition: Found inside the Fortified manor, beside the Sanctified Whetblade

details.description: Hammer comprised of a large stone affixed to a metal handle. Originally a blacksmith's tool.  The art of smithing is said to have originated among the giants. This weapon's striking attacks boast ample weight behind them.

items.name: Hand Axe
items.acquisition: Commonly known as a hatchet, this smaller variety of axe is an everyday work tool. Despite its short reach, it is easy to handle, exceling in successive attacks.

details.description: Commonly known as a hatchet, this smaller variety of axe is an everyday work tool. Despite its short reach, it is easy to handle, exceling in successive attacks.

items.name: Hand Ballista
items.acquisition: At the top of the Forest Lookout Tower, west of the Bridge of Sacrifice.

details.description: An unconventional ballistic device modeled on a weapon used to besiege castles. Only capable of firing greatbolts.  Perfect for reckless acts such as storming a castle on facing an entire army alone.

items.name: Hand of Malenia
items.acquisition: Blade built into Malenia's prosthetic arm. Through consecration it is resistant to rot. Malenia's war prosthesis symbolized her victories. Some claim to have seen wings when the weapon was raised aloft; wings of fierce determination that have never known defeat.

details.description: Blade built into Malenia's prosthetic arm. Through consecration it is resistant to rot. Malenia's war prosthesis symbolized her victories. Some claim to have seen wings when the weapon was raised aloft; wings of fierce determination that have never known defeat.

items.name: Harp Bow
items.acquisition: Acquired by solving the Champion's Song Painting, found in The Shaded Castle

details.description: Bow fashioned from a minstrel's harp. Sonorous tones still resound when firing arrows. Troubadours sing tales of champions, both in the honorable service of the Erdtree, and the one who spurns honor for blasphemy.

items.name: Heavy Crossbow
items.acquisition: Heavy crossbow with iron limbs, increasing damage dealt. Commonly employed in the Shattering.

details.description: Heavy crossbow with iron limbs, increasing damage dealt. Commonly employed in the Shattering.

items.name: Helphen's Steeple
items.acquisition: Greatsword. Dropped by the Tibia Mariner boss found up on a ridge south of Castle Sol .

details.description: Greatsword patterned after the black steeple of the Helphen, the lampwood which guides the dead of the spirit world. The lamplight is similar to grace in appearance, only it is said that it can only be seen by those who met their death in battle.

items.name: Highland Axe
items.acquisition: Axe. Found in the same hall as the Grafted Scion miniboss, under a large painting.

details.description: Single-sided axe used by the warriors of the highlands.  Brave combatants begin battle by crying out their names. Roars are enhanced by this weapon.

items.name: Hookclaws
items.acquisition: Claw weapon. Found on a corpse in the corner of a small corridor on the first level of the wine cellar, filled with crates and patrolled by a single Castle Guard.

details.description: Weapon worn on the fist comprised of sharp parallel blades favored by those who lurk in the dark. Lacerations cause blood loss with great effect.  Claw weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will equip it to both hands.

items.name: Horn Bow
items.acquisition: Bow. Found on a corpse under the stairs leading to Hallowhorn Grounds .

details.description: Longbow made from animal horn. Wielded by the master hunters of the ancestral followers.  Imbues arrows fired with magic damage. Reveals its true worth when used magic-infused arrows.

items.name: Horned Warrior's Greatsword
items.acquisition: Guaranteed drop from the Wind-Aspected Horned Warrior towards the end of Enir-Ilim.

items.name: Horned Warrior's Sword
items.acquisition: Curved Sword dropped by the Horned Warrior found in the norhwestern area of the Belurat Tower Settlement Swamp.

items.name: Hoslow's Petal Whip
items.acquisition: Whip. Dropped by Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood upon defeat.

details.description: Metal whip formed of razor-sharp chain-link blades that have the appearance of flower petals. This work of art is handed down though the generations of the illustrious House Hoslow. High dexterity is required to wield this weapon, but it excels at inflicting devastation

items.name: Icerind Hatchet
items.acquisition: Axe found inside a chest in the Temple Quarter . The chest is located in what remains of the tower of a ruined building, by some poison flowers.

details.description: A hatchet with a frost-coated blade. One of several gifts given by Castle Sol in the distant north. Known as "freezing fog," the blade is thought to be a dragon's scale. Inflicts a powerful frost effect.

items.name: Igon's Greatbow
items.acquisition: After defeating Bayle the Dread while Igon is summoned, Igon will drop this item at his last location at the Foot of the Jagged Peak Drake.

items.name: Inquisitor's Girandole
items.acquisition: Spear . Dropped by the Abductor Virgins .

details.description: Instrument of torture used on nobles behind the curtain at the  Volcano Manor of Mt. Gelmir. Its numerous spikes pierce the flesh, then singe the wounds with flame. The smell of burnt blood induces despair in the victim. A candlestick conveived by a thorough mind.

items.name: Inseparable Sword
items.acquisition: Prince of Death's Throne, after giving D's brother D's Twinned Set

items.name: Iron Ball
items.acquisition: Dropped by Blackguard Big Boggart .

details.description: Iron manifer of spherical shape. Big Boggart the blackguard's weapon of choice. Not a weapon to be taken lightly, as its weighty blows shatter bones with ease.

items.name: Iron Cleaver
items.acquisition: Dropped by one of the enemies that can be found at behind the big door, on the right side.

details.description: Fairly large iron cleaver, commonly used by the maltreated Misbegotten.  Steeped in resentment, these weapons are swung wildly and relentlessly, often after rushing up to foes.

items.name: Iron Greatsword
items.acquisition: Greatsword with a blade of unusually thick steel. A coarse weapon to which polishing is a foreign concept. Weighty even among others of its class, the impact of each strike is sure to be felt.

details.description: Greatsword with a blade of unusually thick steel. A coarse weapon to which polishing is a foreign concept. Weighty even among others of its class, the impact of each strike is sure to be felt.

items.name: Iron Spear
items.acquisition: Commonly used iron spear with no notable traits. The blade is severely rusted.

details.description: Commonly used iron spear with no notable traits. The blade is severely rusted.

items.name: Ivory Sickle
items.acquisition: Dagger. Can be found at the Village of the Albinaurics .It is up a small hill from the Site of Grace, past a perfumer enemy, behind a coffin. Nearby, Albus hides as a pot.

details.description: Sickle fashioned form ivory.  Weapon carried by aged Albunaurics. These weapons re evidence of their dedication to the Haligtree, despite never having entered its presence.

items.name: Jar Cannon
items.acquisition: Ballista. Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Margot when defeated.

details.description: Jar cannon which uses explosives to fire greatbolts. Deals great damage but is slow to reload.  Experimental firearm brought to the assault on Volcano Manor, where it was discovered that no one knew how to use it.

items.name: Jawbone Axe
items.acquisition: Axe made from a herbivore's skull. Weapon of the ancestral followers who disdain metal. This axe is more of a bludgeon; it forgoes a bladed edge, instead using the beast's molar teeth to buffet foes, dealing strike damage.

details.description: Axe made from a herbivore's skull. Weapon of the ancestral followers who disdain metal. This axe is more of a bludgeon; it forgoes a bladed edge, instead using the beast's molar teeth to buffet foes, dealing strike damage.

items.name: Katar
items.acquisition: First Weapon. Looted from a treasure chest in Fort Gael . You can find the chest inside a dark room on the elevated platform above the Lion Guardian.

details.description: Imported dagger design with a rather unique handle. The blade can be swung about as the extension of one's fist.

items.name: Knight's Greatsword
