items.acquisition: Greatsword bestowed upon skilled swordsmen in the demigods' service, and yet had no rank or title. Featuring a long grip enabling a dual-handed use, this weapon was designed to dispatch larger foes. Being charged with such a duty was undoubtedly a great honor.

details.description: Greatsword bestowed upon skilled swordsmen in the demigods' service, and yet had no rank or title. Featuring a long grip enabling a dual-handed use, this weapon was designed to dispatch larger foes. Being charged with such a duty was undoubtedly a great honor.

items.name: Lamenting Visage
items.acquisition: Inside a room on the lower level of the Lamenter's Gaol , you'll need to obtain the Gaol Lower Level Key to gain access.

items.name: Lance
items.acquisition: On top of the big square structure to the west of Deathtouched Catacombs . Jump off the nearby cliff to reach the top.

details.description: Considered a type of greatspear, this weapon has no blade, but instead features a long, conical body designed to pierce. Though heavy and hard to wield, this weapon displays its worth in horseback combat whether mounted or even on foot.

items.name: Large Club
items.acquisition: On the lowest cliff south of the Forlorn Hound Evergaol , near a spiritspring

details.description: A thick, solid lump of wood. Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill. A simple, primitive weapon that requires only brute strength to swing about.

items.name: Lazuli Glintstone Sword
items.acquisition: A sword with a glintstone in its handguards. Wielded by scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus who seek to master Carian sorcery. Deals magic damage. Apparently once used as a staff of sorcery, this sword is made of wood.

details.description: A sword with a glintstone in its handguards. Wielded by scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus who seek to master Carian sorcery. Deals magic damage. Apparently once used as a staff of sorcery, this sword is made of wood.

items.name: Leda's Sword
items.acquisition: Dropped by Needle Knight Leda upon defeat.

items.name: Light Crossbow
items.acquisition: Ranged weapoon made from a bow fixed to a stock. Deals good damage and is simple to use, but requires reloading after firing. Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.

details.description: Ranged weapoon made from a bow fixed to a stock. Deals good damage and is simple to use, but requires reloading after firing. Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.

items.name: Lightning Perfume Bottle
items.acquisition: Located on a corpse in the middle of a big puddle of water guarded by a rolling lightning ram enemy.

items.name: Lion Greatbow
items.acquisition: Greatbow of black iron wielded by General Radahn. Decorated with a lion mane motif. Imbued with gravitational power of the Starscourge, when used along with .  Radahn's Spear, it becomes a true weapon of a champion.

details.description: Greatbow of black iron wielded by General Radahn. Decorated with a lion mane motif. Imbued with gravitational power of the Starscourge, when used along with .  Radahn's Spear, it becomes a true weapon of a champion.

items.name: Longbow
items.acquisition: Longbow made to fire arrows over great distances. Compared to a shortbow, arrows fired reach further and deal more damage. To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.

details.description: Longbow made to fire arrows over great distances. Compared to a shortbow, arrows fired reach further and deal more damage. To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.

items.name: Longhaft Axe
items.acquisition: Rare drop from enemies wielding it at Castle Mourne in Weeping Peninsula. There is an easy to kill one from Beside the Rampant Gaol site of grace, cross the bridge and will be on the left sleeping.

details.description: Large iron axe with a long handle. Weapon of the maltreated Misbegotten. Making use of the force generated by its length, this weapon's resentment-charged blows are difficult to stop.

items.name: Longsword
items.acquisition: A straight sword with a double-edged blade. In addition to its easily-inflicted standard damage, this well- balanced weapon can also perform powerful piercing attacks.

details.description: A straight sword with a double-edged blade. In addition to its easily-inflicted standard damage, this well- balanced weapon can also perform powerful piercing attacks.

items.name: Lordsworn's Greatsword
items.acquisition: Greatsword. Found inside a Wagon Chest.

details.description: Well-crafted straight sword with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army. Through blackened and damaged by years of use, it appears to have otherwise been kept in a serviceable condition, despite the soldiers having long since lost their minds.

items.name: Lordsworn's Straight Sword
items.acquisition: Dropped by a head-less, undead Soldier at Fourth Church of Marika.

details.description: Well-crafted straight sword with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army. Though blackened and damaged by years of use, it appears to have otherwise been kept in a servicable condition, despite the soldiers having long since lost their minds.

items.name: Loretta's War Sickle
items.acquisition: Halberd. Dropped by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree .

details.description: Intricately crafted silver war sickle wielded by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. Originally given for service as a personal guard to Carian royalty, the weapon's blue glintstone has been replaced with unalloyed gold.

items.name: Lucerne
items.acquisition: East of Highland Lookout Tower in East Liurnia of the Lakes, found in the battlefield between phantoms and knights near where the armored giant spawns. Break some carts to reveal the treasure.

details.description: This polearm features a hard, sharpened beak-like spike attached to its head, designed to pierce armor. Though designed mainly as a thrusting weapon, its long handle can be utilized to get around an enemy's guard with a sideward sweeping attack.

items.name: Lusat's Glintstone Staff
items.acquisition: Glintstone Staff. Found in a chest in the building north of the Nox Swordstress & Nox Priest bosses' chamber after defeating them.

details.description: Staff of the primeval glintstone sorcerer Lusat. Only those who have glimpsed what lies beyond the wisdom ofstone may wield it. Enhances power ofall sorceries, but consumes additional FP.

items.name: Mace
items.acquisition: An iron bludgeon with sharp protrusions. Strinking attacks have few drawbacks, potent as they are at breaking through guards and stances, Most suited to head on slugging matches.

details.description: An iron bludgeon with sharp protrusions. Strinking attacks have few drawbacks, potent as they are at breaking through guards and stances, Most suited to head on slugging matches.

items.name: Madding Hand (weapon)
items.acquisition: The weapon is acquired upon defeating the hostile NPC, Madding Hand.

items.name: Magma Blade
items.acquisition: Curved sword with a blade fashioned from the lava of Mt. Gelmir. An armament of the man-serpents, impossible for a human to have made. Deals fire damage.

details.description: Curved sword with a blade fashioned from the lava of Mt. Gelmir. An armament of the man-serpents, impossible for a human to have made. Deals fire damage.

items.name: Magma Whip Candlestick
items.acquisition: Whip . Rewarded by Patches after completing his Volcano Manor quest.

details.description: This ritual implement is a three pronged candlestick with solid flames formed of the magma of Mt. Gelmir. When wielded as a weapon, the flames become supple whips of lava.

items.name: Magma Wyrm's Scalesword
items.acquisition: Curved Greatsword dropped by Magma Wyrm Makar

details.description: Curved greatsword wielded by Magma Wyrms. The shape resembles a dragon's jaw and is covered in hard scales. It's said these land-bound dragons were once humans heroes who partook in dragon communication, a grave transgression for which they were cursed to crawl the earth upon their bellies, shadows of their former selves.

items.name: Main-gauche
items.acquisition: Midway through the Stairs, turn right and enter the room. Enter the room on the right, and defeat the enemies to find the body that contains this weapon on the other side.

items.name: Maliketh's Black Blade
items.acquisition: Maliketh's black blade which once harbored the power of the Rune of Death. A sad shadow of its former glory. After a fragment of Death was stolen on that fateful night, Maliketh bound the blade within his own flesh, such that none might ever rob Death again.

details.description: Maliketh's black blade which once harbored the power of the Rune of Death. A sad shadow of its former glory. After a fragment of Death was stolen on that fateful night, Maliketh bound the blade within his own flesh, such that none might ever rob Death again.

items.name: Mantis Blade
items.acquisition: Dropped by a Cemetary Shade inside the Gelmir Hero's Grave . This enemy can be found by heading down the first Chariot hall until you reach a point where there is a pit on either side of the central concrete walkway instead of lava. Drop into the left pit onto some wooden beams and then drop into the room below. The shade is in an alcove in the eastern wall.

details.description: A curved sword with a blade at both ends wielded by the Cemetery Shades, the insect-ridden grave keepers.  The blade is thin and sharp, and strong attack unleashes a far-reaching slash.

items.name: Marais Executioner's Sword
items.acquisition: Dropped by Elemer of the Briar inside the The Shaded Castle .

details.description: Storied sword of House Marais, the family of executioners who presided over the Shaded Castle. One of the legendary armaments. Elemer of the Briar, the Bell Bearing Hunter, snatched the sword from the site of his looming execution, and furnished it with battle skills from his home of Eochaid..

items.name: Marika's Hammer
items.acquisition: Stone hammer made in the lands of the Numen, outside the Lands Between. The tool with which Queen Marika shattered the Elden Ring and Radagon attempted to repair it. The hammer partially broke upon shattering the Ring, becoming splintered with rune fragments.

details.description: Stone hammer made in the lands of the Numen, outside the Lands Between. The tool with which Queen Marika shattered the Elden Ring and Radagon attempted to repair it. The hammer partially broke upon shattering the Ring, becoming splintered with rune fragments.

items.name: Maternal Staff
items.acquisition: Dropped by Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers

items.name: Meteoric Ore Blade
items.acquisition: Katana. Found inside a chest in a small room at the back of an underground hall filled with sarcophagi and Prawn Miners enemies. The entrance is found in the northwest section of the Caelid Waypoint Ruins .

details.description: Katana forged from meteoric ore to dispatch lifeforms born of falling stars. Deals magic damage. The blade is weighty, known to deliver slashes of such ferocity that the impact is said to resemble the crash of a falling meteor.

items.name: Meteorite Staff
items.acquisition: Glintstone Staff with S scaling but no upgrades. Found on a corpse hanging from a window in Street of Sages Ruins in the swamp of Caelid.

details.description: Staff embedded with a dark purple glintstone, said to be the fragment of a meteorite. Boasts high sorcery scaling and boosts gravity sorceries as well. However, this staff cannot be strengthened in any way.

items.name: Milady
items.acquisition: The Milady Light Greatsword weapon can be found inside a chest. The chest is located at the top of a watchtower.

items.name: Miquellan Knight's Sword
items.acquisition: Straight Sword . Found atop a belltower. You can reach this belltower by entering the second alcove on the left of the eastern walkway, heading up the stairs and then jumping onto the tree branch on the balcony. Follow the tree branch up and across to reach the tower.

details.description: Sword forged by servants of Miquella of the Haligtree, with a design modeled after those carried by Carian knights. Instead of glintstone however, amber from the Haligtree is embedded in the blade. A sumptuous piece, yet it has never been offered to any knight — an ill-starred sword with no master. Skill: Sacred Blade

items.name: Misbegotten Shortbow
items.acquisition: There are flying enemies at the top of the castle. Thet may drop this weapon when killed.

details.description: Shortbow wielded by Winged Misbegotten. Fine fur clings to it. Designed to inflict additional damage by sacrificing range.

items.name: Miséricorde
items.acquisition: Dagger. Found on a corpse inside the Armory. Requires a Stonesword Key in order to dispel the fog gate barring entry.

details.description: Dagger favored by military physicians in white.  The pointed blade is hard and sharp, making critical hits especially potent.  Medicine is mercy. and mercy upon the battlefield is ruthless. Beware the killers clothes as men of compassion

items.name: Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear
items.acquisition: Trident of Mohg, Lord of Blood. A sacred spear that will come to symbolize his dynasty. As well as serving as a weapon, it is an instrument of communion with an outer god who bestows power upon accursed blood. The mother of truth desires a wound.

details.description: Trident of Mohg, Lord of Blood. A sacred spear that will come to symbolize his dynasty. As well as serving as a weapon, it is an instrument of communion with an outer god who bestows power upon accursed blood. The mother of truth desires a wound.

items.name: Monk's Flameblade
items.acquisition: Curved sword with a flickering flame motif. Wielded by the Fire Monks who came from the Mountaintops of the Giants. The monks came to the land of Liurnia in pursuit of a fugitive who stole their fire.

details.description: Curved sword with a flickering flame motif. Wielded by the Fire Monks who came from the Mountaintops of the Giants. The monks came to the land of Liurnia in pursuit of a fugitive who stole their fire.

items.name: Monk's Flamemace
items.acquisition: Warhammer made to resemble flickering flames. Signature weapon of the Fire Monks, who hail from the Mountaintops of the Giants.  The unique strong attack rouses fiery combative spirit.

details.description: Warhammer made to resemble flickering flames. Signature weapon of the Fire Monks, who hail from the Mountaintops of the Giants.  The unique strong attack rouses fiery combative spirit.

items.name: Moonrithyll's Knight Sword
items.acquisition: The weapon drops from defeating the hostile NPC Invader, Moonrithyll, Carian Knight.

items.name: Moonveil
items.acquisition: Katana. Dropped by Magma Wyrm inside Gael Tunnel .

details.description: Katana forged of glintstone. Masterpiece of a Sellian wordsmith.  Light enwreathes the blade when sheathed, explaining its Moonveil moniker.

items.name: Morgott's Cursed Sword
items.acquisition: Warped blade of shifting hue used by Morgott, the Omen King.  The accused blood that Morgott recanted and sealed away reformed into this blade.

details.description: Warped blade of shifting hue used by Morgott, the Omen King.  The accused blood that Morgott recanted and sealed away reformed into this blade.

items.name: Morning Star
items.acquisition: Hammer-type Weapon. Found in a chest inside a broken wagon along the road.

details.description: Warhammer comprised of a globe attached to a handle. Though a bludgeon dealing strike damage, the appellative star covered. in spikes which cause blood loss. Ironic given its grace name, this weapon often reeks of blood.

items.name: Nagakiba
items.acquisition: Can be obtained by completing Bloody Finger Hunter Yura's questline at the Second Church of Marika

details.description: Katana with a ferociously long blade. Signature weapon of Yura, hunter of Bloody Fingers. Reminiscent of a reinforced spear, its imposing lenth can be put to good use with powerful thrusting attacks.

items.name: Nanaya's Torch
items.acquisition: From Midra's Library Site of Grace, you'll need to move one of the bookshelves by pulling a lever in the same room. The balcony you need to reach is directly above the inquisitor below. This torch is on a corpse sitting on a chair, wearing a yellow cloth that resembles that of Hyetta.

items.name: Nightrider Flail
items.acquisition: Dropped by Night's Cavalry that spawns at night near Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace.

details.description: A flail with two additional bludgeoning heads.   Weapon of the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds. The large spikes make it highly effective at inducing blood loss, but also demand higher dexterity to wield.

items.name: Nightrider Glaive
items.acquisition: Halberd dropped by miniboss Night's Cavalry . Only appears at night.

details.description: A jet-black glaive with a blade as weighty as a bludgeon. Weapon of the Night's Vavalry who ride funeral seeds.  This glaive excels at weighty slash attacks that crash into foes, making it a powerful weapon even on horse back.

items.name: Noble's Estoc
items.acquisition: Estoc carried by wandering nobles. Made to be easy to wield.  Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.

details.description: Estoc carried by wandering nobles. Made to be easy to wield.  Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.

items.name: Noble's Slender Sword
items.acquisition: Narrow blade carried by wandering nobles. Made to be easy to wield. Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.

details.description: Narrow blade carried by wandering nobles. Made to be easy to wield. Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.

items.name: Nox Flowing Hammer
items.acquisition: From the Night Sacred Ground Site of Grace in Nokron, go up the stairs to your right. You should find yourself in a room with a Nox Monk and a Silver Tear Ball. Slay these enemies, then ascend a ladder to the back right of the room. Go down the path to the right of the Altar to where you see a Gargoyle Fog Wall. Turn right about halfway down the hallway and you should see a Roof Path out a window with a single Tear Slime. Head to the shingled section of the roof to find a single, unbarred window. Jump through that window to find the Nox Flowing Hammer.

details.description: Mace shaped like a suspended metal droplet wielded by monks of the Eternal City. Forged from liquid metal from a Silver Tear, it is thoroughly tempered until hardened.

items.name: Nox Flowing Sword
items.acquisition: Curved Sword. Dropped by the Nox Swordstress & Nox Priest bosses upon defeat.

details.description: A grim weapon wielded by swordsmen of the Eternal City, this shotel has a blade as fine as a needle. Forged from the liquid metal of a Silver Tear, it is thoroughly tempered until hardened

items.name: Obsidian Lamina
items.acquisition: Complete the entirety of Sir Ansbach's questline by assisting him. This weapon will be available at the end of his questline after the Final Boss where he will be by the entrance to the arena after the fight.

items.name: Omen Cleaver
items.acquisition: Curved Greatsword. Dropped by the Omen enemy in the northwest section of the courtyard. It is advised to take out all of the lesser enemies nearby before taking on the ogre.

details.description: Heavy-bladed curved sword of colossal size awarded to Omen as a tool of war. This weapon is made to take advantage of brute strength.  The pattern etched upon the blade is the remnant of a deteriorating malediction. Indeed, when bestowing a weapon, preparations must be made for taking it away.

items.name: Onyx Lord's Greatsword
items.acquisition: Curved Greatsword . Dropped by the Onyx Lord when defeated.

details.description: Greatsword forged from golden-hued meteoric ore.  The blade conceals gravity-manipulating magic. A weapon unique to the Onyx Lords, a race of ancients with skin of stone who were said to have risen to life when a meteor struck long ago.

items.name: Ordovis's Greatsword
items.acquisition: Greatsword . Obtained by defeating Crucible Knight Ordovis and his regular Crucible Knight companion in their Duo Boss Fight inside the Auriza Hero's Grave .

details.description: Greatsword of Ordovis, one of the two honored as foremost among the Crucible Knights. This sword is imbued with an ancient holy essence. Its red tint exemplifies the nature of primordial gold, said to be close in nature to life itself.

items.name: Ornamental Straight Sword
items.acquisition: Straight Sword. Dropped by the Grafted Scion upon defeat.

details.description: Slender straight sword patterned after an antique ornament. Superior swordsmen prefer to wield one in each hand. After falling from grace, the dregs of the golden lineage sought power and purpose in the past.

items.name: Parrying Dagger
items.acquisition: A knife with curved handguards. Designed to parry, turning foes' attacks against them.  For master of combat who anticipate every enemy strike and counter accordingly, this weapon is all they need.

details.description: A knife with curved handguards. Designed to parry, turning foes' attacks against them.  For master of combat who anticipate every enemy strike and counter accordingly, this weapon is all they need.

items.name: Partisan
items.acquisition: A Partisan Spear that can be dropped from a Godrick Knight in Fort Haight .

details.description: Spear with a wide tip. In addition to its thrusting attacks, this highly versatile weapon can be swing to sweep through foes.

items.name: Pata
items.acquisition: Fist Weapon looted from a corpse hanging on the cliff just north from the Church of Benediction . This same corpse has the Oathseeker Set

items.name: Pest's Glaive
items.acquisition: Glaive made from a hard, sharpened shell. Wielded by the pests who emerged from the Swamp of Aeonia. Slightly increases non-physical damage negation. Though men might recognize the keen intellect of the pests evidenced by this spear's uncanny design, it will never be understood by them.

details.description: Glaive made from a hard, sharpened shell. Wielded by the pests who emerged from the Swamp of Aeonia. Slightly increases non-physical damage negation. Though men might recognize the keen intellect of the pests evidenced by this spear's uncanny design, it will never be understood by them.

items.name: Pickaxe
items.acquisition: Large pickaxe designed to crack thick bedrock. Tool of sturdy miners. Not originally designed as a weapon, but very adept at piercing armor. "Little wretches, do you think your armor harder than stone?"

details.description: Large pickaxe designed to crack thick bedrock. Tool of sturdy miners. Not originally designed as a weapon, but very adept at piercing armor. "Little wretches, do you think your armor harder than stone?"

items.name: Pike
items.acquisition: Can be looted off a corpse that's lying on the heavily guarded courtyard. The nearest checkpoint is the Liftside Chamber site of grace

details.description: A longspear featuring an especially length handle. Specialized for use from long distances, it boasts the longest reach of any melee weapon. Incrdibly useful even against foes on horseback, but hard to wield in cramped spaces.

items.name: Poisoned Hand
items.acquisition: Across the previous Knot Resin, there is a Horned Warrior, in a big area. To that area's right, there is a medium-sized building, similar to a church, and beside it, you will find the Poisoned Hand weapon. Note that the building is infested with Man-Fly.

items.name: Prelate's Inferno Crozier
items.acquisition: Drops from the Prelate wielding it inside Fort Laiedd

details.description: Colossal hammer with the appearance of roiling flames. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. Its heft represents the weight of their guardianship.  The hammer's head is unusually substantial, and strong attacks' will fling foes into the air.

items.name: Prince of Death's Staff
items.acquisition: Climbing on the roots to reach up the towers, it's in one of them.

items.name: Pulley Bow
items.acquisition: Pulley Bow can be found on a sitting corpse (at the top of a siege tower near Mt. Gelmir campsite. The tower is located to the northeast of Gelmir Hero's Grave.

details.description: Longbow which utilizes a series of pulleys and strings. The complex mechanism, which required advanced mathematical and mechanical understanding to craft, was likely made by a certain genius who learned Golden Order Fundamentalism.  Enhances precision while shooting, enabling arrows to fly much further distances.

items.name: Pulley Crossbow
items.acquisition: Can be found on a body at the Craftsman's Shack

details.description: Crossbow made with pulleys and power springs. The complex mechanism, which required advanced mathematical and mechanical understanding to craft, was likely made by a certain genius who learned Golden Order fundamentalism.   One touch fires a volley of bolts. Be warned; large stores of bolts can be quickly spent.

items.name: Queelign's Greatsword
items.acquisition: Use Iris of Occultation on the NPC in the Prayer Room to receive Queelign's Greatsword .

items.name: Rabbath's Cannon
items.acquisition: Rabbath's Rise. After you free the Spiritspring, head outside and use it while mounted on Torrent to reach the higher part of the tower. Loot the chest at the top to obtain this weapon.

items.name: Rakshasa's Great Katana
items.acquisition: Dropped by Rakshasa at Eastern Nameless Mausoleum.

items.name: Rapier
items.acquisition: A piercing sword with a sharp, slender blade. In addition to this weapon's thrusting attack prowess, it also boasts the ability to be used while guarding with a shield.  As one of the smaller piercing swords, quick successive thrust area easy to perform, but without a cutting edge, it cannot be used for slashing attacks.

details.description: A piercing sword with a sharp, slender blade. In addition to this weapon's thrusting attack prowess, it also boasts the ability to be used while guarding with a shield.  As one of the smaller piercing swords, quick successive thrust area easy to perform, but without a cutting edge, it cannot be used for slashing attacks.

items.name: Raptor Talons
items.acquisition: Located at Sage's Cave , in one of the chests, behind several secret walls

details.description: Claw comprised of two sharp, thin blades, wielded by the assassins of Ravenmount, this weapon allows them to imitate the attacks of Deathbirds. Besides excelling at airborne attacks, its charge attack mimics the vicious swoop of a bird of prey.

items.name: Red Bear's Claw
items.acquisition: Weapon drops upon defeating the Red Bear located at the Northern Nameless Mausoleum .

items.name: Red Branch Shortbow
items.acquisition: Drops from an Assassin on the study, past the Trumpeteer

details.description: Shortbow of polished red wood. Fashioned by a master craftsman and wielded by pages.  A bow which requires dexterity rather than strength to master.

items.name: Reduvia
items.acquisition: Dropped by Bloody Finger Nerijus

details.description: Jagged dagger with a distinctive curled blade. Carried by the noble servants of the Lord of Blood. This dagger rips the flesh as it enters, inflicting blood loss with sickening efficacy. A proud testament to the success of its vicious design, this weapon is perpetually coated in blood.

items.name: Regalia of Eochaid
items.acquisition: Straight Sword. Accessed by dropping down to this area after progressing through Gaol Cave

details.description: Treasured sword of Eochaid, a lesser, long-vanished domain. The copper coloration is not to be confused for rust, but is a conduit for its wielder to move it by their will alone.  Swords of Eochaid dance through the skies

items.name: Repeating Crossbow
items.acquisition: along the road next to the Ghostflame Dragon north of the Moorth Highway, South site of Grace

items.name: Ringed Finger
items.acquisition: Hammer found inside the Gelmir Hero's Grave . From the first Chariot hallway, head all the way down and turn left at the end of the path to find a room with a chest containing the weapon.

details.description: Bludgeon made of an enormous finger sheathed in several heavy rings. Thought to have been cut from an ancestor of the Fingercreeper. Some life yet remains in this legacy of an ancient act of blasphemy, as evidenced by the barely perceptible warmth it still exudes.

items.name: Ripple Blade
items.acquisition: Unique weapon wielded by young Albinaurics, this sword is modelled after the ripples that are thought to be the origin of their species. Its attack power is greatly enhanced with one's arcane attribute.

details.description: Unique weapon wielded by young Albinaurics, this sword is modelled after the ripples that are thought to be the origin of their species. Its attack power is greatly enhanced with one's arcane attribute.

items.name: Ripple Crescent Halberd
items.acquisition: Weapon wielded by young Albinaurics. The blade is said to resemble a partial image of a ripple, and its attack power scales with one's arcane attribute.

details.description: Weapon wielded by young Albinaurics. The blade is said to resemble a partial image of a ripple, and its attack power scales with one's arcane attribute.

items.name: Rivers of Blood
items.acquisition: Katana dropped by NPC invader Bloody Finger Okina . Spawns near the Church of Repose in the later areas of the game.

details.description: Weapon of Okina, swordsman from the Land of Reeds. A cursed weapon that has felled countless men.  When Mohg, the Lord of Blood, first felt Okina's sword, and madness, upon his flesh, he had a proposal, to offer Okina the life of a demon, whose thirst would never go unsated.

items.name: Rogier's Rapier
items.acquisition: Piercing sword of superior quality, featuring intricate ornamentation. Signature weapon of the sorcerer Rogier. High dexterity is required to wield the blade to its full potential, but mastery is a sight to behold, characterized by a flowing style which excels in successive attacks.

details.description: Piercing sword of superior quality, featuring intricate ornamentation. Signature weapon of the sorcerer Rogier. High dexterity is required to wield the blade to its full potential, but mastery is a sight to behold, characterized by a flowing style which excels in successive attacks.

items.name: Rosus' Axe
items.acquisition: An Axe found in the room sealed by the Imp Statue in the Black Knife Catacombs.

details.description: Usher of Death, Rosus, who shows the path to the catacombs throughout the Lands Between, is depicted on this ritual axe. The dead easily lose their way, and have always been in sore need i of a guiding hand.

items.name: Rotten Battle Hammer
items.acquisition: Warhammer. Guaranteed drop from the Rotten Duelist enemy in the area

details.description: Large iron warhammer designed for gladiatorial combat, now festering with scarlet rot. Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike. Skill: Braggart's Roar Declare your presence with a boastful roar. Raises attack power, defense, and stamina recovery speed.

items.name: Rotten Crystal Spear
items.acquisition: Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. Though festering with scarlet rot, its magic remains potent.

details.description: Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. Though festering with scarlet rot, its magic remains potent.

items.name: Rotten Crystal Staff
items.acquisition: Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot. Enhances Crystalian sorceries.

details.description: Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot. Enhances Crystalian sorceries.

items.name: Rotten Crystal Sword
items.acquisition: Straight Sword . Found in a chest guarded by 3 Crystalians . From the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace, head down the steps and jump over the rubble on the left. You can engage the Crystalians one by one by luring them to the hallway.

details.description: Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence.

items.name: Rotten Greataxe
items.acquisition: Colossal Weapon. Dropped by the duelist enemy guarding the rear of Ordina, Liturgical Town

details.description: Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat, now festering with scarlet rot. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.

items.name: Rotten Staff
items.acquisition: Colossal Weapon . Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar patrolling the ring walkway in the east.

details.description: Ceremonial staff depicting the Erdtree in its historic radiance. It festers with scarlet rot. Wielded by the avatars who protect the Minor Erdtrees.

items.name: Royal Greatsword
items.acquisition: Obtainable at the end of Ranni's questline; Blaidd will spawn in front of Ranni's Rise tower. Best him in combat for a final time to obtain this weapon along with his armor set.

details.description: Greatsword decorated in royal Carian Style. Favored weapon of Blaidd the Half-Wolf. In defiance of the fate he was born to, Blaidd swore to serve no master but Ranni. As proof. the sword was imbued with a cold magic at the moment oath was sworn.

items.name: Ruins Greatsword
items.acquisition: Acquired by defeating the Misbegotten Warrior and Crucible Knight duo bosses at Redmane Castle

missable.note: The Misbegotten Warrior + Crucible Knight duo at Redmane Castle is replaced while the Festival is active; defeat them first (reaching Altus or progressing Ranni auto-triggers the Festival).

details.description: Originally rubble from a ruin which fell from the sky, this surviving fragment was honed into a weapon. One of the legendary armaments. The ruin it came from crumbled when struck by a meteorite, as such this weapon harbords its destructive power.

items.name: Rusted Anchor
items.acquisition: Greataxe dropped by Scaly Misbegotten located in Morne Tunnel .

details.description: A rusty anchor wielded as a weapon. Each of its four flukes is thick and sharp, enabling piercing attacks. While the Tarnished left the Lands Between with their Kird, one boat alone was said to have been left behind.

items.name: Sacred Relic Sword
items.acquisition: Sword wrought from the remains of a god who should have lived a life eternal.  Thoughts on what the weapon portends are many and varied. Some consider it the mark of a great sin, or a sign of great devastation. Some think of it as the end of an age, while others; the beginning.

details.description: Sword wrought from the remains of a god who should have lived a life eternal.  Thoughts on what the weapon portends are many and varied. Some consider it the mark of a great sin, or a sign of great devastation. Some think of it as the end of an age, while others; the beginning.

items.name: Sacrificial Axe
items.acquisition: Axe. Dropped from miniboss that only spawns at night: Deathbird (Weeping Peninsula)

details.description: Hatchet used in ancient sacrificial rite. A Deathbird is depicted as a malevolent deity. The power of the rite yet lingers. A small amount of FP is restored upon slaying a foe.

items.name: Scavenger's Curved Sword
items.acquisition: Found in Mt. Gelmir , on a corpse near a Grafted Scion across a stone pillar-bridge northwest of the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite site of grace. The corpse closest to the ladder has the blade.

details.description: Unique curved sword, notched like shark's teeth. Weapon carried by corpse pillagers who prowl the sites of old battles. The blade is tacky with blood and covered in hefty nicks, making it totally uneven. Life can be sinister indeed.

items.name: Scepter of the All-Knowing
items.acquisition: Dropped together with the All-Knowing Set upon defeating Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing in Leyndell, Ashen Capital .

details.description: Scepter in the form of a hand grasping a pearl. Signature weapon of Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing. The pearl stands for the world, the heavens, and an eye, representing the many forms of knowledge, never fully attainable. Even knowing that, the All- Knowing's hand grasps for it.

items.name: Scimitar
items.acquisition: A curved sword with a single-sided blade. Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against armor and hides covered in tough scales. Smaller in size than most curved swords, it carves into enemies with quick, sharp cuts.

details.description: A curved sword with a single-sided blade. Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against armor and hides covered in tough scales. Smaller in size than most curved swords, it carves into enemies with quick, sharp cuts.

items.name: Scorpion's Stinger
items.acquisition: Dagger . Found in a chest to the very west of the Grand Cloister .

details.description: Dagger fashioned from a great scorpion's tail, glistening with scarlet rot. A ceremonial tool used by heretics, crafted from the relic of a sealed outer god.

items.name: Scythe
items.acquisition: Found in Cliffbottom Catacombs : toward the end of the dungeon, find a staircase to go up into a room with some Imps and a trap.

details.description: Large scythe featuring a long, slender blade. Designed to reap, this weapon is capable of rapidly inflicting blood loss while also slipping through an enemy's guard.  In the hands of a highly dexterous wielder it is capable of striking fear into the heart of any foe.

items.name: Sentry's Torch
items.acquisition: Torch Given to protectors of the Erdtree. Its flames are bestowed with a special incantation which allows the bearer to see assassins cloaked in veils. Furnished on behalf of the Erdtree and the Grace-Given Lord such that a Night of Black Knives will never come again.

details.description: Torch Given to protectors of the Erdtree. Its flames are bestowed with a special incantation which allows the bearer to see assassins cloaked in veils. Furnished on behalf of the Erdtree and the Grace-Given Lord such that a Night of Black Knives will never come again.

items.name: Serpent Bow
items.acquisition: Found by a pool of rot within Abandoned Cave

details.description: Malformed bow in the shape of a pair of poisonous snakes. Imbues arrows with poison through pagan magic, revealing its true worth when used with poison-infused arrows. Used by assassins known as the Formless Serpents.

items.name: Serpent Flail
items.acquisition: Head down using the ladder past the first tower, and defeat the enemies. Beware of the flamethrowers. Use spells or arrows if you have them. Reach the end of the area to find a chest that contains this item

items.name: Serpent-God's Curved Sword
items.acquisition: Can be found at Ruin-Strewn Precipice, after the first singing bat go up two ladders then another one on the left and walk across to where the Land Octopus are

details.description: Curved sword fashioned in the image of an ancient serpent deity and tool of a forgotten religion practiced on Mt. Gelmir. Formerly used to offer up sacrifices, this sword restores HP upon slaying an enemy.

items.name: Serpent-Hunter
items.acquisition: Great Spear . Held by a corpse on the left as you enter the boss chamber of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy . This weapon has a special interaction when fighting Rykard in both his first phase as the God-Devouring Serpent and second phase as Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.

details.description: Weapon that serves as both greatsword and spear. Thought to have been used to hunt an immortal great serpent in the distant past, it manifests a long blade of light when facing such a creature. When their master's heroic aspirations degenerated into mere greed, his men searched for a weapon with which they might halt their lord.

items.name: Serpentbone Blade
items.acquisition: Katana . Rewarded by Tanith after completing the second letter quest.

details.description: Sinister katana modeled after a serpent bone. The denely packed row of spines that jut away from the cutting edge are coated in a lethal poison

items.name: Shamshir
items.acquisition: Found inside the Highroad Cave, on a platform after the waterfall section, being feasted on by Giant Bats.

details.description: Curved sword with a thin blade of ample length. Light of weight despite its larger size, its slicing attacks come in rapid succession. A devastatingly powerful weapon in the hands of a skilled swordsman.

items.name: Short Spear
items.acquisition: A exceedingly plain spear of modest weight. Simple to wield compared to many of its peers, strong attack unleashes a series of successive piercing thrusts.

details.description: A exceedingly plain spear of modest weight. Simple to wield compared to many of its peers, strong attack unleashes a series of successive piercing thrusts.

items.name: Short Sword
items.acquisition: A short straight sword with a short blade.  In addition to its reliable standard damage, this weapon also boasts powerful piercing attacks.  Lightweight amongst straight swords, this weapon is easy to wield, requiring only humble attributes.

details.description: A short straight sword with a short blade.  In addition to its reliable standard damage, this weapon also boasts powerful piercing attacks.  Lightweight amongst straight swords, this weapon is easy to wield, requiring only humble attributes.

items.name: Shortbow
items.acquisition: Small bow made to fire arrows over great distances. Other than its ability to fire off arrows in rapid succession, it is also well-suited for use on horseback. To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.

details.description: Small bow made to fire arrows over great distances. Other than its ability to fire off arrows in rapid succession, it is also well-suited for use on horseback. To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.

items.name: Shotel
items.acquisition: Curved sword with a severely hooked blade. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard.  Made to hunt down humans, this weapon requires high dexterity to wield efficiently.

details.description: Curved sword with a severely hooked blade. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard.  Made to hunt down humans, this weapon requires high dexterity to wield efficiently.

items.name: Siluria's Tree
items.acquisition: Dropped by Crucible Knight Siluria

details.description: Siluria's Tree, weapon of one of the two honored as foremost among the Crucible Knights. The primordial form of the Erdtree is close in nature to life itself, and this spear, modeled on its crucible, is imbued with ancient holy essence.

items.name: Smithscript Axe
items.acquisition: Location: Taylew's Ruined Forge . From the initial site of grace, continue following the path, get past the enemy, and take the ladder down then jump across the other platforms and turn left. You will find a Golem there. Behind it, at the back of the room, you will find the Smithscript Axe.

items.name: Smithscript Cirque
items.acquisition: The weapon is looted from a body in the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past. The body is located by the edge of the sewage waterfall.

items.name: Smithscript Dagger
items.acquisition: Ruined Forge Lava Intake. Take the first ladder down, past the golem, and after the fire blob turn right. As soon as you enter the room past the Fire Blob, slightly to the left. You can also drop down to this area from the lever's location. At the end of the hallway, you will find a golem and this weapon on a corpse near the back wall.

items.name: Smithscript Greathammer
items.acquisition: Use the giant platform in the middle to jump to the other side. Once there, keep moving forward and on the left side there will be a fire blob enemy protecting the item. Defeat the enemy and loot the corpse behind it to obtain the weapon.

items.name: Smithscript Spear
items.acquisition: The weapon is looted from a body located on the main floor of the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past.

items.name: Soldier's Crossbow
items.acquisition: A crossbow of simple make, usable by anyone, but lacking in both power and accuracy. Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.

details.description: A crossbow of simple make, usable by anyone, but lacking in both power and accuracy. Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.

items.name: Spear
items.acquisition: Weapon comprised of a blade attached to a long haft. A far-reaching piercing weapon, it can be wielded from behind the safety of a raised shield. Very effective against mounted foes.

details.description: Weapon comprised of a blade attached to a long haft. A far-reaching piercing weapon, it can be wielded from behind the safety of a raised shield. Very effective against mounted foes.

items.name: Spiked Caestus
items.acquisition: A Caestus with the rivets replaced by blood loss-inducing spikes. Fists weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will it to both hands.

details.description: A Caestus with the rivets replaced by blood loss-inducing spikes. Fists weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will it to both hands.

items.name: Spiked Club
items.acquisition: A club with beast fangs wrapped around the striking end. The uneven spread of fangs causes blood loss. Given only to the toughest of demi-humans, this weapon is a badge of honor. Or so the demi-humans believe.

details.description: A club with beast fangs wrapped around the striking end. The uneven spread of fangs causes blood loss. Given only to the toughest of demi-humans, this weapon is a badge of honor. Or so the demi-humans believe.

items.name: Spiked Spear
items.acquisition: Chance for it to drop from a Marionette Soldier enemy just outside of Witchbane Ruins .

details.description: Weapon comprised of a spiked cylinder attached to a long pole. Capaable of dealing strike damage when swung. The spikes induce blood loss. Weapon of the Marionette Soliders employed by sorcerers.

items.name: Spiraltree Seal
items.acquisition: Reward for completing "The Sacred Tower" Painting Puzzle .

items.name: Spirit Glaive
items.acquisition: Charro's Hidden Grave: This Halberd Can be found on a corpse surrounded by gravestones in the northeastern edges of the area.

items.name: Spirit Sword
items.acquisition: Cerulean Coast: Located on a corpse lying next to some gravestones guarded by demi-humans. You can access this area by following the path East from Cerulean Coast West

items.name: Spread Crossbow
items.acquisition: A Spread Crossbow can be found on a body by the riverside and the Ellac Greatbridge. Past the Ellac Greatbridge turn right and head to the lower level. There is a smaller camp with three Messmer Soldiers. There you will find the Spread Crossbow.

items.name: St. Trina's Torch
items.acquisition: Special Torch. Looted from the treasure chest in the caravan wagon carted in the southern portion of Consecrated Ground in the northern lands.

details.description: Candlestand torch that burns with a light-purple flame. The carvings depict St. Trina, but in adult form, somewhat unnervingly.  The light-purple flame induces sleep.

items.name: Staff of Loss
items.acquisition: Glintstone Staff. Found on a corpse leaning over a building's balcony. Accessible by jumping across the rooftops.

details.description: Staff missing its glintstone. Wielded by sorcerers who believe that discovery comes through acts of asceticism. This staff is only capable of casting invisibility sorceries, but that is reason enough for some to wield it.

items.name: Staff of the Avatar
items.acquisition: Drops from the Erdtree Avatar you encounter near the Great Waterfall Crest site of grace. To reach the area, you have to defeat the Valiant Gargoyle duo boss then lie down on the coffin at the back

details.description: Ceremonial staff depicting the Erdtree in its historic radiance. Wielded by the avatars who protect the Minor Erdtrees. The avatars, emerging in the wake of the Elden Ring's shattering, were determined to protect the withering Erdtree's offspring.

items.name: Staff of the Guilty
items.acquisition: A heretical staff fashioned from a smoldering, withered sapling that turns the blood of sacrifices pierced by it into glinstone. Similar to hex magic. Sorceries are scaled with faith rather than intelligence when weilding this staff which enhances Thorn sorceries in particular.

details.description: A heretical staff fashioned from a smoldering, withered sapling that turns the blood of sacrifices pierced by it into glinstone. Similar to hex magic. Sorceries are scaled with faith rather than intelligence when weilding this staff which enhances Thorn sorceries in particular.

items.name: Star Fist
items.acquisition: In the left side of a castle situated atop the mountain near the West Capital Rampart grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital .

details.description: Spherical iron manifer covered in spikes which induce blood loss.  Used in brutal games of pugilism.

items.name: Star-Lined Sword
items.acquisition: Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Marigga, who can be found in Cerulean Coast's Demi-Human Valley.

items.name: Starscourge Greatsword
items.acquisition: Curved greatswords of black steel wielded by General Radahn. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif. Radahn earned considerable renown as the Starscourge in this youth, and it is said that it was during this time he engraved the gravity crest up these blades.

details.description: Curved greatswords of black steel wielded by General Radahn. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif. Radahn earned considerable renown as the Starscourge in this youth, and it is said that it was during this time he engraved the gravity crest up these blades.

items.name: Steel-Wire Torch
items.acquisition: Torch. Found on a corpse at the end of a narrow path at the top level of the castle. Guarded by two harpies.

details.description: Torch wound with metal wire. The flame can illuminate dark locales, or be used to attack enemies. Heavier than a normal torch, but the heated filament boosts fire damage dealt.

items.name: Stone Club
items.acquisition: Signature weapon of battlemages, hewn from hard glintstone.  This club is much heavier than its size suggests, but has no magic power. So that they not lose sight of the true essence of combat, battlemages prefer to feel the impact of their blows, fighting their opponents hand to hand.

details.description: Signature weapon of battlemages, hewn from hard glintstone.  This club is much heavier than its size suggests, but has no magic power. So that they not lose sight of the true essence of combat, battlemages prefer to feel the impact of their blows, fighting their opponents hand to hand.

items.name: Stone-Sheathed Sword
items.acquisition: This is one of the three altars that affect the Stone-Sheathed Sword. The first one gives you the sword, then you may get the Sword of Darkness or the Sword of Light. Raise the Stone-Sheathed Sword to the light or darkness at this altar to unlock the Sword of Light or Sword of Darkness

items.name: Stormhawk Axe
items.acquisition: 2x Found under the bridge leading from the swamp up to Village of the Albinaurics if Nepheli Leux has died.

details.description: Battle axe designed to resemble a hawk, wioth its wings comprising the blade. Signature weapon of warriors who strive to remain one with the storm, despite being so far from their place of birth. Their hearts are proud, and thereby easily undone.

items.name: Swift Spear
items.acquisition: The Swift Spear can be found lying on a corpse guarded by 3 Messmer Soldiers along the road

items.name: Sword of Milos
items.acquisition: Greatsword . Dropped by Dung Eater as an NPC invader upon defeat.

missable.lockedBy: Burning the Erdtree (Forge of the Giants)
missable.note: Dung Eater's moat invasion does not occur in the Ashen Capital.

details.description: Sinister greatsword fashioned from a giant's backbone. The spines along each side of the blade have been tapered to a fine point and mete out wounds like a lopside saw-blade. Milos was indersized for a giant, and was viewed as sullied and terribly gortesque.

items.name: Sword of Night
items.acquisition: Jolan is a Knight of Night that serves Count Ymir. After completing Ymir's questline, give Jolan the Iris of Occultation to receive the Sword of Night , or the Iris of Grace to receive Swordhand of Night Jolan Spirit Ashes

items.name: Sword of Night and Flame
items.acquisition: Straight Sword. Found in a chest inside a locked room behind the gardens. This is accessible by using the walkways above. You can get onto the walkways from the Chapel building in the west.

details.description: Storied sword and treasure of Caria Manor. One of the legendary armaments. Astrologers, who preceded the sroveres, established themselves in mountaintops that nearly touched the sky, and considered the Fire Giants their neighbors.

items.name: Sword of St. Trina
items.acquisition: Found inside a chest in the underground cellar of the Forsaken Ruins .

details.description: Silver sword carried by clerics of St. Trina. Inflicts sleep ailment upon foes. St. Trina is an enigmatic figure. Some say she is a comely young girl, others are sure he is a boy. The only certainty is that their appearance was as sudden as their disappearance.

items.name: Thiollier's Hidden Needle
items.acquisition: Summon Thiollier during the battle at the end of his questline, then loot his body in the boss arena after the fight.-

items.name: Thorned Whip
items.acquisition: Hefty whip coverd in crimson thorns. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. A device of fearsome religious encouragement, it is fashioned in the image of the briars of fin.  Very effective at inflicting blood loss.

details.description: Hefty whip coverd in crimson thorns. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. A device of fearsome religious encouragement, it is fashioned in the image of the briars of fin.  Very effective at inflicting blood loss.

items.name: Tooth Whip
items.acquisition: Found inside the Whipping Hut.

items.name: Torch
items.acquisition: This torch's tip is wrapped in oil-soaked rags and set on fire. The flame can illuminate dark locales, or used to attack enemies. Can be raised up when equipped in the left hand, illuminating more of the surrounding area.

details.description: This torch's tip is wrapped in oil-soaked rags and set on fire. The flame can illuminate dark locales, or used to attack enemies. Can be raised up when equipped in the left hand, illuminating more of the surrounding area.

items.name: Torchpole
items.acquisition: Torch fastened to a long pole. Lights up dark areas, but cannot be raised overhead. Used by soldiers on watch, its attacks set foes aflame.

details.description: Torch fastened to a long pole. Lights up dark areas, but cannot be raised overhead. Used by soldiers on watch, its attacks set foes aflame.

items.name: Treespear
items.acquisition: Found on the Caravan left at the edge of the collapsed bridge.

details.description: Golden spear with tree-like design. Wielded by knights employed as palace guards in the Royal Capital of Leyndell. Deals only holy damage.  Requiring superior dexterity to wield, this greatspear can perform consecutive thrust attacks despite its larger size.

items.name: Troll Knight's Sword
items.acquisition: Colossal Sword. Dropped by a Troll Knight guarding the staircase leading up to the boss of Caria Manor.

details.description: Greatsword embedded with a blue glintstone. Weapon of the trolls in service to the royal family of Caria. Called into service when the Queen invoked an oath they swore, the trolls are treated as true knights of Caria, and fight arm in arm with their human comrades.

items.name: Troll's Golden Sword
items.acquisition: In a Chest on a Black Carriage, which can be found east of Erdtree-Gazing Hill site of grace.

details.description: Sword given to the giants who fought for the Erdtree during the War against the Giants long ago. Though the giants have lost their minds, they stay inseparable from their swords that are in sad shape—such that the gold plating had flaked away.

items.name: Troll's Hammer
items.acquisition: Hammer Weapon. Found in a storage shed inside the Old Altus Tunnel dungeon.

details.description: Mining tool of stonedigger trolls used to crack bedrock.  Trolls are descended form the giants, and these were supposedly once used as ceremonial smithing tools. In the distance past, smithing was considered divine.

items.name: Twinblade
items.acquisition: Underground. Can be found once you take the stairs down Dragon-Burnt Ruins .

details.description: A sword with blades on both sides of the hilt. This weapon is difficult to wield, and requires high dexterity. Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is enabled  with dual-handed spinning attacks.

items.name: Twinned Knight Swords
items.acquisition: In a burning corpse pile in front of East Windmill Pasture in Altus Plateau .

details.description: An attractive twinblade of fine make that prizes the chivalric way.  Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is unlocked with dual-handed spinning attacks.

items.name: Uchigatana
items.acquisition: Found inside the Deathtouched Catacombs. It is in a body, hanging from the upper platform. You need to use the lever in order to reach that room. Beware of the Skeleton Archers.

details.description: A katana with a long single-edged curved blade.  A unique weapon wielded by the samurai from the Land of Reeds. The blade, with its undulating design, boasts extraordinary sharpness, and ts slash attacks cause blood loss.

items.name: Urumi
items.acquisition: Whip. Found on a body on the south-east ramparts, reached by jumping from the higher ramparts leading to the elevator and the Manor Upper Level site of grace.

details.description: This weapon made of extremely thin, flexible blades of metal is wielded like a whip by Nightfold warriors. Though in essence a whip with a cutting edge, it can also be used as a spear to pierce foes.

items.name: Varré's Bouquet
items.acquisition: Obtained from White-Faced Varre after invading him and depleting his dialogue.

details.description: A steel mace resembling a charming bouquet of roses. Each petal has a sharpened edge, leaving the roses perpetually colored with blood.  This weapon reflects White Mask Varré's manner of speech rather well, enticing in its splendor, but full of deadly consequence.

items.name: Velvet Sword of St. Trina
items.acquisition: From the Fissure Cross site of grace, walk north to the brick platform that's tilted nearly vertical. Climb down to a ledge that passes underneath the brick platform nearest the site of grace. The sword is in a small cave network there and guarded by several putrescent oozes.

items.name: Venomous Fang
items.acquisition: Claw Weapons. Climb on the Iron Maidens near the end of the Abandoned Cave to acquire them.

details.description: One of the weapons designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. The black fang protruding from the bronze snake head is coated in deadly poison.

items.name: Veteran's Prosthesis
items.acquisition: Fist Weapon. Dropped by Commander Niall upon defeat.

details.description: Bladed prosthetic leg enwreathed with the power of lightning, instead attached to the fist. Commander Niall, veteran of Castle Sol, offered this prosthesis in exchange for the lives of defeated knights held prisoner. He went on to lead these men as an army of no nation.

items.name: Vulgar Militia Saw
items.acquisition: A weapon comprised of a saw blade attached to a long grip. Brandished by the vulgar militia, its serrated edge is very effective at inflicting blood loss. The saw is said to also be used to cut up bodies to feed the militia, but there are no firsthand witnesses to confirm the dire rumor.

details.description: A weapon comprised of a saw blade attached to a long grip. Brandished by the vulgar militia, its serrated edge is very effective at inflicting blood loss. The saw is said to also be used to cut up bodies to feed the militia, but there are no firsthand witnesses to confirm the dire rumor.

items.name: Vulgar Militia Shotel
items.acquisition: A hooked blade attached to a long handle. Wielded by the vulgar militia, its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard. The vulgar militia are the undecorated stewards of rancid, scorched battlefields that none dare approach, and forbidden domains better forgotten by the rest of the world

details.description: A hooked blade attached to a long handle. Wielded by the vulgar militia, its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard. The vulgar militia are the undecorated stewards of rancid, scorched battlefields that none dare approach, and forbidden domains better forgotten by the rest of the world

items.name: Vyke's War Spear
items.acquisition: Can be dropped from Festering Fingerprint Vyke

details.description: War spear singed and blistered by fingers, used by Vyke, Knight of the Roundtable Hold. Like Vyke himself, it has been tormented by the yellow flame of frenzy from within.

items.name: Wakizashi
items.acquisition: Dagger. Found within Gaol Cave

details.description: Short sword with a tempering pattern on the blade. A weapon unique to warriors of the Land of Reeds. Afflicts targets with blood loss. These swords are considered auxiliary weapons. Yet, one man is known to wield this weapon in his left hand while using a full-sized katana in his right. A demonic swordsman known only as Okina.

items.name: Warhawk's Talon
items.acquisition: Talon-swords are affixed to the legs of the Stormveil's warhawks, but this one has been repurposed for human use. The blade is thin and lightweight so as not to obstruct the hawk's mobility.

details.description: Talon-swords are affixed to the legs of the Stormveil's warhawks, but this one has been repurposed for human use. The blade is thin and lightweight so as not to obstruct the hawk's mobility.

items.name: Warped Axe
items.acquisition: Oversized double-headed axe with a bizarre, almost melted appearance. Brute strength is the only thing required to wield this weapon, which appears to have taken quite the beating itself.

details.description: Oversized double-headed axe with a bizarre, almost melted appearance. Brute strength is the only thing required to wield this weapon, which appears to have taken quite the beating itself.

items.name: Warpick
items.acquisition: Looted from one of the many Undead Soldiers .

details.description: Warhammer with a hard protruding beak. A pickaxe designed for combat, in essence. A simple but highly effective weapon, the weighty piercing attack casually rips through metal armor.

items.name: Watchdog's Greatsword
items.acquisition: Stone greatsword wielded by Erdtree Burial Watchdogs. Though decorated with the watchman's eye, the pupil was taken by graverobbers and is now hollow, leaving this sword a mere lump of stone.

details.description: Stone greatsword wielded by Erdtree Burial Watchdogs. Though decorated with the watchman's eye, the pupil was taken by graverobbers and is now hollow, leaving this sword a mere lump of stone.

items.name: Watchdog's Staff
items.acquisition: Located in Road's End Catacombs , behind an illusory wall near the stairs at the beginning of the dungeon.

details.description: Large stone staff embedded with glintstone. Wielded by Erdtree Burial Watchdogs who protect catacombs. The Watchdogs, battered and broken over their lengthy tenure, rule the catacombs and are even said to command the imps. Unique Skill: Sorcery of the Crozier Channel magic into the glintstone to activate an ancient sorcery, producing floating magic projectiles that chase enemies automatically.

items.name: Weathered Straight Sword
items.acquisition: Straight sword with a rather short but wide blade. Simple to wield, it was known as the sword of the people. Though the Erdtree styling is still visible, time has not been kind to this sword, now merely a shadow of its former self.

details.description: Straight sword with a rather short but wide blade. Simple to wield, it was known as the sword of the people. Though the Erdtree styling is still visible, time has not been kind to this sword, now merely a shadow of its former self.

items.name: Whip
items.acquisition: Whip. Found on a corpse inside the building known as the Rampart Gaol. This building is first accessed by walking atop the western wall of the castle. Look to the left for a building with a blue roof. Jump onto this roof and then jump down to the cliffs below. Follow the cliffs southeast until you return to a section of the castle with a big square opening. Descend into the opening by landing on the wooden beams. There is a corpse with a Smithing Stone [2] on one of the beams and there are several Rats and a Harpy at the ground level. The corpse with the whip is sitting against a wall.

details.description: A leather whip. Not originally used for combat, but as an instrument of pain. Through its supple attacks cannot be thwarted by parrying or even guarding, it is incapable of dealing critical hits.

items.name: Wing of Astel
items.acquisition: Curved Sword . Found in a small chest at the top of the ruins in southern Uhl Palace Ruins . Inaccessible until entering from the Northern, higher level section.

details.description: Sword fashioned from a delicate wing, suffused with the magic of the stars. Strong attack unleashes a wave of enchanted light. Crafted from a relic of the Naturalborn of the Void who is said to have assailed the Eternal City.

items.name: Winged Greathorn
items.acquisition: A unique horn in which the power of ancestral spirit fiercly dwells, this large, wing-shaped specimen is wielded as weapon of spirit worship.  In the ancestral spirit-woshipping faith, these are considered envoys' wings, made to reap the lives of beings which experience no sprouting.

details.description: A unique horn in which the power of ancestral spirit fiercly dwells, this large, wing-shaped specimen is wielded as weapon of spirit worship.  In the ancestral spirit-woshipping faith, these are considered envoys' wings, made to reap the lives of beings which experience no sprouting.

items.name: Winged Scythe
items.acquisition: Located In the center of Tombsward Ruins , there is a set of stairs leading underground into a dark hall with a door to a small room at the end. The scythe is inside a chest in the small room.

details.description: Sacred scythe resembling a pair of white wings. Deals holy damage. According to pagan belief, white-winged maidens are said to be Death's gentle envoys.

items.name: Zamor Curved Sword
items.acquisition: Curved Greatsword. Dropped by the Ancient Hero of Zamor inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave upon defeat.

details.description: Weapon wielded by the knights of Zamor who earned great renown during the War against the Giants. In apparent devotion to winter, the curved blade is styled after an icy wind and imbued with a powerful frost effect.

items.name: Zweihander
items.acquisition: Just about the largest sword a mere man is capable of swinging. True to its name, it is designed to be wielded in both hands, but those of merely ordinary strength will still struggle to do so. The long blade is heavy and sharp, sending foes reeling back with its broader strokes, while also capable of a devastating piercing thrust.

details.description: Just about the largest sword a mere man is capable of swinging. True to its name, it is designed to be wielded in both hands, but those of merely ordinary strength will still struggle to do so. The long blade is heavy and sharp, sending foes reeling back with its broader strokes, while also capable of a devastating piercing thrust.

items.name: Black Whetblade
items.acquisition: Key Item. Found on a corpse slumped in front of an altar in Night's Sacred Ground .

details.description: Black whetblade with a cipher engraved. Can be used as a whetstone knife.

items.name: Glintstone Whetblade
items.acquisition: Looted off a corpse that is hanging on the fence of an office balcony. From the fountain of the academy's courtyard, go west and head up the slope. The office is in front of the group of kneeling Noble Zombies.

details.description: Glintstone whetblade with a cipher engraved. Can be used as a whetstone knife.

items.name: Iron Whetblade
items.acquisition: Key Item. Found on a corpse inside the Armory. Requires a Stonesword Key in order to dispel the fog gate barring entry.

details.description: Iron whetblade with a cipher engraved. Can be used as a whetstone knife.

items.name: Red-Hot Whetblade
items.acquisition: Key Item. Found in Redmane Castle , at the bottom level of the gate house building east of the main gate.

items.name: Sanctified Whetblade
items.acquisition: Found inside the fortified manor, you have to access by jumping through the roof and entering the building.

missable.lockedBy: Burning the Erdtree (Forge of the Giants)
missable.note: Royal Capital only; unlocks Holy/Lightning affinities. Collect before Farum Azula.
